chapters.title: Chapter 2930 Alteration! II
paragraphs: The vibrant Extremity Vein and rotating Aletheian Havens were mere twinklings of stellar objects far, far behind Athena and the others as they waited.
In front of them, the visage of the Extremity of Quintessence spoke at such a time.
{Expect the unexpected today. The design of Mors Apokalypsis knows of the power expressed in the last battle as today, it seeks to counter it.}
Noah's voice dripped with wild waves of power, his figure right now being something that very few could hold the gaze of or look at closely!
He seemed like a behemoth of a being that others couldn't carelessly look at, his existence alone inducing a sense of pressure and awe that made him seem different than all of them.
Yet even such a being cautioned them.
Even he told them to be careful.
And the reason for this....
HUUM!
Blared forth at this moment akin to a booming horn signaling the end.
Off to the side, the Bard of Quintessence opened his eyes as his monkey like visage began to play a set of drums before him.
DUM! DUM! DUM!
The drums were heavy in anticipation.
They seemed to be the beginnings of a symphony that may be his best one yet, his pupils shining brilliantly as they gazed past the barrier of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
There, an expanse of white light that everybody could see was blooming- a light of maddening existential Extremity Authority that could be felt all the way here!
It was Vitalis, yes.
But it wasn't the Vitalis they were familiar with.
The blooming transparent white light was something much purer as in anticipation of what would appear from this maddening light-
BOOM-CRACK!
The flow of existence seemed to have come to a halt.
The Bard of Quintessence didn't manage to capture what had just happened.
Lilith, Kazuhiko, Emperor Penguin, or any of the other Defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven didn't manage to see what happened!
Their eyes could not even follow it!
Only entities like the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and the Primogenitor of Steel managed to catch a glimpse- and only a glimpse.

Because as soon as the white light spread and they prepared, the barrier of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven cracked and splintered above them, a blinding white light moving towards them at speeds they couldn't even comprehend!
No, not moving towards them.
If it were moving toward them, they would already be dead.
It moved towards a single being with purpose.

In the span of an instant, at a speed others couldn't even react to, an absolute Titian of an entity appeared right in front of the Extremity of Quintessence as their blazing aura swept in like a tide.
It stood staunchly at the 9th Gradation of Extremity- nay, it even seemed to almost be exceeding it!
The moment it appeared...
BOOOM!

The weavings of Existence seemed to shatter as cracks spread across the surrounding space as if they were shattered mirrors, a heavy and suffocating force pushing everyone that was far behind Noah even further back as their existences creaked under the pressure!
And when they could finally see and react....

They saw the visage of the Extremity of Quintessence with his arms raised in a defensive position, tens of millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures swirling and cracking around him as the whole region behind him shone with blue, purple, colorless, and a tantalizing golden light!
In front of him, multiple Quintessential Superius Wheels of Extinction were deformed and bent as they held back the fists of a terrifying entity!
Not millions of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts.
Not tens of millions of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts.
Just one.
Massive in stature.
Glorious in nature.
The visage of the Extremity of Quintessence was currently the size of a World, but this beast was ten times as large.
It threw down two fists blazing with white Existential flames as truly, it was humanoid in nature.
Bulky and filled with tightly toned muscles that would put an existential bodybuilder to shame, a beastial humanoid could now be seen before Noah!
Its white tendons that seemed like existential steel forming its body were not the most astonishing.
The two pairs of wings behind its back were not the most astonishing!
The volatile nine white tails that seemed like stretchable rivers of planes of existence were not the most astonishing.
What was most astonishing was the head of this terrifying Entity. White flames danced wildly for its hair as its face...held a unique devilish charm that resembled a single being.
Noah's eyes were sharp as he felt the blossoming tyranny and Infinity within him, his arms creaking from the pressure as his Superius Wheels of Extinction were deformed.
His skin that was the hardness of a High Grade Armament of Extremity stung as he gazed sharply at the face of the entity ahead of him...that held his own likeness.
His devilish features.
His handsomeness.
His ferocity.
And even...
|Kneel.|

A booming and utterly undeniable voice boomed out as shockingly, a dazzling white throne appeared behind this creature, its two hands that were just smashing into Noah having already been retracted and thrown out again- this time with tendrils of billowing flames of extremely pure Vitalis that seemed to be mimicking Tyranny!
Vitalis...mimicking the extreme he always portrayed!
Vitalis.
A concept of beginning.
Everything had a beginning.
For a truly advanced application of the Extreme of Vitalis, one could weave a ridiculous stipulation that all extremes have a beginning, and Vitalis...could express the beginnings of any extreme.
An extremely, ridiculously, brazenly stupendous application of an extreme.
And one of the few able to apply such a ridiculous capability was none other than the will of a Codex of Extremity!
BOOM!
The impact was heavy.
Reality splintered and cracked as Noah's figure was pushed back like a meteor!
And his push would have continued, but a dazzling light of Extremity rose behind him as he faced a creature who moved at speeds and power that very few could even match.
{The Extremity of Relativity burns brightly while stating that speed is its forte.}
{The Extremity of Relativity seeks permission to advance towards Existential!}
An extreme burned brightly as Noah's will spread out in the surroundings.
He was stopped inches away from Barbatos and the others as shockingly, the beast mimicking his features had already arrived above and carried indomitable momentum!
Quintessence burned at such a scene.
Tyranny pulsed and Infinity blared.
And the Protagonist turned up with a piercing gaze as the extreme of Plot gained the support of all of his Existential Extremity Authorities.
{This is not our battlefield.}
Plot commanded.
Plot deemed it so.
And so...the figures of Noah and this unidentified beast suddenly disappeared from the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!

chapters.title: Chapter 2931 Mimeisthai! I
paragraphs: The scene was a horrific and mesmerizing one as to this point, very few had even comprehended what occurred!

Reality shattered like a broken mirror as a blazing white transparent authority bloomed, most of the Defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven catching a glimpse of the unidentified beast that held the likeness of the Extremity of Quintessence.
Thereafter, reality shattered again and both the Extremity of Quintessence and the unidentified beast disappeared!
The Defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven breathed heavily.
Their gazes were somber as they all felt the profound sense of suffocation from the beast that was just taken away from this domain!
And their gazes remained heavy.
{Fucking hell....}
The sweet voice of Barbatos let out a curse at the forefront as the brilliance of the blooming white light outside of the shattered boundary of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...did not disappear.
In the back, the gaze of Henry changed as a dazzling Golden light wrapped around him while he surged out with a bellow.
{Watch ou-!}
BOOM!

The reality before Barbatos shattered as another dazzling white light appeared, this one at a somewhat manageable speed as in front of it, a humanoid entity bathed in a silver bronze hue appeared protectively in front of Barbatos.
Even though this Queen of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had a Bastion of colorless bones protectively enacted around her.
The Extremity of Steel appeared forward like a valiant warrior as his power that seemed to be on the edge of spilling into the Ninth Gradation of Extremity stopped the newly appearing enemy!
An enemy that shockingly held a likeness of none other than...the son of the Extremity of Quintessence.
But ten times the size of a world. A humanoid body with white muscular tendons like steel, and yet the devil shot handsome looks of Henry!
The eyes were cold and callous as a heavy oppression of the Eighth Gradation of Extremity emanated from this newly appearing feature!
And it wasn't alone.
DUM! DUM! DUM!

The drums played by the Bard of Quintessence reached a heavy crescendo as soon after, from the storm of white light outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, beams of light moved out and became clear to all.
An unidentified beast with the likeness of Barbatos.
Short in stature, a blessed muscular chest, and wide spanning wings and 9 sharp tails.
A humanoid beast whose face looked very similar to Hyperion.
A humanoid beast who resembled a prideful Emperor Penguin!
One that looked like Sargon, Ishtar, and Elodie...and one that from afar, Lilith looked at with trembling eyes.

A demonic white humanoid beast with her dazzling face appeared as hellish white flames raged around her, and this beast and those around it gazed at the defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven coldly.
Those who carried a sense of likeness were those who had destroyed the highest number of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts during the first day.
They were deemed the greatest threats as multiple of these unidentified beasts with the likeness of the prominent defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven appeared as from them...
|Kneel.|
|Kneel.|
|KNEEL!|
A heavy and indomitable pressure unfolded and billowed down, each of them mimicking a sense of the profound extremes they had all just begun to get familiar with!
Away from the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
In the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, within the Supernal Haven of Helios.

Small golden Planes of Existence filled with dense numbers of Cosmos, Universes, and even more countless empty worlds were stretching out in the distance- all of them floating on top of one of the largest Archipelagos in this Haven.
And yet it was all empty with no Lifeforms at this moment- with the Weaver of Extremity having taken everything away hours ago!
And now...
BOOM!

Space fissured and cracked as the weavings of the Extremity of Quintessence appeared here once more, a terrifying beast opposing him whose nine tails danced with mad power, the pairs of wings behind its back vibrating with brilliance as the illusion of a throne behind it remained!
It held dominating momentum as just ever so briefly before it began to move again, the eyes of the Weaver of Extremity blazed with vermillion light as this unidentifiable creature became known.
{Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai} ...!
Mimeisthai!
An ancient word that closely stood for an entity that imitated others, their whole story coming to completion when the one they initiated was ultimately destroyed and devoured by them.
This was a Mimeisthai.

And what stood before Noah was an utterly terrifying one that seemed to almost be escaping the bounds of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, with the actions it carried out being utterly taboo with a shocking usage of the Existential Extremity Authority of Vitalis!
And they could only be taboo as...
|KNEEL!|
Its booming voice echoed out again, the weavings of Vitalis twisting uniquely as in the next moment, another massive visage of the Mimeisthai appeared.
And another.
And another.
A dozen.
A hundred.
A thousand!

It was the dazzling authority of Infinity being imitated as in an instant, 10,000 horrific figures of Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthais appeared in the dazzling space of the Supernal Haven of Helios.
It was taboo.
It was profane.
Looking at it, the extremes within Noah didn't hold an ounce of fear as a shocking force began to descend from all 10,000 Mimeisthais, his extremes instead rising with unstoppable anger and desire!
Something dared to copy them?!
BOOM!
An endless sea glimmered behind Noah as instantly, thousands of bodies just like his began to appear.

The blazing flames of tyranny also began to form at this time behind each one, but the speed of the Mimeisthai was utterly obscene as the combined attack of 10,000 of its bodies already arrived and smashed onto Noah and all the figures behind him!
BOOM...CRACK!
The force was heavy as reality shattered like mirrors, Noah's main body and the forming clones being hit with an undeniable existential force as they all smashed back like comets.
BOOM!

His main body was smashed through a gorgeous golden Plane of Existence as the force was enough to cause its weavings to turn unstable, the cosmos within it fracturing before the Plane of Existence imploded into a blaze of heat.
It was a Mimeisthai, yes.
It only mimicked, yes.
But its force...was truly undeniable as it moved like a killing machine!

chapters.title: Chapter 2932 Mimeisthai! II
paragraphs: Noah had only just arrived in the Ninth Gradation of Extremity as whatever shocking means were utilized to forge this Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai, it was made out to be something almost exceeding the Dikastes of Extremity.
Even though it radiated an oppressive air at the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, it truly seemed far away from this stage!
This was the result that the Codex of Extremity produced- judging that this would be enough to take care of the problem that had risen to stop its procedural task in completing successfully.
Based on the weavings of Noah in the past day.
Thinking of this, even though his extremes were raging, Noah smiled.
Something was created to contend against him based on his own strength...in the past day.
It was powerful, yes.
But the basis of its creation was also the biggest limitation.
Noah never stayed in one place. His power never stalled in one area for too long!
And currently, his extremes were billowing with fervor even in the face of all of this power as while surrounded by the heat of a shattered plane of existence, Noah rose unharmed while voicing out.
"Just how much authority from the Fruits of Existence did they pump into you?"
His words came along with a radiance of blue as all of his other bodies lined up alongside him.
Thousands of them.
He didn't have to gaze far as akin to one Mimeisthai becoming a legion of thousands, rows of copies of this shocking creature gazed back at him coldly as it was not one for conversation!
But Noah's words remained true and utterly critical.
The number of Fruits of Existence utilized to bring to fruition this Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai before him had to be entirely unfathomable as for Noah, this held a Quintessential meaning!
In the last day, he had taken the authority of Fruits of Existence flowing within millions of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts and turned it into his own Fruits of Existence.
This was something he shouldn't have even been capable of doing, but a single extreme extracted everything and made it possible.
And this single extreme was the key to making Noah's further advancement even more disastrous for his enemies.
An extreme to increase the quantity of The Fruits of Existence he received.
An extreme to inflate the quality of Fruits of Existence he received!

An extreme that would make it so whatever cost went into utilizing the Codex of Extremity to make this current reality possible...Noah's returns from overcoming its challenges would be many times that.
So even though Relativity stepped up and stated its resolve.
Even though Apocalypse was ready to advance.
Noah glared at the thousands of copies of the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai and this being itself in question as his intent weaved out.
'Rise above...Loot.'
His thoughts affirmed it.
And his will carried it out.
HUUM!
His existence buzzed as within the expanded breadth of his soul, a new flower bloomed.
A blazing, fiery, golden light radiating blistering and nonsensical might bloomed as for the first time ever, the Extremity of Loot began to shine with an Existential light.
Its fiery gold light was different from the Aurum gold glow of the Protagonist, with its hue seeming more transient and bright as it could best be described as...a gilded glow of wonder!
It spread out from Noah in this instant of time where he was doing a great deal of things as if he were stuck in time, with a blaze of prompts cascading soon after!
{The Protagonist welcomes the new entrants with interminable splendor.}
{The Extremity of Loot nods in recognition and burns with an existential light, calling upon Quintessence, the Protagonist, and Plagiarism!}

Loot called upon two other Existential Extremity Authorities and uniquely, Plagiarism was added into the picture as just like when the Protagonist first came to be, it wanted to showcase its authority with a bang!
{Under the lead of the budding Existential Extremity Authority of Loot, the feature of Existential Analytical Looter is being forged.}
Existential Analytical Looter.
The moment this feature came to be, Noah felt his existence set aflame as his distinction as the Weaver of Extremity heavily and with shocking fervor flowed into it.
{The capabilities of the Weaver of Extremity flood into the Existential Analytical Looter.}
{The Extremity of Plagiarism becomes deeply entrenched into the budding feature!}
{The Extremity of Cheats watches on carefully with support and encouragement.}
Noah felt multiple rising Authorities within his existence come together and culminate into something fantastical, his eyes becoming glazed with a gilded light as he looked ahead at his enemy.
{Existential Analytical Looter has been activated for the first time.}
{The selected target is the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai.}

Under the glow of the gilded light, Noah saw a flash of brilliance only he could observe as the massive figure of the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai...had everything about its weaving seemingly scanned and analyzed as to its right, a golden illusory hologram representing it appeared.
On his illusory hologram, there were multiple points where golden lights were emphasized- on its wings or tails, or even the joints making up its body!
Noah didn't fully grasp their intricacies until the flow of information began to burn with his mind.
{The Weaving of the makeup of Existence of the target has been analyzed under the feature of Existential Analytical Looter.}
{The structural makeup and source of the target can potentially be plagiarized and recreated.}
{The weaving of the extremes, records, and existence of the target can potentially be looted and recreated.}

{When impacting the highlighted areas of the selected target, a greater concentration of Loot based on the source of the target can be obtained. Currently established concentrations are 200% increased loot quantity and quality.}
A shocking advent of a new feature came to be as under it, Noah's eyes shone with an unstoppable golden light as he could see everything about his enemy.
He could see everything as through it...he could attain everything!
And what he was currently experiencing...was only an initial glimpse!

This was the result that the Codex of Extremity produced- judging that this would be enough to take care of the problem that had risen to stop its procedural task in completing successfully.
Based on the weavings of Noah in the past day.
Thinking of this, even though his extremes were raging, Noah smiled.
Something was created to contend against him based on his own strength...in the past day.
It was powerful, yes.
But the basis of its creation was also the biggest limitation.
Noah never stayed in one place.
His power never stalled in one area for too long!
And currently, his extremes were billowing with fervor even in the face of all of this power as while surrounded by the heat of a shattered plane of existence, Noah rose unharmed while voicing out.
"Just how much authority from the Fruits of Existence did they pump into you?"
His words came along with a radiance of blue as all of his other bodies lined up alongside him.
Thousands of them.
He didn't have to gaze far as akin to one Mimeisthai becoming a legion of thousands, rows of copies of this shocking creature gazed back at him coldly as it was not one for conversation!
But Noah's words remained true and utterly critical.
The number of Fruits of Existence utilized to bring to fruition this Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai before him had to be entirely unfathomable as for Noah, this held a Quintessential meaning!
In the last day, he had taken the authority of Fruits of Existence flowing within millions of Existential Apokalypsis Beasts and turned it into his own Fruits of Existence.
This was something he shouldn't have even been capable of doing, but a single extreme extracted everything and made it possible.
And this single extreme was the key to making Noah's further advancement even more disastrous for his enemies.
An extreme to increase the quantity of The Fruits of Existence he received.
An extreme to inflate the quality of Fruits of Existence he received!

An extreme that would make it so whatever cost went into utilizing the Codex of Extremity to make this current reality possible...Noah's returns from overcoming its challenges would be many times that.
So even though Relativity stepped up and stated its resolve.
Even though Apocalypse was ready to advance.
Noah glared at the thousands of copies of the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai and this being itself in question as his intent weaved out.
'Rise above...Loot.'
His thoughts affirmed it.
And his will carried it out.
HUUM!
His existence buzzed as within the expanded breadth of his soul, a new flower bloomed.
A blazing, fiery, golden light radiating blistering and nonsensical might bloomed as for the first time ever, the Extremity of Loot began to shine with an Existential light.
Its fiery gold light was different from the Aurum gold glow of the Protagonist, with its hue seeming more transient and bright as it could best be described as...a gilded glow of wonder!
It spread out from Noah in this instant of time where he was doing a great deal of things as if he were stuck in time, with a blaze of prompts cascading soon after!
{The Protagonist welcomes the new entrants with interminable splendor.}
{The Extremity of Loot nods in recognition and burns with an existential light, calling upon Quintessence, the Protagonist, and Plagiarism!}

Loot called upon two other Existential Extremity Authorities and uniquely, Plagiarism was added into the picture as just like when the Protagonist first came to be, it wanted to showcase its authority with a bang!
{Under the lead of the budding Existential Extremity Authority of Loot, the feature of Existential Analytical Looter is being forged.}
Existential Analytical Looter.
The moment this feature came to be, Noah felt his existence set aflame as his distinction as the Weaver of Extremity heavily and with shocking fervor flowed into it.
{The capabilities of the Weaver of Extremity flood into the Existential Analytical Looter.}
{The Extremity of Plagiarism becomes deeply entrenched into the budding feature!}
{The Extremity of Cheats watches on carefully with support and encouragement.}
Noah felt multiple rising Authorities within his existence come together and culminate into something fantastical, his eyes becoming glazed with a gilded light as he looked ahead at his enemy.
{Existential Analytical Looter has been activated for the first time.}
{The selected target is the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai.}

Under the glow of the gilded light, Noah saw a flash of brilliance only he could observe as the massive figure of the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai...had everything about its weaving seemingly scanned and analyzed as to its right, a golden illusory hologram representing it appeared.
On his illusory hologram, there were multiple points where golden lights were emphasized- on its wings or tails, or even the joints making up its body!
Noah didn't fully grasp their intricacies until the flow of information began to burn with his mind.
{The Weaving of the makeup of Existence of the target has been analyzed under the feature of Existential Analytical Looter.}
{The structural makeup and source of the target can potentially be plagiarized and recreated.}
{The weaving of the extremes, records, and existence of the target can potentially be looted and recreated.}
{When impacting the highlighted areas of the selected target, a greater concentration of Loot based on the source of the target can be obtained.
Currently established concentrations are 200% increased loot quantity and quality.}
A shocking advent of a new feature came to be as under it, Noah's eyes shone with an unstoppable golden light as he could see everything about his enemy.
He could see everything as through it...he could attain everything!
And what he was currently experiencing...was only an initial glimpse!

chapters.title: Chapter 2933 Mimeisthai! III
paragraphs: Existential Analytical Looter unfolded in a grand fashion as the Existential Extremity Authority of Loot showed itself off in such a fashion.
Besides the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai, the golden illusory hologram that was created after the activation of this ability was something that Noah was learning about in real time.

The prompts first made it clear that the weavings, records, and the extremes of the analyzed records could be recreated, and if Noah focused on the highlighted areas in the joints, wings, and areas on the nine tails of this beast- the amount of loot he could attain was insurmountable!
So he got ready to move.
But...Loot was not done.
{The analysis of the weavings of the target is 10% processed as a link has been formed from the Existential Illusory Weaving to the actual target.}

{Through Existential Extremity Authorities, you can target the highlighted areas on the Existential Illusory Weaving of the target as in return, you can deal 10% of the maximum damage dealt towards the actual target.}
'What?'
Noah's eyes opened wide as he reread the last prompt to make sure he grasped it correctly.
And it remained blazing just like so.
It created a progression of events that were so nonsensical that even he doubted them!
First, a golden illusory hologram was created by Existential Analytical Looter as this told Noah of the weaknesses and areas to capitalize on for his selected target.
Or so Noah thought.
But he could go even further as attacking this illusory hologram that was known as an Existential Illusory Weaving, he could actually deal damage to the original target!
It was the weaving of Loot, Plagiarism, Quintessence, and the Protagonist.

And it was so incredulous that in this instant where the terrifying beast was already moving towards Noah with all of its clones, the golden Existential Illusory Weaving of the Mimeisthai was brought in front of Noah, and instead of attacking the Mimeisthai a distance away...
HUUM!
Noah's fist struck out towards one of the brightest highlighted areas on the Existential Illusory Weaving.
Between the two eyes of the Mimeisthai who held his devilishly handsome features.
His first carried behind it the momentum of an endless sea of Infinity- the swirling of millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures.

And then in addition to all of this, just like when he took the weight of his existence itself to crush millions of Apokalypsis Beasts, he also allowed the weight of his existence to flow to his fist as he struck the golden illusion only he could see straight on.
To others, it may seem like he was only striking out in an empty space.
And yet...
BOOM!
Out of nowhere, the Mimeisthai received an impact of an astounding force as a small crack bloomed in its forehead!
The original Mimeisthai. The real Mimeisthai!
Noah had attacked a hologram of it, and yet he affected the real thing as this incredulous reality was spurred on by Loot!
The mechanism of this concept was so ethereal that after Noah struck his target in a way where it couldn't even retaliate or counter against him...
{An Area of Weakness has been impacted on the selected target.}
{The Existential Extremity Authority of Loot imposed itself.}

On the small crack that appeared on the forehead of the Mimeisthai, a golden light gushed from it before this creature blazed with white flames that extinguished everything, along with healing the recently appearing crack.
But the action had already been taken.
{Loot has extracted from the very Source of the affected target.}
{The obtained loot is further elevated in quantity and quality.}

When Noah killed millions of Apokalypsis Beasts, he was given Fragments that made up the Fruits of Existence. What exactly would he receive now as he stole the source of his enemy even before it died?
{You have attained 1x Quintessential Fruit of Existence.}
{A Quintessential Achievement has been recorded down in the weavings of your existence!}
{The weavings of your Extremes has ushered forth an elevated version of the Fruit of Existence that is already not properly understood!}
A reality that was enough to leave one speechless unfolded, Noah's will sensing a new loot appearing within him.
Larger than normal Fruits of Existence. Brighter. And in addition to the translucent glow, tendrils of gold flowed within it.
It was the first appearance of the Quintessential Fruit of Existence.
And before Noah could delve too deeply into it...
|WUU!|
The Mimeisthai bellowed out as if it felt the subtle changes and the actions of Loot, its hands rising up before crashing down as it carried with it an authority of denial.
An authority seeking to mimic...Quintessence itself!
When Quintessence expressed its embodiment, no others could even utilize their authorities unless they were Quintessential.
The Mimeisthai actually sought to mimic such a feature as at such a bold and blasphemous action...
{Daring!}
Noah's hands moved rapidly.
The hands of the thousands of clones behind him moved rapidly.

The image of the Existential Illusory Weaving of the Mimeisthai was in front of all of them as with the weight of all of his existence, with the weight of all of his clones brought about by Infinity, and a surge of maddening Quintessence that was staring at the face of a blasphemous action...a flurry of catastrophic and apocalyptic hits landed on golden lit up areas of a figure that only Noah could see!
The Existential Illusory Weaving of the Mimeisthai received a Quintessential beat down from thousands of Noah's figures.
And the result was a profound one as opposite them, the main body and the clones of the Mimeisthai trembled, indentations, cavitations, and cracks occurring across various parts of their bodies!
Their tails became twisted. Their wings became shredded.
And a vibrant gilded light of Loot came to cover them as they lost major parts of their existence!
This was a new form of warfare.
The target itself wasn't even attacked as the Extremity of Quintessence attacked an empty space before him, and yet heavy damage was expressed against his enemy!

chapters.title: Chapter 2934 Mimeisthai! IV
paragraphs: {Multiple Areas of Weakness have been impacted on the selected target.}
{The Existential Extremity Authority of Loot has imposed itself!}
Dazzling prompts flowed before Noah's eyes as the momentum of the Mimeisthai was broken off, with its budding authority finally pushed back!
The brilliance of dazzling white flames within its eyes had dimmed down somewhat as Noah had stolen off a great deal of its very existence, and Noah knew this because...
{You have attained 33x Quintessential Fruits of Existence!}
{You have attained 47x Quintessential Fruits of Existence!}
{You have attained 104x Quintessential Fruits of Existence!}
Golden words in blue borders rose and told him so.
His existence felt the dazzling translucent fruits filled with tendrils of gold light flow within him!
And to make things even more obscene...

{The analysis of the weavings of the target has increased to 25%. From this point onwards, 25% of the maximum damage dealt to the Existential Illusory Weaving will now be dealt to the actual target. Furthermore, through increased understanding of the target, you can now mitigate 12.5% of any authority they throw towards you.}
The brilliance of the Existential Analytical Looter only showed itself more as Noah raised his head with a blare of profound tyranny.
{You dare to try and imitate Quintessence?}
HUUM!
{You dare and try to express Tyranny?!}
Dazzling purple thrones appeared on Noah's visage and all the clones around him.
The weight of his existence became focused on his hands as with the weight of the extremes behind him as well, Noah's struck out towards the illusory golden hologram only he could see.
BOOOM!
The Mimeisthai and its copies enclosed their limbs and wings in defensive positions even though they didn't grasp how Noah's attacks were reaching when he wasn't even near them.
They burned with the weight of their own existence as they sought to defend!
But...
CRACK!
With more damage expressed against the Mimeisthai after being analyzed even more, the strikes that caused cavitations on its body now caused fissures and cracks to spread across its limbs.
The pairs of wings were told as the nine tails became shredded and bled white blood!

This beast that was dominating the battle initially and pushing Noah back with every strike found itself in the same position currently, and the damage to its existence was significant as just like it...Noah did not stop.
He continued to attack and apply the weight of his existence and extremes on the hologram only he could see.
His visage looked like a maddened emperor who was dishing out constant and endless judgment onto an existence that blasphemed their authority!
Rows and rows of prompts cascaded one after another due to his actions.
{You have attained 88x Quintessential Fruits of Existence!}
{You have attained 66x Quintessential Fruits of Existence!}

{The analysis of the weavings of the target has increased to 50%. From this point onwards, 50% of the maximum damage dealt to the Existential Illusory Weaving will now be dealt to the actual target. Furthermore, through an increased understanding of the target, you can now mitigate 25% of any authority they throw towards you.}
{Existential Analytical Looter has reached a critical threshold on the selected target.}
{By burning a tremendous amount of Existential Extremity Authority, a version of the weavings of the target can be plagiarized into existence momentarily.}
{Carrying 50% of the weavings of Existence of the target, the Existential Illusory Weaving V2 can now be formed.}
Existential Analytical Looter just did not stop.
Even more of its boons were unveiling itself in real time as Noah's eyes shone brightly, his chest expanding as he breathed in billowing authority before he called out valiantly.
{Existential Illusory Weaving...V2!}
HUUM!
From the Existential Illusory Weaving that only he could see.
From this golden illusory hologram that he had been attacking!
A blazing golden light flashed over it as a second hologram very quickly formed, but this one...began to turn very real and very solid.
Taking the shape of the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai with Noah's likeness, an entity with golden skin and tendons of muscles running through it appeared before the eyes of all.

Its eyes were cold and emotionless as it came to stand beside Noah, the Extremity of Quintessence not even gazing at it as while looking at the injured visage of the Apokalypsis Mimeisthai, he placed his hands on the head of the Existential Illusory Weaving V2 and spoke succinctly.
{You like playing the game of a copycat.}
{So relish this.}
WAA!

With a flicker of his hand, the Existential Illusory Weaving V2 of the Mimeisthai that he now controlled surged out like a missile- a white gold light surrounding it as hundreds of clones very quickly began to manifest around it!
It covered the sight of the actual Mimeisthai that was recovering with burning white flames around it, and while the Mimeisthai was occupied with a golden white foot of itself surging towards it...
{Ho!}
The Extremity of Quintessence resumed his relentless attacks on the hologram of the Existential Illusory Weaving only he could see as his purpose was none other than complete destruction!
This was the unfolding reality within the Supernal Haven of Helios as the Extremity of Quintessence faced the shocking opposition of the Codex of Extremity.
Away from here, there was still a critical scene playing out with the defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as for the first time, they faced enemies that may have actually outclassed them!
For them, simply reacting towards the movements of their Mimeisthai was a challenge as so far, they were only reactive.
BOOM!

Heavy impacts were booming all around as Mimeisthais with the likeness of many prominent Defenders running rampant, with none being more deadly than the ones mimicking the Queens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
At this moment...
SAA!
A heavily breathing Lilith pulled her head back in the last moments from the sharp tip of a pulsing white spear that a Mimeisthai that looked like Athena wielded.
On her head, one of her horns slid off as she barely managed to keep her head intact, this Mimeisthai making another move as a spear was already in front of her face again!
{Fuck!}

A curse came beside her as a flurry of talismans unfolded to block the spear, the Cimmerian Architect appearing to reinforce as at this moment, many others were grouping up and standing together to face these terrifying foes!
Yet even in the face of all of this...
Many rose their wills towards the space above as at this moment, a Mimeisthai with the resemblance of Adelaide appeared above.
Behind her, a blizzard of Vitalis with glacial waves surging endlessly barraged down- as if it were seeking to place the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven into an ice age!

chapters.title: Chapter 2935 Ludicrous! I
paragraphs: Glacial waves of Vitalis cascaded down like an endless sea- freezing everything in their path as in the distance, even the Son of Destiny was pushed back as he opposed a Mimeisthai who looked like him!

The glacial light was restrictive and wrapped around one's existence like chains that would freeze their souls entirely, and it carried a mimicked sense of Quintessence that made it hard for others to even react.
So the surging glacial sea barreled down.
The gazes of many flickered brightly as someone had to step up, their bodies already lighting up with existential lights as at such a dire time...
The voice of an ancient being rose with a mere whisper as the visage of none other than the Primogenitor of Steel stepped forward.
His burly figure held defined and aged muscles that showed his eons of work as a blacksmith. His bronze silver skin radiated age and vicissitude as in front of his eyes, waves of prompts were rising.
{Your Fable is a long one that has been etched across Existential Domains.}
{You now join the weavings of a being who could elevate your Fable to be etched into your own Existence- and for your Fable to resonate across even vaster domains.}
{Your Fable empowers you as one of the most distinguished entities in Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.}
The Primogenitor of Steel saw these prompts as in the distance, the drums of the Bard of Quintessence became high paced.
TU! TU! TU!
As if they were about to bear witness to something grand.
Many wills resonated as with a profound light, the Primogenitor of Steel spread his arms out as...his body exploded into a dazzling sea of silver and bronze.
A sea pulsing with Quintessence.
A sea carrying a long and accomplished Fable.

This Sea went on to clash with the glacial waves of Vitalis and only expanded as if one looked closely within it, they would be capable of seeing that its waters were made up of countless small Armaments!
BOOM!

The impact was resounding as the counter attack of the Primogenitor of Steel acted like a trigger, the others striking back at this time as they sought for a way to handle this ordeal themselves...without having to rely on the being whose concepts already made their stand possible!
At the same time as this occurred.
At the same time as Fables empowered all of their unfolding Legends.
The glimmer of a gilded light began to buzz within their bodies as the weavings of Loot began to descend.
The weavings of Loot and the ridiculous capabilities only Noah had played with so far began to unfold, and even Noah himself...had not seen the last of these capabilities!

Away from the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and within the chaotic Supernal Haven of Helios where a shocking battle was underway, Noah didn't let up his relentless attacks on the hologram of the Existential Illusory Weaving- his very existence pounding on the highlighted areas over and over again as all damage was reflected by as much as 50% at this moment.

And the Mimeisthai itself couldn't take a step forward as after {Existential Analytical Looter} called forth the Illusory Weaving V2, its sight was covered by this construct from Noah that also displayed 50% of its power!

This created for a shocking reality where the Mimeisthai was the only one currently being pushed back, and they couldn't even retaliate as the moment Noah's flurry of attacks ended was when its whole existence would finish being devoured.
The Mimeisthai seemed to know this as at such a juncture, ite apathetic eyes flared coldly towards the distant Noah that wasn't even looking towards it.
And the Vitalis within its eyes brightened immensely.
The whiteness around it turned into an aurora of lights even as more and more of its body fissured and cracked.
As if at any moment, the existence of this Mimeisthai would be wiped out!
Yet at such a moment...
HOONG!
A beam of dazzling white light crashed across the space above as it tore open the Supernal Haven of Helios, shattering multiple Planes of Existence on its path as it came to land on the Mimeisthai.
And thereafter, as if a nuclear blast of white light was expanding outwards, all weavings of existence, records, and extremes were pushed back while reality shattered into countless fragments!
BOOM!
The figure of the Illusory Weaving V2 was pushed back, along with Noah's own visage in the distance.
Amidst the shattering reality, Noah waved his hands to stabilize everything as when the scene became clear...
A brilliant yet terrific reality was displayed far ahead.
The Mimeisthai that should have been in its death throes...radiated an even more radiant light than before.
As if it had undergone a rebirth.
As if it had passed through Nirvana!
Four pairs of bright white wings now stood behind it.
12 tails now danced like spears of planes of existence that could pierce anything!
And the likeness of Noah only became more magnified as its size reduced and became more compact!
This beast had actually undergone a transformation before it was entirely wiped out and came back stronger than ever, seemingly about to make this fight into an extremely heavy and long one.
But would the Extremity of Loot really allow this?

{The analysis of the weavings of the target has increased to 75%. From this point onwards, 75% of the maximum damage dealt to the Existential Illusory Weaving will now be dealt to the actual target. Furthermore, through increased understanding of the target, you can now mitigate 37.5% of any authority they throw towards you.}
{Carrying 75% of the weavings of Existence of the target, the Existential Illusory Weaving V2 can now be empowered.}
The Weavings of Loot had only just continued to work in the background as an even greater percentage of the enemy was analyzed!

And with this analysis, Noah could freely attack a hologram that only had to stand there and take it before reflecting the damage to the main body, so even though the Mimeisthai just underwent a form of Nirvana and thought it was about to come back even stronger than ever to end things...
"Ruination."

chapters.title: Chapter 2936 Ludicrous! II
paragraphs: Ruination!
The Extremity of Quintessence called out to Ruination.

He was about to entirely disappoint this creature in its belief that it was back stronger than ever to turn the tides of this fight as he called out to a treasure that truly didn't even fit the bounds of High Grade Armaments.
And his hands blared forth with an incandescent crimson gold light as he grasped something so bright that its form couldn't be clearly ascertained.
With a slight dimming, one may be able to make the outline of a dazzling sword hilt.
With another passing instant, they may be able to observe the immeasurably sharp golden blade edge.
But one couldn't really say for sure.
All one could say was that the Extremity of Quintessence grasped tightly onto Ruination, and he then proceeded to begin layering his existence onto the sword he held within his hands.
Ruination had also devoured Fruits of Existence as she held her own heaviness.
She held her own sharpness!
When layered with the weight of the Extremity of Quintessence himself, the Existential damage output was bound to be unfathomable!
And the Mimeisthai seemed to sense this as it bellowed out like a horn announcing the end, tens of thousands of clones appearing around it as it tore across spacetime.

The Illusory Weaving V2 appeared before it as before it could even make a move, the Mimeisthai already appeared before it and grabbed its head with both hands- twisting in an unnatural manner as its momentum was heavy!
At such a moment...
The glimmering tendrils of golden Loot spread out in the surroundings flickered into life.
{The Weavings of Loot have applied Existential Analytical Looter to the surrounding reality.}
{The light of Loot has already spread out to cover a tenth of the Supernal Haven of Helios.}
{The analysis of the surrounding space has reached 100%, allowing for the complete Existential Manipulation of this defined domain.}
Under Noah's eyes.

He saw golden borders stretching out many light years away as they formed into a circle to demarcate a tenth of the Supernal Haven of Helios that ludicrously, Loot had spread out to, covered, and analyzed 100%.

It then stated that Noah had complete Existential Manipulation over this entirely analyzed space as in the next moment, a hologram of this vast space was superimposed, and Noah's mind buzzed with instinct as he moved naturally!
His will saw the countless lines and waves that constructed a hologram of this domain, and his will tugged upon these lines as they moved simply.
They moved and converged towards the barreling figure of the Mimeisthai and its many clones- as if the weavings that made the entire enclosed domain were wrapping around them!
And wondrously, it really was so as in the next moment, the weavings of existence itself around this domain of Helios turned utterly nutty.
Reality tested and distorted, converging towards the figure of the Mimeisthai and thousands of its clones as they found themselves becoming bound and restricted in space!
As if the very Haven they were on denied them and their movements!
The Mimeisthai and its forces became bound and slowed down.
The twisted head of the Illusory Weaving V2 bellowed out and radiated intense white gold light!
And Noah gained the time to freely and without worries...direct Ruination in his hands towards the vibrant hologram of the Existential Illusory Weaving That only he could see.
{Quintessence imposes its undeniability.}
His extremes burned with righteous splendor as they sought to utterly wipe out the entity that had been seeking to imitate them.
{Infinity radiated endless judgment.}
Behind Noah, the illusion of an endless blue sea appeared in a mesmerizing fashion- all of this Sea placing its weight behind him.

And above the tumultuous waves of this Sea, a dazzling purple throne of immense tyranny materialized, the visage of an entity adorned in a golden robe sitting atop it as he gave off the feeling of someone central.
Someone critical.
Someone integral to the weaving of reality as it was none other than the Protagonist!
All of them added their weight onto the small figure of Noah as their weavings expressed their undeniable desire!
They all flowed through Noah's figure as the blazing radiance of Ruination became even more resplendent, and Noah struck out towards the illusory hologram only he could see at this moment.
An interminable silence was the only thing that could be heard.
In front of Noah, thousands of iridescent crimson gold light bloomed.
They carried the weight of his existence.
They carried the weavings of his extremes.
They carried the weight of his records.
And they all surged towards the visage of an enemy only he could see- to strike the weakest points only he could see.
The impact...was a silent one.
The dazzling waves of swords seemingly sank into the empty space of their target and disappeared.
The weavings of reality were quiet as Noah then retracted his sword, with Ruination entirely disappearing within his hands a moments later.
The Illusory Weaving V2 that he enacted still stood inches away from the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai and its clones, yet its eyes showed immersible defiance and tyranny!
The light within the eyes of the Mimeisthai before it were radiant, and yet it stood still.
The clones behind it were radiant, and yet they stood still.
Space fluctuated as shockingly, it was under the complete control of the Extremity of Loot after being analyzed.
A moment after, the space before the Mimeisthai twisted to show the visage of Noah.
A potent golden glow covered him and his Emperor's robes, but his devilishly handsome face was clear to all.
His eyes holding nine pupils radiated calmness and certainty as he came right in front of the weapon of the Codex of Extremity for the second day of Mors Apokalypsis!
The Mimeisthai looked at him.
And he looked back at the Mimeisthai as he felt like he was staring at something far grander behind it.
Yet his voice was filled with Quintessential tyranny as he spoke.
"I better not see you trying to imitate again tomorrow. I may just do everything in my power to follow the weavings of the Apokalypsis Beasts and rip you to shreds myself."
His words were addressed to the Mimeisthai before him, but he knew they were reaching something even more stupendous behind it!
The Mimeisthai didn't reply as it silently gazed at him.
The blinding radiance within its eyes...then rapidly began to deteriorate as across its body, countless cuts bloomed!
Its brilliance began to dwindle like a dying flame as the single attack thrown out by Noah at the end utterly finished everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 2937 Obscene! I
paragraphs: A single attack ended everything!
The two were standing before each other face to face, and yet both sides knew one had their existence erased and extracted entirely.
Yet the glare within the eyes of the Mimeisthai- or really the source that lay behind it...continued to stare at Noah with immeasurable scrutiny!
As the light within the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai faded, the thousands of clones behind it that formed a small legion followed.
The Mimeisthai had its body instantly shredded by immeasurable lacerations- each gap becoming filled with the golden light of Loot as the victor of this whole ordeal...
His vision was covered by an immense eruption of prompts.
{You have attained 888x Quintessential Fruits of Existence!}
{You have attained 739x Quintessential Fruits of Existence!}
{You have attained 799x Quintessential Fruits of Existence...!}
{The analysis of the weavings of the target has increased to 100%.}
{The target of Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai had been entirely analyzed and its weavings were eradicated in the process.}
{Existential Analytical Looter radiates brightness as the Extremity of Loot states that even in existential eradication, one cannot escape it.}
{The Existential Illusory Weaving and the Existential Illusory Weaving V2 of the Mimeisthai can now be superimposed to construct the Existential Illusory Weaving V3.}
Noah's eyes radiated immense splendor.

He gazed back at the illusory golden hologram that he had been attacking this whole time, his will observing as this hologram only he could see floated and superimposed itself on the Existential Illusory Weaving V2 that was standing right in front of him!
And...
HUUM!
The weavings of Existence trembled.
A blazing aura filled with maddened might rose and fell as before Noah's eyes, a construct faded in and out of existence!
{The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Mimeisthai, is coming to fruition.}

{It is something only observable under your eyes, with the weavings of its Records, Existence, and Extremes mimicking the Original Mimeisthai, with the only alteration being the composition of its Extremes.}
An utterly unreal reality unfolded.
An obscene happening was being carried out under Noah's extremes!
With the likeness of Noah, a body with steel like muscular tendons, four pairs of wings and twelve tails...a terrifying entity was born as its visage pulsed with a golden purple light.
The aura it emanated was madly at the Ninth Gradation of Extremity- and oppressively so as it didn't seem to just be at this stage!
{The Extremity of Cheats releases a belly full of laughter at such a ridiculous reality!}
{The Extremity of Plot watches with fascination.}
{The Extremity of Fables shines ever brighter, adding a new and unfathomable Legend to itself.}
Even Noah's own Concepts were left baffled at what was currently unfolding!

The Extremity of Loot truly imposed itself, showing the ultimate forms of Loot as even after droves of treasures were extracted from the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai, the ultimate loot obtained thereafter was this feature itself!

The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Mimeisthai, burning with a light of Loot and Tyranny outwardly, along with Quintessence, Infinity, and the very essence of the Protagonist within it...such a being appeared and kneeled towards Noah at this moment.
Ethereal.
Not visible to others.
A killing machine under his orders and bidding formed as the ultimate prize of the Extremity of Loot- this extreme's rise to the Existential level truly defining itself and leaving others in awe!
Noah looked at the muscular appearance of the Mimeisthai with calm eyes as he voiced out to it calmly.
"Go observe over the Infinite Hyperversal Haven. Let them forge their own Fables, but if necessary...step in."
HUUM!
With a glimmer of silent brilliance, the first Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Mimeisthai, disappeared.

Noah's eyes were deep as he remained alone in this region of the Supernal Haven of Helios, gazing at the crimson gold hues of this region...as well as the illusory holographic lines layered on top of them that allowed him to hold the Original Mimeisthai down with the force of this Haven itself!
Existential Manipulation through none other than the Existential Analytical Looter itself.
And as if it wanted to express that it was still very much prevalent...
{The Existential Analytical Looter is spreading its analysis further within the Supernal Haven of Helios.}
{The fully mapped and analyzed areas can have the weavings of their very existence drained and devoured by Loot, leaving nothing behind.}
{Another pathway opened after complete analysis is the accelerated devouring by Existential Dungeon Apocalypse, requiring only two Dungeon Monoliths to devour the entirety of an analyzed Haven.}
The means of the Existential Analytical Looter were too many as even after analyzing a Haven, they gave Noah two possibilities!
And he looked at their words calmly before already coming to a decision, his hands beckoning above as the skies began to split and stretch.
And from above...
HUUM!
Two massive pillars of monoliths began to descend while all around him, the light of Loot continued its analysis.
He wasn't alone in all this as he couldn't devour everything himself.

The Infinite Hyperversal Haven was an indispensable tool that would need to devour as much of these Existential Domains as it could, with Noah very expectant on the results of all of this as the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...had never let him down in what it could do.
His utility for it only increased since he attained it as a floating Spiritual Land, and he now waited for it to give him the natural production of Fruits of Existence!
His eyes flickered with brilliance when he came across this thought as he waved his hands, a dazzling light blooming in his palm.
It held a translucent glow, and it actually contained mesmerizing tendrils of gold within it as it was very much a modified version of a normal Fruit of Existence.
And under Noah, it held the moniker of Quintessential.
He hasn't fully uncovered what a normal Fruit of Existence granted, and he now grasped an elevated one. The only way to understand it...was to of course, devour it!
With a glimmer of brilliance, the Quintessential Fruit of Existence entered his jaws as an explosion of light unfolded.

Even Noah's own Concepts were left baffled at what was currently unfolding!

The Extremity of Loot truly imposed itself, showing the ultimate forms of Loot as even after droves of treasures were extracted from the Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai, the ultimate loot obtained thereafter was this feature itself!

The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Mimeisthai, burning with a light of Loot and Tyranny outwardly, along with Quintessence, Infinity, and the very essence of the Protagonist within it...such a being appeared and kneeled towards Noah at this moment.
Ethereal.
Not visible to others.
A killing machine under his orders and bidding formed as the ultimate prize of the Extremity of Loot- this extreme's rise to the Existential level truly defining itself and leaving others in awe!
Noah looked at the muscular appearance of the Mimeisthai with calm eyes as he voiced out to it calmly.
"Go observe over the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Let them forge their own Fables, but if necessary...step in."
HUUM!
With a glimmer of silent brilliance, the first Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Mimeisthai, disappeared.

Noah's eyes were deep as he remained alone in this region of the Supernal Haven of Helios, gazing at the crimson gold hues of this region...as well as the illusory holographic lines layered on top of them that allowed him to hold the Original Mimeisthai down with the force of this Haven itself!
Existential Manipulation through none other than the Existential Analytical Looter itself.
And as if it wanted to express that it was still very much prevalent...
{The Existential Analytical Looter is spreading its analysis further within the Supernal Haven of Helios.}
{The fully mapped and analyzed areas can have the weavings of their very existence drained and devoured by Loot, leaving nothing behind.}
{Another pathway opened after complete analysis is the accelerated devouring by Existential Dungeon Apocalypse, requiring only two Dungeon Monoliths to devour the entirety of an analyzed Haven.}
The means of the Existential Analytical Looter were too many as even after analyzing a Haven, they gave Noah two possibilities!
And he looked at their words calmly before already coming to a decision, his hands beckoning above as the skies began to split and stretch.
And from above...
HUUM!
Two massive pillars of monoliths began to descend while all around him, the light of Loot continued its analysis.
He wasn't alone in all this as he couldn't devour everything himself.

The Infinite Hyperversal Haven was an indispensable tool that would need to devour as much of these Existential Domains as it could, with Noah very expectant on the results of all of this as the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...had never let him down in what it could do.
His utility for it only increased since he attained it as a floating Spiritual Land, and he now waited for it to give him the natural production of Fruits of Existence!
His eyes flickered with brilliance when he came across this thought as he waved his hands, a dazzling light blooming in his palm.
It held a translucent glow, and it actually contained mesmerizing tendrils of gold within it as it was very much a modified version of a normal Fruit of Existence.
And under Noah, it held the moniker of Quintessential.
He hasn't fully uncovered what a normal Fruit of Existence granted, and he now grasped an elevated one.
The only way to understand it...was to of course, devour it!
With a glimmer of brilliance, the Quintessential Fruit of Existence entered his jaws as an explosion of light unfolded.

chapters.title: Chapter 2938 Obscene! II
paragraphs: Resplendence was unfolding within the existence of the Extremity of Quintessence.
While this occurred, his newest construct to form made its way and arrived in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
It bore witness to the heavy battle here as even though the main Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai was defeated by Noah, the lesser ones mimicking his people didn't stop!
But the light within their eyes changed.

As if they knew that all of the second day of Mors Apokalypsis was for naught, but they continued regardless as they seemed to be gathering information on the weaving of the Extremes that Noah's people displayed- the weavings of their records and existence!
As if even though they couldn't obtain much from Noah himself, they may be able to obtain something more from his people.
Unseen by any other beings, the Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Mimeisthai, floated grandly above the battlefield.
Neither Noah's people nor the Lesser Mimeisthais could even see it!
Its gaze pressed down in observance to accomplish its mission as 3 seconds after its arrival...
It honed in on a certain area.
It could read the flow of existence and extremes easily as it saw the main reason why Noah's people were struggling so much against the Lesser Mimeisthais.
For many of them, their Existence did not carry as much weight as their enemies moved so fast in their eyes- to the extent they were having a hard time reacting against them!

And such a reality played out now as a Lesser Mimeisthai with the likeness of the Emperor Penguin passed between Svetlana and the Extremity of Foundation, its flipper filled with deadly white light striking down towards a group that consisted of Seer of Sima, Erikson, Ayame, and a few others that were throwing out their attacks from behind!
The scene turned critical as the tan visage of Erikson moved forward to protect the others, a slipper being carried in both his hands as he sought to distort probability to an extreme.
But the Lesser Mimeisthai was of the Eighth Gradation of Extremity and held much greater weight.
Erikson's defense would not be sufficient, and since the Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Mimeisthai deemed it so, its figure instantly flickered.
An instant later, it appeared before the Lesser Mimeisthai even reached its targets, the muscular hand of Noah's unseen weapon moving as...
SPLAT!
Reality was painted to a scene of a Lesser Mimeisthai being flattened into a pancake and subsequent explosion of white blood and gore in the next instant.
Silence descended in the nearby surroundings as this...was the first Mimeisthai to fall in the battle so far!
From the back, Ayame and the others gazed at Erikson who was scratching his head himself, since they really didn't see anything appear to attack the enemy right in front of them.
Erikson looked at the slippers in his hands and wondered...had he truly twisted probability that much?
He then looked around cautiously for a culprit as he shook such a brazen idea from his head, but nobody could be found!
Meanwhile, in front of the eyes of the Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Mimeisthai...
{You have attained 5x Quintessential Fruits of Existence for your Master!}
{The analysis of the weavings of the eradicated target has reached 100%}
{The target of the Lesser Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai has been entirely analyzed and its weavings eradicated in the process.}
{The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Lesser Mimeisthai Emperor Penguin, can now be called out to work under the banner of the Extremity of Loot.}
A profound extension of power for the concept of Loot that continued to dominate at this time.
The Mimeisthai with Noah's likeness looked at the prompt before it as in the next moment, the gilded light of Loot began to flow within its eyes.

The glow of Existential Extremity Authorities blared out silently and away from the gazes of others as a singularity formed in front of it- a singularity that bloomed in the next moment to form into a Lesser Mimeisthai resembling the Emperor Penguin!
Its sleek feathers were lined with gold and blue lights as outwardly, it brimmed with Loot and Infinity.
It bowed towards the glorious figure of the Mimeisthai that had conjured it as around them, the weaving of Loot seemed to be dancing with valor and glory!
Silently, invisible to others, they watched and observed.
It was the advent of a silent army that enemies would not see or feel coming, with those truly powerful only sensing the danger as it arrived!
In the Supernal Haven of Helios.

Noah seemed to be at the very center of a now controlled domain that was thoroughly becoming analyzed by the very Extreme of Loot, two massive Dungeon Monoliths already being situated a few light years away as the moment that the feature of {Existential Analytical Looter} stated it's completion, Noah could spurr a Dungeon Break and have the Infinite Hyperversal Haven devour and assimilate this whole Supernal Haven.
And yet at this moment, his gaze was extremely stern as he felt the subtle changes within himself!

He had taken a single Quintessential Fruit of Existence, and he was observing the changes compared to the Fruits he had been taking so far as the first thing...was the concentration of authority that erupted like an endless sea from it.

The major finding was that at the very minimum, Noah observed 50% more eruption of authority- and the even more unique thing was that unlike normal Fruits of Existence that chose a part of Noah to strengthen, whether that be his Aspects of Existence, Extremes, or Records...the Quintessential Fruit of Existence had its energy spread out to empower everything.
Every. Single. Thing!
And even while discerning all of this, Noah still felt like he was only standing at the tip of the iceberg- and that there were many more things he did not yet know!
After all, these were precious resources utilized by entities that had exceeded the Gradations of Extremity.

What he needed to do was understand just how critical it was that he was able to alter and gain a better quality of such a resource...and exactly what edge he gained with it compared to the Legacies stretching out over the eons!

chapters.title: Chapter 2939 Dominium! I
paragraphs: Much of its wonders were unknown.
But their core truth lay in their usage.
In who used them.

Noah's Will was bright as he didn't even need to ask Ruination whether she could multiply these Quintessential Fruits of Existence, feeling the few thousand he had attained due to Loot as he called them out at this moment.
In the Supernal Haven of Helios being analyzed at this very moment.
Hundreds of dazzling translucent Quintessential Fruits of Existence appeared around Noah as if they were gorgeous singularities.
Most of them held slivers of golden tendrils coursing through them, but there were also some that were entirely translucent as they were normal Fruits of Existence!
Noah felt like it was time to take another leap of power and have more of his questions answered as he was about to begin devouring and elevating en masse.
But as he was about to begin...
{The Weavings of Loot shine with ingenuity.}
{The Extremity of Loot calls upon all other Existential Extremity Authorities under the banner of its Existence.}
{The Extremity of Loot seeks to apply the feature of Existential Analytical Looter on the Fruits of Existence and the Quintessential Fruits of Existence.}
The Loot that came as a product being extracted from defeated enemies!

It was elevated in quality and quantity by Loot as due to the mysterious nature of the authority flowing within the Fruits of Existence, even the concept that extracted them, Loot...did not know too much about them!
And now, it sought to change that.
What result could be attained if the feature of Existential Analytical Looter could analyze everything?
It had so far analyzed an Existential Apokalypsis Mimeisthai and then constructed a creature just like it. It had analyzed a whole Haven.
And now, its reach was extending towards the Fruits of Existence themselves!
Noah's eyes buzzed as he saw the golden light of Loot cover a Quintessential Fruit of Existence and a normal Fruit of Existence.
{The analysis of the weavings of the Quintessential Fruit of Existence is at 1%}
{The analysis of the weavings of the Fruit of Existence is at 1%}
Two fruits became covered by the light of Loot as holographic images similar to them began to be formed on the side.
It was bound to be a much slower and more complicated process, but it would finish in due time as more answers would then present themselves!
But until then...
{Come.}
Noah spoke calmly to the dazzling Fruits around him.
Quintessential and not Quintessential.
Everything began to flow towards his mouth as the Extremity of Loot began to devour the Loot of the Second Day of Mors Apokalypsis!

He had already devoured a significant amount of Fruits of Existence the day prior as he knew with Quintessential certainty that what he was devouring and assimilating now- especially these elevated versions of the Fruits of Existence...they were bound to grant a shocking result!
HUUM!
Indomitable brilliance began to surround him.
The translucent light filled with golden brilliance spread to all parts that defined him.
They covered the weavings of his Existence, of his Records, and of his Extremes.
Everything!

And the raging seas came down with such momentum that they instantly propelled Noah's mind ever higher, Vermillion flames of the Weaver of Extremity beginning to burn with intense brightness as questions...began to rise within him.
Extremity.
Existence.
Records.
How did they all fit together?
Why did the Seeds within Vitalis refer to the Basileus and Dikastes as Those Above Extremity?
What did it mean to be above Extremity? Was this distinction even something genuine, or only spoken by beings that didn't know much about what lay above?
One could move past the Nine Gradations of Extremity and climb above them, but was this symbolism it?!
{The Weavings of Extremes, Records, and Existence lay themselves bare before the eyes of the Weaver of Extremity.}

As boundless seas of the authority of Fruits of Existence surged within him, Noah felt everything about him being raised as the questions hard to answer before...may actually be able to provide defined answers this time!
Noah remembered the prophecy that was uttered by the Protagonist himself at this time.
{Waters crossed with unimaginable speed. Immeasurable extremes all brought under a single creed...Only one Extreme will be left at the end of it all.}
He had already fulfilled the first line.
He had crossed the Gradations at a speed others couldn't even fathom!
And now the second line indicated that many extremes...would be brought together under a single creed!
And furthermore, only one extreme will be left at the end.
These were words Noah inherently said as they held their own profound meaning- born from the mouth of the Protagonist!
"Extremes...Existence...Records..."
Noah's voice echoed out in an ethereal manner as he delved into a state of a profound epiphany.

The raging authorities of the Quintessential Fruits of Existence were unquantifiably strengthening all of him, causing his mind to try its best to sift through advancements that were too advanced for his current stage!
And at such a time, his consciousness was fully brought to the waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity.
Around him, plucked Fruits of Existence could be seen as his breakdown of the Dikastes of Extremity to construct an Existential Automaton continued, and in addition to this...
{Existential Analytical Looter has latched on to the visage of the Dikastes of Extremity.}
{The analysis of the weavings of the Dikastes of Extremity is at 10%}
Loot asserted itself even in this region as its extreme let its intent run free and loose.

In his state of epiphany, Noah looked around the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, as well as the twinkling feeling that had begun to bud within him that he could traverse across this Gradation at rapid speeds with all of the strengthening he had obtained from the Fruits of Existence!
And when he reached the end, he could...
He could...
HUUM!

There seemed to be a thin film preventing any advancement of information, and at this moment, Noah's visage released a sea of Vermillion flames that sought to crash anything preventing his advancement!
{The Weaver of Extremity pulls upon the intricacies of the Gradations.}
{The Weaver of Extremity gazes at the path above.}
{The Gradations of Extremity pave the pathway of Extremes that propel one's Aspects towards a single destination.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2940 Dominium! II
paragraphs: Yes.
He already had weavings of the answers, and they came the moment he first swallowed a Fruit of Existence.
What was the first thing that the Fruits of Existence did as their authorities exploded within him?
They flowed into his Soul.
They flowed into his Origin.
They flowed into his Body.

Being objects consumed by those who had exceeded the bounds of the Gradations of Extremity, their first inherently actions were these as their main goal was to take the Aspects of Existence within Noah towards becoming...
{Existential.}
WAA!
{After traversing the Gradations of Extremity, one culminates the intent of their Extremes to spur their advancement into the next Realm.}
From the very Waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity around him.
From the dissected and analyzed bodies of Dikastes of Extremity around him!
The Weaver of Extremity was pulling up on any and all strands of information around him as he formed a clear picture!
{Distinguished differently by a myriad of Legacies across the eons, the traversal of the Gradations of Extremity leads one towards the Existential Realm.}

{Threads of Weavings show this Realm referred to as Existential Realm, Existential Sculpting Realm, or Existential Dominium Realm among a few, with other distinctions too thin to have their weavings currently grasped.}
Profound weavings flowed into the mind of the Extremity of Quintessence!
{The weavings of Extremes are the pathway traversed to arrive at this destination- a Bridge built to reach Existential.}
Extremes were the bridge towards Existential, but it didn't mean their usage stopped there.
Even after stepping into the Existential Dominium Realm, One's extremes still dominated as the foundation that formed the bridge towards Existential would retain its supremacy!
After all, to complete the bridge toward the Existential Dominium Realm, an Existential Extremity Authority was required.
So before anything else, one's Extreme had to become Existential!
There were still many intricacies with how one arrived at this stage, but one thing remained crystal clear.
Noah had not taken the proper steps.
He attained an Existential Extremity the moment he took his concepts towards Extremity. Actions that were obscene to even think about!
One had to go through their Extremes to bridge the gap towards Existential.
And yet Noah had begun to consume a large number of Fruits of Existence that were already taking his Soul, Origin, and Body towards nothing else other than...Existential.
His Existence. His Records. His Extremes.
"My extremes..."
The surrounding waters began to tremble at his voice.
He thought of his Extremes.
Had they truly reached...their extremes?
His soul burned with desire.
His weavings trembled with an influx of power that was taking him towards the Existential Dominium Realm!
And...
{You seek to expand the Extremity of Extremity for the second time.}
A dazzling prompt descended.
In the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
Surrounded by Existential Extremity Authorities, Basileus Anaine waved her hands calmly as many thoughts passed through her mind.
She always found the purest tendrils of authorities within an Existential Domain to be unique, convinced that it was subtly different from any other extreme produced by Entities.
This was why even though she and all of the Legacy of Al-Abalem were of the Existential Soul Dominium, she still gave time to Vitalis.

She compared the tendrils of pure Vitalis Existential Extremity Authority passing over her hands to the endless seas of Soul Existential Extremity Authorities coursing within her existence, her hand placed on her chest as she closed her eyes.
Her Soul felt boundless.
Like it could overcome anything else.

And of course, a similar feeling was shared for those embarking on the path of Existential Body Dominium and Existential Origin Dominium- it was a feeling all entities in the Existential Dominium Realm felt!
And such a feeling was true and false at the same time.
Such a feeling was why even after careful and intricate planning, she still feared her Father.

She still feared Al-Abalem as amongst all of the Existential Dominium Realm entities out there, he had the unique position of annealing his Existential Soul with an endless source of Fruits of Existence.

That's why so many cards had to be played.
This was why she associated with a certain Legacy that held a being powerful enough to hold back the endless Existential Dominium Soul that Al-Abalem held.
She let out a laugh at such a thought as she considered the state of the Existential Omniverse and countless Entities moving across it.

The Existential Soul Dominium.
The Existential Origin Dominium.
The Existential Body Dominium.

"How fickle all of it is..."
Basileus Anaine's eyes turned sharp as she thought of her own plans to bring about the downfall of the Existential Dominium of a terrifying being!
