chapters.title: Chapter 2941 Dominium! III
paragraphs: Plans were just that.
Plans.
For them to actually succeed, a great deal of sacrifice would have to be paid!
Basileus Anaine knew the fragility and strength of her own plan as she wondered of the most fragile part.

The unknown weavings of the man she had seen a glimpse of and didn't brand him with her Existential Soul Dominium, and she had instead protected his weavings from the gaze of the Archon Basileus Al-Abalem!

This entity became part of her plans, but he was also the most fragile part as Basileus Anaine had to suspend her common sense- or be with the mindset that he was different from many other Corrupted Seeds that had appeared within Existential Domains.
Especially when the Codex of Extremity was utilized, nothing could escape its grasp. Yet...he seemed to be causing issues even with this.

Such a reality caused Basileus Anaine to reconsider this being. 'Unless you have a way to reach the Existential Dominium Realm before the Ninth Day arrives, it will all be for naught. And even if somehow you attain Existential Dominium...you will just be a fledgling that has not gotten a chance to anneal any authority yet.'
Yes!

Given that after 9 days when the Codex of Extremity finished its work, even if Osmont somehow attained the impossible ascension of Existential Dominium for a Seed, what could he do when Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and Ignatius themselves descended to confirm the results?
The time right after Mors Apokalypsis would present an Existential Domain free of weavings of any Records.
The absolute restrictions imposed on the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius would be at their weakest during such a time as they could descend and wade across Vitalis and Vacuous easily!
Basileus Anaine did not even seek to peer that far ahead as around that time, her machinations should be coming to fruition.
After 9 days, both Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and Archon Basileus Ignatius would be at their weakest.
If she didn't move then, she would never be able to make another move again.
After all, what were the chances of another Corrupted Seed as profound as this one who forced a Mors Apokalypsis to appear in the eons to come?!
Thinking of this, Basileus Anaine's eyes burned with purpose as she opened her palm, a Fruit of Existence appearing on it as she began to eat it with bright eyes.
She also had to continue annealing her Existential Soul Dominium. The process of annealing was endless.
To this day, nobody had discovered an apex.
And the stronger she was, the easier things would become!
HOONG!
The surroundings of Noah's existence were filled with a blinding light of brilliance within the Supernal Haven of Helios.
A new extreme was trying to be brought to fruition as it radiated multicolored splendor!
Extremity!
Could Noah really say he had reached the extremes of his concepts...if he didn't truly hold the very concept of Extremity in his hands?
But it was something too high before.
His existence was not ready for it.
But with all his Aspects being bathed with the unfathomable light of Quintessential Fruits of Existence along with his extremes...Noah felt that it may just be possible.
And this process was occurring while even he didn't know what the effect all of this would have on all of his established Extremes!

As he sought to bring this shocking task to completion, he felt a subtle change with his Manifestation in the Waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity that was continuing to pluck Fruits of Existence.
This body of his felt a driving force propelling him upwards at the same time as he sought the Extremity of Extremity.
As if he was being told this wasn't the place to attain it!
His visage began ascending upwards as streams of the endless waters around him flooded towards his existence.
The higher up one went across the Gradations of Extremity, the more refined and purified their Extremes became.
The further they went on the path of Extremity!
On his grand undertaking to attain the Extremity of Extremity, Noah found that he had to be sitting at the very peak of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity.
And so he surged towards it.
These actions he was currently undertaking were grand, but they were not just for him.
They didn't affect just him!
Back in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, its defenders were having trouble just reacting against the Lesser Mimeisthai because of how powerful these enemies were.
They were having trouble.
Were!
As the seconds passed, they began to notice subtle changes as the entities that were too fast for them before...they seemingly began to slow down.
Ever so manageable.
To the extent that soon after, the pace of the battle began to change as the Lesser Mimeisthai were now being pushed back!
This change was so noticeable that many perceptive defenders soon realized why, their existence enjoying a boost from nothing else other than...Noah's extremes.
All of those who walked on the path of Quintessence.
Of Infinity and Tyranny.
And then, there was Loot.
As Noah rose to the peak of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, so did the power they could wield through his extremes!
It was to the extent that within a few seconds...
BOOM!
The Lesser Mimeisthai of Ishtar had a spear going through her chest, Athena standing over her as from the back, golden chains of dreams stemming from Eowyn held this Lesser Mimeisthai down.
{Ha!}
With another bellow, the Atlatl in Athena's hand spun with a heavy propulsive force, the chest and body of the Lesser Mimeisthai becoming shredded as the light of Loot covered it entirely!
It was the first time another Lesser Mimeisthai fell from the hands of those other than Noah, and before the eyes of Athena and Eowyn...
{The Weavings of Loot thank you for aiding in the Analysis of the Lesser Mimeisthai- Ishtar.} {You have attained 3x Quintessential Fruits of Existence!}
{The analysis of the weavings of the eradicated target has reached 100%}
{The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Lesser Mimeisthai Ishtar, will now be called out to work under the banner of the Extremity of Loot.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2942 Dominium! IV
paragraphs: These prompts rose before the eyes of Athena and Eowyn as they only held question marks, and they weren't able to see the scene of a golden illusory hologram rising from the Lesser Mimeisthai they had just killed- a new invisible assassin being born to add to the ranks of a deadly army under the Extremity of Loot!
But seeing the changing tide of the battle, they focused and moved to reinforce others.
The Weavings of Noah's extremes through them only became prominent as it was clear that from now on...the challenge of the Lesser Mimeisthai would become an inevitability for them to handle.

All that waited on the opposite side was the allure of Loot, with this challenge from the Codex of Extremity for the second day of Mors Apokalypsis being considered a win for the Infinite Hyperversal Haven once more!
And yet even as the Lesser Mimeisthais became oppressed with the battle dropping in their favor, their eyes remained shining brightly as they continued to collect information.
As they continued to grasp the weavings of the forces of the Extremity of Quintessence!
As if the Codex of Extremity was planning for something even grander for the next day of Mors Apokalypsis!
And truly, in response to what had just occurred with the Extremity of Quintessence...the Codex was already on the move.
It sought to cook up something profound to achieve its set purpose for the next day.
So even though the second day had just begun and its forces were already done for, it began to move and prepare for tomorrow right away.
And this...would have shocking implications for certain Entities.
In the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.

Archon Basileus Al-Abalem rose up on a bed shimmering with soft white clouds as he stretched with contentment, multiple figures of dazzlingly beautiful Basileus being visible on this bed breathing out with exhaustion.

His gaze was cold and calculating as his bare body was laid plain for all to see, his chest showing intriguingly intricate runic weavings as he floated from the bed and towards a crystal table holding a mountain of Fruits of Existence!
This was his glorious life.
Constant elevation and strengthening over eons, and being able to put his hands on any Entity he found to his liking.
Who would ever tire of such an existence?
Especially for someone of his caliber who held shocking aspirations, what could-
HUUM!

His thoughts came to a halt as his hand that was reaching out to one of the few hundred Fruits on the crystal table touched nothing but air, the dazzling Fruits of Existence here instantly fading away with an eruption of white light!
His gaze of contentment instantly faded as an instant later, he bellowed out in shock and anger!
"WHAT!"
BOOM!
The reality around him cracked and distorted as even the figures on the bed behind him shrieked, their bare bodies thrown back from the pressure as white gold blood leaked from their lips.
They shuddered as it felt like the very Soul Dominium of the Archon Basileus Al-Abalem was pressing down on everything- and they may very well die from it if it continued just for another second!

The visage of the Archon Basileus Al-Abalem was currently aflame with rage as the hundreds of Fruits of Existence before him disappeared, and he felt thousands more within his reserves begin to leak out one after another in a nonstop fashion!
Such a development was an obscene one, with all of Archaeos Vitalis Pylos beginning to tremble as the Dominium of Al-Abalem spread out all around.

It observed the grand appearance and flaring out of an illusory Codex of Extremity in the space above the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos, and it even sought to press down below to see what exactly was happening within the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
Because the second day of Mors Apokalypsis had just begun, and the Codex was already taking even more resources in order to complete its task!

This made Al-Abalem want to bellow out towards it- what the hell would need this much of his resources to accomplish? What the hell was happening down there that even at this moment, Al-Abalem shockingly counted that 33% of his remaining reserves of Fruits of Existence were just taken away?!
This was his question, but there were no answers.
His eyes blazed with immeasurable flames of anger as at this moment, his Soul Dominium remained oppressively in the surroundings as all Entities quaked from it!

In a corner of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos, Basileus Anaine could also be seen with a stern expression, gazing unblinkingly at the bright Manifestation of the Codex of Extremity as in her heart, boundless intents surged.
All of this was due to a single being!
A being they all knew of by name and distinction as at this moment, they wondered what exactly he was doing down there to cause all of this.
And what was the Extremity of Quintessence currently doing?
His manifestation within the Waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity crossed distances that others would take their whole lifetimes to cross...within mere moments.
The waters around him became thinner as droves surged into him.
His extremes accepted everything as after a certain point, his moving figure seemed to become the center point of these waters.
The chains of Dikastes of Extremity rising off their hibernating bodies trembled and became twisted.
The branches holding barely formed Fruits of Existence shattered, dissolving into the waters of the Gradations that then surged into Noah's visage!
He climbed up like this while his Records, Existence, and Extremes were being empowered all at once, until he finally felt his body slowing down and coming to a stop.
He came to a stop as he reached...the furthest reaches of the Gradations of Extremity.
His Extremes vibrated with wonder.
His will opened to observe....the ends of the Gradations of Extremity.
The extreme of these waters.
The area that one had to cross as on the other side, their Existential Dominium would be formed if ever one crossed!
At such a place, Noah uttered out with defiance.
{Extremity.}
HUUM!
{The Extremity of Extremity is coming to fruition!}
A dazzling prompt arose.
And brilliance followed!

paragraphs: Tendrils of branches holding up Fruits of Existence shattered.
Half formed Fruits of Existence became ground to dust!
At the very Apex of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, Noah acted as the nexus who was swallowing all waters nearby into his Existence and Extremes as the aura he gave off was awe inspiring!
But what really mattered was within.
What really mattered was the concept he was now expanding, and what its effects would be on all of his other concepts.
{The Weaver of Extremity is expanding the very concept of Extremity.}
{Its weavings speak to you and wrap around your Existential Extremity Authorities.}
{Its weavings wake from an endless slumber and begin suffusing into your Records, Extremes, and Existence.}
From the moment that the Extremity of Extremity began to wake, Noah's Quintessence became ever brighter.
Infinity radiated an even grander blue sheen, and Tyranny and the Protagonist pulsed with excitement!
Loot remained silent as its gilded light became all that much more brilliant.
Extremity.
The furthest point. The utmost end of something. So what did the extreme of an extreme even entail? It was...
{The Extremity of Paradox gazes on with anticipation.}
Paradoxical.
Such a concept was paradoxical as to put it in perspective, the Awakening Extremity of Extremity was having its authority course towards all of Noah's concepts!
Not just his Concepts- but also his Existence and Records.
And at the same time...
{The Extremity of Extremity is not a concept that is attained unless it is Existential.}
The moment it began to form, its authority was already far above others as Noah felt the breadth of his soul get squeezed once more.
The thousands of Quintessential Fruits of Existence made space, but it was still a heavy concept coming to fruition as in its conception, it radiated an existential light!
A light of profound wonder that cemented Noah who quite literally stood at the very extreme of the Gradations of Extremity.
The changes caused by the advent of such a thing were not subtle at all, Noah feeling the rapid expansion and elevation of all of his authorities as...
{The Extremity of Cheats nods with appreciation and curiosity while grasping the tendrils of authority of the Extremity of Extremity.}
Tendrils.

Their colors were deep and ancient as they could best be described as stygian The newly rising Existential concept was bathing everything within Noah with these stygian tendrils of authority as some of his extremes reacted very differently compared to others.
Cheats went outside the norm to grasp the stygian tendrils of the Extremity of Extremity layering itself on top of it for the purposes of elevation as...
BZZT!
The two authorities clashed and rebuffed!
{The rousing will of the Extremity of Extremity gazes coldly at the Extremity of Cheats.}
WAA!
Its purpose was a singular one.
Its desire as a concept was a simple one.
To achieve the utmost extremes of all extremes.
All extremes...under the banner and empowerment of a single extreme!
But when another concept played with tendrils of its authority like so...
{The Extremity of Cheats gazes calmly at the burning Existential Authority of Extremity.}
{The Extremity of Cheats beckons as the authority of the Extremity of Extremity!}

Noah's will buzzed as he experienced the shocking scene of the stygian tendrils of authority of a newly forming Existential Extremity Authority...actually moving uncontrollably and sinking into the Extremity of Cheats!
What was this?
What was even happening?!
{The Extremity of Cheats absorbs the Existential Extremity Authority of Extremity and tells it not to think too much.}
{For Cheats to live up to its extreme, doing something like this is only natural.}
WAA!
It was supposed to be the singular spotlight of a newly forming concept of shocking proportions, and yet such a moment occurred where even this forming Extremity of Extremity had to pause briefly!
But it could not place a rebuttal as the Extreme that had made a move...could truly only do so if it was living up to its name to an extreme extent.
And this single scene...gave a glimpse into the currently quantifiable boons of the expansion of the Extremity of Extremity that Noah had expanded.
The elevation and revolution of all of his concepts to a level that even he couldn't imagine!
The Extremity of Extremity may not bring and show the most profound changes itself right away- but it would bring the most spectacular changes to every other extreme.
{The Extremity of Extremity gazes at the Existence who has called upon it.}
{As a concept, others have called and expanded it.}
{Your worthiness for Extremity does not even need to be questioned as the Extremity of Extremity begins fully assimilating into you.}

Some stupendous prompts came forward as Noah's will buzzed, wisps of information being revealed that showed likely...entities at the Existential Dominium Realm may grasp and hold the Extremity of Extremity!
But here was Noah, still within the Gradations of Extremity grasping it.
His worthiness didn't even need to be questioned!
So the Extremity of Extremity fully assimilated into him as far from being just a concept, it sought to take what was known as Noah Osmont...to its ultimate extremes.
{Your Lineage is going towards its quintessential extremes.}
{Your Lineage rushes ever faster to become Existential.}
{Your Aspects of Existence are going towards their Quintessential extremes.}
{Your Aspects of Existence attain Quintessential stability as they head towards becoming Existential.}
{Your Records are being imposed with the light of utmost extremes.}
{The weight of your Records becomes even more unfathomable.}
{Your Fable continues to be one of unsurpassable brilliance.}
Stygian flows of brilliance coursed all around him as Noah felt the false sensation of being the nexus of everything around him.
False, and yet also true as it was a paradoxical sensation.
And yet the effects remained true as he felt his blood boiling.
As he felt his Body, Origin, and Soul boiling.
There may have been many ways for others to cross the Gradations of Extremity and climb above them to attain the Existential Dominium Realm.
But the pathway Noah was taking...it was hard to say if it was one that had ever occurred before!

chapters.title: Chapter 2944 Dominium! VI
paragraphs: Those who enacted their Existential Dominium were not entities to be taken lightly.
Noah was very hurriedly about to knock on the doors of such a stage, but there were others who had been in it for eons.
And such beings were currently his enemies.
Not any common being among those in the Existential Dominium Realm, but those distinguished as Archons!
Away from the brilliance of Noah knocking on the doors of Existential Dominium.
Within the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
The visage of Archon Basileus Al-Abalem floated at the very peak of this domain as he stared at the illusory Manifestation of the Codex of Extremity above.
He could still feel his connection to the Codex itself, and the fact that as of right now, it had only stopped taking Fruits of Existence once his remaining 50% were taken away.
50% of the reserves of an Archon Basileus.
Such a number was a heavy one as it left him exposed to his enemies.
And Al-Abalem did not have a few enemies!

The Fruits of Existence were akin to garments that stood around him protectively- a weapon of caution against his enemies as one could do many things with the sudden eruption and usage of Fruits of Existence.
To be left with his reserves so low, Al-Abalem felt like he was lying naked in a field that could have enemies swirling by at any moment.
This couldn't be allowed to continue.
The first time it occurred, it could be attributed to an unexpected change that the Codex had to react to.
But this second time?
The reduction of his reserves of 50% of Fruits of Existence?!
If the Archon Basileus sat still after all of this, he would not be Al-Abalem.
The other option would be for him to sit and wait passively to see what result the Codex would produce with its recent actions.
But what if that result was similar to what had just occurred twice before?
How many of his Fruits of Existence would be left then?
No. Archon Basileus Al-Abalem was not a passive being.
With such a thought, his figure was wrapped by a blazing transparent light as he instantly disappeared.
He shuttled across the weavings of Records and Existence as within an instant, he crossed into a tenebrous domain where he felt the other blazing Soul Dominium that shone brightest apart from him.
HUUM!
When the raging Existential Extremity Authorities cleared, the figure of Al-Abalem bathed in white light was gazing at the figure of none other than...Ignatius.
Billowing darkness wrapped around him as his expression was also sour.
The other Entity who was under the same situation as him!
Al-Abalem appeared before Ignatius as he spoke with a calm gaze.
{We seem to have come across a paradoxical Seed that even the Codex of Extremity unleashing Mors Apokalypsis is having a hard time clearing away.}
His words were uttered calmly even though they held immense gravity!
Archon Basileus Ignatius nodded back with a sharp gaze while Al-Abalem placed his hands behind his back and continued.

{We must take a step back and react to our best interests in this situation. If it unfolds as is, the worst case scenario is one that is neither favorable for me nor you. I propose...we stop abiding by the Existential Absolute Restrictions of these Domains of ours. I propose our descent to clear out everything ourselves before this progresses into an even worse issue.}
WAA!
Terrifying words echoed out as the pupils of Ignatius burned with dark flames!
His expression was filled with doubt as he replied cautiously.

{The restrictions make way for us to harvest the Fruits of Existence the way we have been harvesting. Violating the restrictions will hurt the Domains themselves and make it so that we cannot harvest anything for the next 9 eons...}
There were intricacies behind everything that occurred.
If they violated that which should not be violated...
{It matters not.}
Al-Abalem waved his hands dismissively as he gazed down before him.

{My enemies are your enemies since we occupy the same lands. If they find out our resources are being depleted this much, they will swarm and devour us whole. We have been bleeding a great deal. Let us stop this bleeding, and we can come out of the other side stronger. To break the restrictions, it will have to be the both of us.}
His words were undeniable.
Ignatius remained silent briefly before his eyes lit up with darkness, becoming resolved as he thought of his own Legacy!
{Will we still have enough to pay our tributes for 9 eons?}
A question only the two of them would understand.
And Al-Abalem shook his head while replying.

{Maybe for half of those eons. The other half, we will have to find other means to make sure no injunction is filed against us to strip our control of these domains. We could set off to do...that. Dangerous as it may be, it will ensure survival and control.}
WAA!
The mind of the Archon Basileus Al-Abalem was made up as all factors were considered!
And since they arrived at such a junction, Ignatius could do nothing but...nod his head.
{Very well.}
An irreversible decision was made.
It was a heavy one as it showed...Entities following the Existential Soul Dominium were not to be underestimated!
And as the two Archons came to this decision...
Back in the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.

The visage of Basileus Anaine gazed at the illusion of the Codex of Extremity as if she were reading the weavings of the skies themselves, her expression coming to a resolution as she affirmed Archon Basileus Al-Abalem had truly left.
The action of his leaving right after this event meant too many things to her as after an instant...it affirmed her resolve.
She placed her hands on her chest as her eyes closed, a terrifying Dominium spreading around her and covering her entirely as within moments, nothing of her weaving could be discerned!
In such a state, she spoke as she sent a message out.
|Things have changed. He may very well be at his weakest right now- both him and Ignatius. The time to move is now.|
Her message fluttered into and out of existence as it went towards a destination only she knew.
One being after another made their move at this moment as their Dominiums sought to encompass everything.
And the Entity whose Dominium had not even formed at the center of this all...
He was enjoying the empowerment of the Extremity of Extremity as all the ridiculous things he could do before...were about to be made entirely too broken!
To the extent that in the midst of his elevation, the following prompts washed over his will.
{Your Infinite Forge is going towards its ultimate extreme.}
{Within your forge, the authority of the Fruits of Existence has seeped in abundance as it seeks to replicate it.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2945 Dominium! VII
paragraphs: The Culmination of too many things was occurring all at once.
Noah had to analyze it all, categorize it, and assimilate it to put it to its full usage with as much efficiency as possible!
At this moment, within the Aspect of his Soul that was acclimating to the apex of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, there was his infinite forge.
It sought to do something as grand as replicating the Fruits of Existence to be produced within the Forge!
But when it came to this...
BZZT!
The dazzling light that the forge was accumulating fizzled.
{The action of generating Fruits of Existence is one that Legacies have theorized and arduously forged pathways of over the eons.}
{Existential Domains have been one of the main methodologies to produce Fruits of Existence, and something that is not Existential can't produce a Fruit of Existence.}
The Weaver of Extremity received waves of information regarding the shocking task he wanted to undertake!
Legacies had to reside over Existential Domains like Vitalis and Vacuous just to extract Fruits of Existence over the years through these Existential Authorities.
Another Methodology unique to Noah...was his own Concept devouring the authority stemming from the Fruits of Existence and elevating it!
This was the task of Loot.
But to this day, neither Noah nor the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had managed to produce their own Fruit of Existence!
For the Infinite Forge to do so, the first task already had its clue laid out bare.
Something that was not Existential could not produce the Fruits of Existence.
So he had to attain an Existential Soul Dominium first.
And an Existential Origin Dominium as he wanted to give his Havens and Extremity Vein a chance for their own wonders!
And an Existential Body Dominium as he wanted his visage to be impenetrable!
These were the aspirations of the Extremity of Quintessence as he stood at the very peak of the Gradations of Extremity, his eyes already seeking to gaze at something far above it.
The Existential Dominium Realm.
{Normally, an existence would bathe an Aspect of the Existence with an Existential Extremity Authority, gradually refining the chosen Aspect towards becoming Existential itself.}

{The Existential Extremity forms a Bridge between that which is existential and not, and once such a connection is established as one- the first steps into the Existential Dominium Realm can be achieved.}

{Your Aspects of Existence were bathed with the light of Quintessence and multiple other Existential Extremity Authorities, but the greatest benefactor of their rise towards the Existential level was the unsurpassably pure authority of the Fruits of Existence!}

The means of achieving Existential Dominium Realm were shown as for others, they had to have a truly compelling Existential Extremity Authority in order to form an Existential Bridge from their concept to an Aspect of their Existence.
If this Existential Bridge formed was stable enough, a transference would occur as those on opposite ends of this bridge would resonate, and one's Existence would begin forming their own Dominium.
Their own Dominium that would be influenced heavily by their concept that guided everything there.
This was the purpose of Extremity.
A pathway.
A literal bridge towards Existential.

And yet Noah skipped around and did things his own way where even before forming an Existential Bridge, not just one...but all three of his Aspects of Existence were pristinely close to the Existential level!
And as the Extremity of Extremity surged with countless stygian tendrils of authority across him...
HUUM!
His existence began to tremble.
He knew something grand would soon be taking place!
But at such a moment...
His existence suddenly felt a sense of suffocation.
As if something or someone was pressing down against him on all sides!
This feeling of suffocation...was a very early warning of his own existence.
A warning of something he did not yet know!
But it was enough that even his extremes began to buzz.
{Quintessence observes an obscure weaving in the near future.}
{Infinity senses the possible imposition of limits to its endless seas!}
{Tyranny rages at an uncertain sense of oppression!}
His extremes began to buzz as Noah was about to activate Existential Proofreader to see if his Unrecorded Fable would be visible even with this sense of danger, but all of a sudden...
{The Extremity of Cheats rises its head with scrutiny at the unknown warning and danger.}
{The Extremity of Cheats states that one simply needs to grow powerful enough in the time period before the danger arrives in order to whether through it.}
The Extremity of Cheats that had grasped and taken in the Existential Extremity Authority of Extremity...began to move earnestly.
And this...was something more terrifying than many could even fathom!
{The Extremity of Cheats pulls upon all Extremes under the banner of The Weaver of Extremity.}
HUUM!
Tens of millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures seethed with maddened fervor.
Cheats...pulled upon the authorities of all of Noah's extremes.
Whether they were existential or not.
{The Extremity of Cheats knows that whatever danger that is coming...is coming towards the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains. If these domains cease to exist, what can they come down to?}
A bold and heavy assertion was thrown out as...
{The Extremity of Cheats directs all of the Extremes under the Weaver of Extremity to accomplish its extreme.}
{The Analysis of the Supernal Haven of Helios has been pushed to 100%}
{The Entire Haven will now begin its assimilation into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}
WAA!
The two Dungeon Monoliths stretched it across this Haven pulsed and underwent a Dungeon Break simultaneously.
And all of the Supernal Haven of Helios began to tremble as its very existence began to be devoured!
But Cheats was just getting started.
{Existential Analytical Looter is being applied to all Nether and Supernal Havens of Vitalis.}
{The Analysis and construction of the Existential Automatons is being increased Quintessentially.}
{The Analysis of the Quintessential Fruit of Existence is being increased Quintessentially.}
{Immeasurable authority courses through Cheats as it states the formation of the Existential Bridge can now begin.}

sentences.text: The Culmination of too many things was occurring all at once.
Noah had to analyze it all, categorize it, and assimilate it to put it to its full usage with as much efficiency as possible!
At this moment, within the Aspect of his Soul that was acclimating to the apex of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, there was his infinite forge.
It sought to do something as grand as replicating the Fruits of Existence to be produced within the Forge!
But when it came to this...
BZZT!
The dazzling light that the forge was accumulating fizzled.
{The action of generating Fruits of Existence is one that Legacies have theorized and arduously forged pathways of over the eons.}
{Existential Domains have been one of the main methodologies to produce Fruits of Existence, and something that is not Existential can't produce a Fruit of Existence.}
The Weaver of Extremity received waves of information regarding the shocking task he wanted to undertake!
Legacies had to reside over Existential Domains like Vitalis and Vacuous just to extract Fruits of Existence over the years through these Existential Authorities.
Another Methodology unique to Noah...was his own Concept devouring the authority stemming from the Fruits of Existence and elevating it!
This was the task of Loot.
But to this day, neither Noah nor the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had managed to produce their own Fruit of Existence!
For the Infinite Forge to do so, the first task already had its clue laid out bare.
Something that was not Existential could not produce the Fruits of Existence.
So he had to attain an Existential Soul Dominium first.
And an Existential Origin Dominium as he wanted to give his Havens and Extremity Vein a chance for their own wonders!
And an Existential Body Dominium as he wanted his visage to be impenetrable!
These were the aspirations of the Extremity of Quintessence as he stood at the very peak of the Gradations of Extremity, his eyes already seeking to gaze at something far above it.
The Existential Dominium Realm.
{Normally, an existence would bathe an Aspect of the Existence with an Existential Extremity Authority, gradually refining the chosen Aspect towards becoming Existential itself.}

{The Existential Extremity forms a Bridge between that which is existential and not, and once such a connection is established as one- the first steps into the Existential Dominium Realm can be achieved.}

{Your Aspects of Existence were bathed with the light of Quintessence and multiple other Existential Extremity Authorities, but the greatest benefactor of their rise towards the Existential level was the unsurpassably pure authority of the Fruits of Existence!}

The means of achieving Existential Dominium Realm were shown as for others, they had to have a truly compelling Existential Extremity Authority in order to form an Existential Bridge from their concept to an Aspect of their Existence.
If this Existential Bridge formed was stable enough, a transference would occur as those on opposite ends of this bridge would resonate, and one's Existence would begin forming their own Dominium.
Their own Dominium that would be influenced heavily by their concept that guided everything there.
This was the purpose of Extremity.
A pathway.
A literal bridge towards Existential.

And yet Noah skipped around and did things his own way where even before forming an Existential Bridge, not just one...but all three of his Aspects of Existence were pristinely close to the Existential level!
And as the Extremity of Extremity surged with countless stygian tendrils of authority across him...
HUUM!
His existence began to tremble.
He knew something grand would soon be taking place!
But at such a moment...
His existence suddenly felt a sense of suffocation.
As if something or someone was pressing down against him on all sides!
This feeling of suffocation...was a very early warning of his own existence.
A warning of something he did not yet know!
But it was enough that even his extremes began to buzz.
{Quintessence observes an obscure weaving in the near future.}
{Infinity senses the possible imposition of limits to its endless seas!}
{Tyranny rages at an uncertain sense of oppression!}
His extremes began to buzz as Noah was about to activate Existential Proofreader to see if his Unrecorded Fable would be visible even with this sense of danger, but all of a sudden...
{The Extremity of Cheats rises its head with scrutiny at the unknown warning and danger.}
{The Extremity of Cheats states that one simply needs to grow powerful enough in the time period before the danger arrives in order to whether through it.}
The Extremity of Cheats that had grasped and taken in the Existential Extremity Authority of Extremity...began to move earnestly.
And this...was something more terrifying than many could even fathom!
{The Extremity of Cheats pulls upon all Extremes under the banner of The Weaver of Extremity.}
HUUM!
Tens of millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures seethed with maddened fervor.
Cheats...pulled upon the authorities of all of Noah's extremes.
Whether they were existential or not.
{The Extremity of Cheats knows that whatever danger that is coming...is coming towards the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
If these domains cease to exist, what can they come down to?}
A bold and heavy assertion was thrown out as...
{The Extremity of Cheats directs all of the Extremes under the Weaver of Extremity to accomplish its extreme.}
{The Analysis of the Supernal Haven of Helios has been pushed to 100%}
{The Entire Haven will now begin its assimilation into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}
WAA!
The two Dungeon Monoliths stretched it across this Haven pulsed and underwent a Dungeon Break simultaneously.
And all of the Supernal Haven of Helios began to tremble as its very existence began to be devoured!
But Cheats was just getting started.
{Existential Analytical Looter is being applied to all Nether and Supernal Havens of Vitalis.}
{The Analysis and construction of the Existential Automatons is being increased Quintessentially.}
{The Analysis of the Quintessential Fruit of Existence is being increased Quintessentially.}
{Immeasurable authority courses through Cheats as it states the formation of the Existential Bridge can now begin.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2946 Dominium! VIII
paragraphs: A concept was going utterly wild.
Just...what extreme was it trying to embody!
For it to grasp the authorities of all Extremes through it.
For it to control things as it was doing so now! Some would question and ask how any of it would be possible, and this concept may just simply tell them to look at its intent. To look at its extreme.
It was simply Cheats.
And just how could one correctly and sufficiently define the utmost extreme of Cheats- and what it could do or not do?!
It blazed with Quintessence to the extent that one may even mistake the Colorless brilliance emanating from it currently.
But through it, Quintessence shone ever brighter!
So through the ushering of a concept whose extreme couldn't be clearly defined, a wondrous scene bloomed at the very Apex of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity.
With Noah's body as the start, the beginnings of an ancient looking bridge filled with all sorts of colors began.
One slab after another was built as it was filled with Existential Extremity Authorities, and it was enacted from the waters...and going towards the impenetrable barrier and what lay beyond it.
As if through this bridge, one's existence would be baptized one final time with Existential might, and one would arrive on the other side with an Aspect of theirs gaining Dominium!
Noah's Manifestation buzzed with brilliance in the waters of the Gradations of Extremity as outside of it.
Within the Supernal Haven of Helios that was being distorted and swallowed freely.

His main body seemed anchored in space, the weight of his existence spreading out for light years as above him, the illusion of a massive incandescent multicolored bridge began to form, its ends unknown.
The columns of the bridge seemed to shine with an endless light of Infinity and Quintessence.
The bearings of the bridge vibrated with Tyranny as the deck of the bridge was lined gold with Loot and the Protagonist!

The guardrails and abutments connecting the bridge together radiated a profound Existential light of the very concept of Extremity as guiding all of them...the radiance of Cheats that was not even Existential in itself blared out with maddened grandeur.
The Existential Bridge was being formed.
A heavy Dominium was coming!
And while it did, an Existential Domain was also about to disappear completely.
Helios was the first.
Its Analysis was complete, and the Dungeon Breaks had occurred as everything about it was swallowed up...and channeled towards a single construct.
Towards a single land whose Operandi was its own to understand!
Within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
HUUM!
The weavings of reality all around quaked as this land accepted an entire Haven of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, and this would only be the first as...
{The Analysis of the Supernal Haven of Genesis has been pushed to 100%}
{The Entire Haven will now begin its assimilation into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}
{The Analysis of the Nether Haven of Dissolution has been pushed to 100%}
{The Entire Haven will now begin its assimilation into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}
One after another.
Urged by Noah's concepts.
Made impossibly fast by the weavings of Cheats.
One Haven after another was being fully analyzed before being devoured and assimilated into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, and this action...held many meanings.
Some meanings were not at all understood or planned for.
Because as the Infinite Hyperversal Haven accepted the influx of an entire Existential Domain...
{You are assimilating the Source of an Existential Domain governed by its own weavings.}
{You have assimilated enough of the Source of the Vitalis Existential Domain to the extent of reaching the weavings of the Codex of Extremity in place to govern it.}
The Codex of Extremity.
It was not something others could easily understand, but it was intricately connected to the Existential Domains its authority covered.
So what would happen when one began swallowing the very source of this Domain?
HUUM!
A sharp apathetic cry of defiance boomed out at such a juncture as above the Havens of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, the illusion of an endless white book flared!
And yet...
{The Analysis of the Nether Haven of Elera has been pushed to 100%}
{The Entire Haven will now begin its assimilation into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}
The assimilation of Havens by the Infinite Hyperversal Haven continued on without stopping!
{You are encroaching upon the weavings of the Codex of Extremity.}
{An impossibility.}
{A weaving of existence and extremes that should have in no way been capable of occurring!}

{You may begin to encroach upon the authority of the Codex of Extremity and even weaken it, but it is surrounded by a blazing and impenetrable Dominium that tightly holds on to it. Until all Existential Domains under this Codex of Extremity are assimilated, competing for the authority of the Codex of Extremity against the Dominium controlling it is yet another impossibility.}
WAA!
An influx of prompts came down as a shocking pathway was shown!
And yet even against such raging waves of influx of authorities...
{The Extremity of Cheats raises the question- who decides on impossibilities?!}
A daring authority that had been sitting back all this time began to move earnestly.
And such earnestness was truly too terrifying as it was unknown what results would be achieved at the end of it!
But this was only one side.
One part of the equation.
There was the other side- the one whose Dominium covered the Codex of Extremity!
If an authority was encroaching upon it, of course, he would feel this. He would know this!
In an indeterminate region of existence between Vitalis and Vacuous.
Archon Basileus Al-Abalem was talking with Archon Basileus Ignatius when suddenly...
His gaze shifted from incredulity to immeasurable wrath and disbelief as he uttered out while his Dominium began to run rampant.
|Let's go!|
This was his intent.
This was his will.
But before it could even begin...
|Father, we seem to have guests coming over.|
The intent of Basileus Anaine was transmitted to him as his pupils constricted with interminable weavings!

chapters.title: Chapter 2947 Dominium! IX
paragraphs: One unimaginable thing occurred after another.
Archon Basileus Al-Abalem impossibly felt a foreign authority actually encroached upon his Codex of Extremity, and the way it did so was enough to cause one to pause!
Not a direct opposition to his authority over it, but it was an encroachment beginning from the very Existential Domain itself that the Codex was connected to.
Once more, the culprit was none other than the Corrupted Seed.
Noah Osmont!
Yet before Archon Basileus Al-Abalem could divulge even more thoughts towards this...an interruption came.
Guests!
When would his Existential Domain ever have guests? Anyone arriving at this moment would only be an enemy.
HUUM!
His Dominium pulsed as it read interminable weavings.
And his expression and the expression of Archon Basileus Ignatius changed rapidly as the tanned visage of Ignatius uttered out with disgust.
{The Leashed Dog, Lethith!}
From the Legacy of Lethith.
The Archon Basileus Lethith that stood atop it- an entity known as a Leashed Dog due to his blatant advancement and encroachment of other's Existential Domain!
A fiery warmonger from the Existential Domains of Ignis, and one of those nearby who was definitely not a friend of Al-Abalem!
Coming here as a guest...
Booming arcs of light erupted from Al-Abalem as he disappeared soon after, his intent being the only thing left behind.
{Prepare for anything. Let us see the reason for the Leashed Dog Lethith to come to our Domains.}
With a dazzling glimmer of light, he was gone.
Ignatius had tenebrous eyes swirling with might at this scene as he also disappeared!
Outside of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
A ring of clear white and dark light began at one point and stretched out endlessly, the glow of and shockingly powerful Dominium covering everything around it.
Its ends seemed to stretch out over the horizon before curving as it seemed infinitely large and small at the same time.
As if it was as small as a grain of sand.
Or as vast as a stretch of Infinity.
Its location, entry, and even existence itself seemed to be paradoxical- as if it could fade away at any time as its existence was dependent on something grand!
Its existence...was dependent on unique Annals to contain their records.
This...was the point of existence and nonexistence where the Existential Domains of Vitalis and Vacuous could be found!

The intricacies of how the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains were connected to the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, Gradations of Extremity, and even the Archaeos Vitalis and Vacuous Pylos were too hard to grasp as something like this...was profound in nature.
Something like an Existential Domain was extremely prized as in the Existential Omniverse, any Entity who held control of such a place was renowned.
More likely and more often than not, it was a Legacy!
But these Legacies did not obtain the right to rule Existential Domains simply because they decided to.
Another force made that decision.
Another Entity made that decision.
The Legacy of Al-Abalem and Ignatius obtained the rights to rule over and reap the profits of the Existential Domain of Vitalis and Vacuous!
But this rulership was not always set in stone.
This rulership could change hands through certain...circumstances.
In the mind of Al-Abalem, these thoughts and more crossed as he appeared with a stern face in this region absent of existence and non-existence outside of his Existential Domain.
The visage of Basileus Anaine and dozens of other Basileus lined up behind him, their Dominiums blazing with brilliance and wonder as they stared ahead of them coldly.
In the distance, massive Existential Vessels could be seen, their shapes ovoid as they pulsed with a crimson gold light.

At the front of these Existential Vessels, the banner and Scripture standing for {Lethith} could be seen as each of these Vessels emanated an artificial aura of a Dominium that could crush throngs of Entities at the early stages of the Existential Dominium Realm.

Entities who barely just formed their Dominiums and had not even annealed their chosen Aspect of Existence with many Fruits of Existence may just be crushed from the sheer weight of these Vessels alone!
And from such vessels...
HOONG!
A fiery light blazed as one Entity after another emanating a blazing Dominium appeared.
At the forefront was a man with fiery red gold hair and fair white skin, his visage burly and built as he seemed like a moving force of nature!

Beside him was a woman with constantly smiling eyes and mouth that made one feel unsettled, her tan skin radiating beauty and wonder as she was the reason for the moniker of the Archon Basileus Lethith.
The reason for him to be known as the Leashed Dog!
Even though he was the Warmonger who controlled two Existential Domains, this woman beside him was the one who made most decisions as far as many knew.
The owner of the Leashed Dog.
The Veiled Herald of Flames- Agathina Helestri!

Further around them were other Basileus of their Legacies with ferocious and regal expressions, and the visage of Basileus Sarynn could be seen extremely close to the Veiled Herald of Flames- Agathina Helestri.
Basileus Sarynn defiantly smiled as her gaze was ahead, with nobody being the wiser about its infatuation as it locked onto the calm visage of Basileus Anaine.
The Legacy of Lethith arrived as with the Vessels they came with and this procession of dozens of Basileus...it was impossible to say this was a friendly visit!
And yet the Archon Basileus Lethith smiled brightly and laughed as he came towards Archon Basileus Al-Abalem.
"Bahaha, my old friend! How have you been? How have these eons treated you?"
Bright words.
Adorned in a tall crimson Emperor's Robes, the Leashed Dog floated forward freely while the eyes of Al-Abalem only became sharper.
His reply was cold as he looked from him and towards the Veiled Herald of Flames.

"We do not normally see guests across Existential Domains unless we've had prior communications, this is not how we operate in our great Imperium. I'm afraid I won't be able to be a proper host for this occasion."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 2948 Dominium! X
paragraphs: His words were clear cut as there was no point of contention, and yet the Leashed Dog laughed while the Veiled Herald of Flames behind him smiled, but before they could reply, yet another voice echoed out.
"I'm afraid I'll have to agree with Al-Abalem here, we aren't really accepting visitors right now."
With a blooming light of darkness, the Dominium of Ignatius bloomed, along with dozens of Basileus behind him!
Their appearance only caused the eyes of the Veiled Herald of Flames to smile even sharper, and the Leashed Dog actually stopped laughing as he gazed at everyone here with a gradually fading smile.
As if he was turning into an entirely different person, a raging aura began to dance around him as he now looked sour and cold, his words booming out.
"Well, since all parties are here, I'll get right to it."
BZZT!
He waved his hands as behind him, an existential light bloomed to carve out words into existence, words that caused the expressions of Al-Abalem and Ignatius to turn extremely sour!

|For misleading the Imperium and incorrectly managing the Existential Domains given to you by the Grace of the Imperium, I hereby bring forth the Rule of Imperium Telos against Al-Abalem and Ignatius. We'll follow procedures and everything else, but I Contest the ownership of these lands behind you while putting up the Existential Domains of Ignis on the table. If my contest is a wrongful one, my Domain shall be yours.|
BOOM!

Shocking words echoed out as Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and Ignatius instantly exploded with mad power, the silver white hair on Al-Abalem blazing with white flames of brilliance as he spoke out firmly!
|A rubbish and false accusation against my Legacy. Who are you to know whether I am incorrectly managing my Domain? I live and die for the Imperium. You come here and state all of this without even-|
|Without an Imperium Right to Challenge? Oh, but I have even that. Preliminary information we provided to the Imperium deemed it necessary for this to proceed...|
With a smile, the intent of the Leashed Dog arose as he waved his hands to reveal a shocking scroll.
A scroll radiating a terrifying Existential light that felt restricting even to the Basileus behind all Archons!
An unreliable object of power.
One that contained the authority of the Imperium!
The gazes of Al-Abalem and Ignatius turned entirely grave, their lips twisted as if they had eaten the shit of countless Corrupted Seeds.
This was not a friendly visit.
They knew this.
But...it really turned out to be even graver than they expected!
This...was the weaving of Existence here.
There were other forces moving with their own extremes and ideals.
Then, there was a being who was called a Seed.
There was a being who was offered to join the ranks of the Basileus if he simply fell in line.

There was an entity who had forged his own Existential Extremity Authorities and elevated himself to the point that at this moment...a bridge filled with Existential light formed above him in an empty void of records where the Supernal Haven of Helios used to be.
The Existential Bridge was dazzling to see as after it was nearly formed...
HUUM! To Noah's left and right, two more bridges began to come to fruition as the Existential Extremity Authorities above him went utterly wild!

{The advancement towards a Dominium is in a singular aspect for all existences, with the possibility for the advancement of other Aspects becoming available after one stabilizes their first chosen Dominium.}
{The simultaneous elevation of three Existential Dominiums is not something the weavings of Existence normally follow.}
Something outside of the norm!
Yet here Noah was doing just that as three dazzling Existential Bridges were forming, and Noah felt as if his existence was being split into pieces as he underwent immense pain at this moment!
As if his origin was being ripped apart.
As if his soul was being separated from his body.
If any of these Aspects were not strong enough by themselves, they wouldn't have even been able to survive what was currently happening.
Yet after the initial burst of pain, Noah felt three parts of his Existence appear before the three Existential Bridges.
One felt like a husk, another was transparent and filled with brilliance, and the last was a complex weaving that seemed entwined with an Extremity Vein!
And seamlessly, all three aspects of his existence began to float across the Existential Bridges being established.
RUMBLE!
His weight was immeasurable...and yet the Bridges supported him.
They supported his ascent as the Existential Extremity Authorities that made up the Bridges were too stable.
They were too strong!
They supported the weight of his existence as moments after, a blazing boundary of pure Existential Authority began to form around his Aspects of Existence.
A boundary of power.
An expression of the pure meaning of his existence.
A Dominium!
A step into the Existential Dominium Realm!
What others considered Above Extremity not too long ago.
What Primogenitors and Legends of the very Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains feared!
Noah quite literally took the steps towards this stage at this moment as his weavings, Records, Existence, and Extremes all underwent a change.
{The Extremity of Cheats beckons the Extremity of Ascendancy out of its stupor, guiding the innumerable tendrils of Existential Extremity Authorities through it at this moment.}
A blinding golden light bloomed as Noah's ascension was made all that more brilliant.
{The Extremity of Quintessence observes all ongoing Quintessential acts as it turns its attention towards its Lineage.}
{The Lineage of the Weaver of Extremity is attaining threads of Existential brilliance!}
{The Extremity of the Body radiates an Existential light.}
{The Extremity of the Soul radiates an Existential light.}
{The Extremity of the Origin radiates an Existential light.}
There were many reasons why when entities went towards the Existential Dominium Realm, only a single Aspect of their existence took the first leap forward.
It was because the extreme of that Aspect would be taken towards the Existential level as it formed its Dominium!
Those elevating would barely have enough breadth of their souls to manage the expansion of another Existential Extremity Authority.

So Noah, who already had multiple more Existential Extremity Authorities under his banner and just recently expanded the very concept of Extremity towards the Existential level...would he even be able to handle a single other concept becoming Existential- much less three?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2949 Three Dominiums!
paragraphs: The brilliance was blinding.
A man was traversing three Existential Bridges, all three Aspects of his Existence gaining a Dominium slowly as while they did so, their correlating concepts also went towards the unreachable level!
The question was whether the breadth of his soul could handle such an action.
After expanding so many concepts to the Existential level already, could Noah really take more?!
The answer was a Quintessential one as the moment his will began to buzz with worry...
{A Dominium is something far out of reach for many, and entirely understood by few.}
{Your forming Existential Origin Dominium radiates a light of brilliance as it takes on the Extreme connected to it.}
A marvelous prompt came.
This whole time, the expansion of concepts depended on one's soul- with the possibility of elevating a concept to the Existential level requiring a soul with great breadth to handle it!
And yet a Dominium of the Origin...was shockingly able to take on the role of the Soul as ever so slightly, Noah began to gain a glimpse of the workings of the Existential Dominium Realm.
If one built the Existential Origin or Body Dominium, their Existential Extremity Authorities could be supported by these Dominiums.
The soul no longer remained the sole important aspect of existence.
So the question of whether he could handle more Existential Extremity Authorities or not was not even needed as from each of his elevating Aspects of Existence forming their own Dominiums...
{The forming Dominium of the Body contains its own Existential Extremity.}
{The forming Dominium of the Soul contains its own Existential Extremity.}
{The forming Dominium of the Origin contains its own Existential Extremity.}
His Three Dominiums seamlessly took on the weight of their respective Existential Extremes.
His weight became ever heavier as he continued to walk across the Existential Bridges, passing the halfway point as the weavings of his existence and records were sentimental at this moment.
{Your Records are entirely erased from any Annals as from this point forward, they will only ever be carried within your Dominium.}
Prompts came and went.
He found himself bombarded with years worth of records as he saw himself in that dilapidated apartment on the blue world.
He saw himself on the Beast World gazing at a floating spiritual land for the first time.
He saw himself in an endless sea of Atlantis.
In a world of Cultivation.
In universes and cosmos of interminable brilliance.

He saw himself across all of these records as they forever became his to know and understand, with nobody being capable of ever finding out their Weavings unless they dissected him and broke his Existence down.
These Records of his held immense weight as they were a source of his power- making his Dominium even more brilliant!
{The Extremity of Fables thrives with unimaginable brilliance at your short journey that has stacked this many accolades.}
{The Extremity of Fables is ready to arrive at the Existential level at any time as at this moment...your legend is becoming Existential. Your Fable is Existential.}
His Fable.
His story.
Noah thought of his long story as he finally arrived on the other side of the Existential Bridges with his Aspects of Existence.

His body radiated tendrils of unimaginable multicolored brilliance as even though it didn't hold his Origin or Soul, it seemed like an ancient unbreakable instrument that radiated a profound Existential aura.

His Origin seemed to shimmer like a cluster of Havens surrounding a radiant infinity symbol, the rotation and gravitational of each Haven pressing a heavy Existential light on everything as the surroundings trembled!

His soul...one may not even be able to see it as it seemed almost transparent, but the shockingly oppressive Existential Dominium around it that was heavier than both the Body and the Soul combined told one singular thing.
As of this moment, Noah's Existential Soul Dominium was the strongest.
After all, it bore the weight of multiple Existential Extremities while his Body and Origin only bore the weight of their own respective Existential Extremity Authorities!
So with the Existential Soul Dominium in the lead, it took the last step.
The step that should have him advance entirely to the other side.
And the massive bridge that was holding his soul...
BOOM!
Shattered into a storm of existential authority that swirled and surged towards his Existential Soul Dominium.
BOOM! BOOM!
Two additional bridges erupted for his Body and Origin, their Existential Authorities also surging into their respective aspects as at this moment...
WUU! WUU! WUU!
A symphony of a unique power burst from each of his Aspects.
A symphony of a Dominium.
What even was an Existential Dominium? What did it grant one at this stage where they exceeded the bounds of their Extremes?!
What did-
BOOOM!

Just as Noah was in a reverie of his grand accomplishment, a shocking, pervasive, and unseen authority instantly reigned down from all around- pressing on each of Noah's Dominiums as they sought to do one thing in totality!
This force came down and transmitted its intent clearly!
|Your Dominium falls under the Existential Weavings of the Omniverse of the Great Imperium!|
|Know and realize that you are under the rule of the Great Imperium!|
|Pay obeisance to the Great Imperium!|
It pressed all around his Dominiums!

He had to give off the intent and state his obeisance to this unknown and undeniable power that was seemingly pressing down on everything- even the Aeonic Annals of Extremity of the Existential Domains of Vitalis and Vacuous!
Even though Noah's records were his own, his existence and Dominium was still present in a space where the authority of this power was spread in!
So...
|Pay obeisance to the Great Imperium!|
|Pledge your allegiance to the Great Imperium!|
HUUM!
From all around, the intent made itself clear and became even heavier the more time passed.

It didn't require anything too mighty from a recently advancing Existential Dominium Realm expert, only for them to understand and know their place, to voice out their intent acknowledging that they fell under the bounds of this power!

chapters.title: Chapter 2950 Defiance!
paragraphs: The Extremity of Tyranny was being forced to acknowledge that he fell under the banner of the Great Imperium!
Of the Existential Omniverse that this Imperium controlled!

If every single entity arriving in the stage of the Existential Dominium Realm faced this, they had to submit entirely otherwise...the pressure bearing down on them pervasively from all around would continue until they were crushed.
Coming across this situation, Noah gained a glimpse into the workings of Legacies.
Their people must have all acknowledged this Great Imperium.
They all fell under their banner as even though Legacies reigned over and controlled Existential Domains like Vitalis and Vacuous, they were all really under the Great Imperium.
In this Existential Omniverse, none could escape their area of influence.
If Noah did not acknowledge them in the next few seconds, he may not exist in this Great Imperium!
It was such a shocking progression of events that...
{The Extremity of Tyranny vehemently denies acknowledging any others!}
Noah's three Dominiums buzzed with defiance.
In this shocking development, Noah already had an idea of what he needed to do, but before he did so, he made his intent clear.
His Three Dominiums that were surrounded by clear transparent amalgamations of authority all turned up.
Towards the pressure descending all around.
Towards the intent cascading all around him.
Towards all of this...the Intent of the Weaver of Extremity rang out clearly.
|The Extremity of Quintessence will never pay obeisance to the Great Imperium!|
RUUUMBLE!
The void of existence and nonexistence trembled.
The pervasive authority all around was not cognizant, but it seemed to become utterly enraged at this moment.
But before it could do anything...
WAP!
Noah's Dominiums disappeared.
The intent from all around calmed as it didn't sense the newly forming Dominium that had yet to acknowledge the Great Imperium.
His Records had already fully retreated into him as he then returned to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

He appeared in the endlessly blue sea of the Aletheian Haven of Fantasia, his three Dominiums shining vibrantly as here...he didn't feel the pervasive intent telling him to pay obeisance to the Great Imperium!
{The Weaver of Extremity affirms the profoundness of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}
This land.
This past Spiritual Land with its own Quintessential Annals of Extremity!
It could actually exist while evading the ever present and pervasive will of something Noah didn't fully understand.
The intricate system of Legacies and those behind them...the so-called Great Imperium.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven could evade its gaze.
Only now.
Only after he stepped within his Infinite Hyperversal Haven, under the umbrella of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity...did he stop hearing her hounding voice asking for obeisance!
His Weavings bubbled and billowed.

His Three Dominiums gazed at each other with profound gazes as in the next moment, they began to feel an undeniable pull towards each other as his Existential Body, Soul, and Origin Dominiums converged towards each other!
There was a lot to unpack regarding what had just occurred, but Noah's elevation was of far more importance as he sought to understand himself and his Dominiums at this moment.
{You hold three Existential Dominiums that entered this state at the same time.}
{Your Dominiums are diverged and converged at the same time.}
{The Existential Dominium of Noah Osmont is coming to fruition!}
His Body, Origin, and Soul were ultimately all him, even under their own separate Dominiums.
{Your distinction as the Weaver of Extremity is becoming elevated.}
{Your Lineage has become Existential.}
{You have gained the advanced distinction of the Weaver of Existence.}
{The Extremity of Cheats steps in and collects all of your achievements.}
{All of your accomplishments are joining together.}
{Your Existential Dominium lays down its first Dominium Rule and applies it to your Lineage.}
{Surpassing Annals and Existence, your Lineage is being taken to embark with the distinction of an Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage.}

Towards his Dominiums that were all converging together, a blinding river of golden transparent blood erupted out and shot upwards, turning into a shower of transparent golden blood that spread across the blue sea!
But it didn't stop there.
The blood carried ancientness and wonder- threads of the Dominiums Noah carried as it spread out across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
It was the advent of Noah's Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage.
Vermillion flames could be seen around the transparent gold sea of blood spreading out as it carried the distinction of the Weaver of Extremity.
Of the Weaver of Existence.
It was a result of Noah's actions that even he did not yet understand.
It stated that his first Dominium Rule was utilized to elevate his Lineage even further towards the initial steps of barely being an Existential Omniversal Lineage.
But what was a Dominium Rule?
And just how shocking had his existence become after all this?
And just what profound a change did it mean for him to have an Existential Omniversal Lineage?!
His will boomed out as it sought to understand everything!
The Imperium Right to Challenge was displayed before Al-Abalem and Ignatius as their faces were entirely dark.
Yet even in the midst of all this, Al-Abalem kept his composure.
Things had already progressed here as they could only salvage what could be salvaged.

|Whatever information you all provided to the Imperium is just falsified weavings of Existence. I will provide accounts to the Imperium myself as your Imperium Right to Challenge...I do not have to accept it until I let the true weavings be known!|
Al-Abalem spoke with a sense of calmness and callousness.
But at his words, the smile on the Leashed Dog became even more resonant as behind him, the Veiled Herald of Flames actually floated forward and spoke.

|But O Great Archon Basileus Al-Abalem, we have gone through the proper channels to even invite an Imperium Royal Basileus to observe this. A neutral party that makes it so this Imperium practice cannot be denied.|

Her words were biting as she bowed with respect, pointing behind her as from the back of the Existential Dominium Vessels, another Vessel that was much larger and filled with much grander waves of power came forth.
A vessel of the Imperium!

{The Weaver of Extremity affirms the profoundness of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.}
This land.
This past Spiritual Land with its own Quintessential Annals of Extremity!
It could actually exist while evading the ever present and pervasive will of something Noah didn't fully understand.
The intricate system of Legacies and those behind them...the so-called Great Imperium.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven could evade its gaze.
Only now.
Only after he stepped within his Infinite Hyperversal Haven, under the umbrella of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity...did he stop hearing her hounding voice asking for obeisance!
His Weavings bubbled and billowed.

His Three Dominiums gazed at each other with profound gazes as in the next moment, they began to feel an undeniable pull towards each other as his Existential Body, Soul, and Origin Dominiums converged towards each other!
There was a lot to unpack regarding what had just occurred, but Noah's elevation was of far more importance as he sought to understand himself and his Dominiums at this moment.
{You hold three Existential Dominiums that entered this state at the same time.}
{Your Dominiums are diverged and converged at the same time.}
{The Existential Dominium of Noah Osmont is coming to fruition!}
His Body, Origin, and Soul were ultimately all him, even under their own separate Dominiums.
{Your distinction as the Weaver of Extremity is becoming elevated.}
{Your Lineage has become Existential.}
{You have gained the advanced distinction of the Weaver of Existence.}
{The Extremity of Cheats steps in and collects all of your achievements.}
{All of your accomplishments are joining together.}
{Your Existential Dominium lays down its first Dominium Rule and applies it to your Lineage.}
{Surpassing Annals and Existence, your Lineage is being taken to embark with the distinction of an Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage.}

Towards his Dominiums that were all converging together, a blinding river of golden transparent blood erupted out and shot upwards, turning into a shower of transparent golden blood that spread across the blue sea!
But it didn't stop there.
The blood carried ancientness and wonder- threads of the Dominiums Noah carried as it spread out across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
It was the advent of Noah's Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage.
Vermillion flames could be seen around the transparent gold sea of blood spreading out as it carried the distinction of the Weaver of Extremity.
Of the Weaver of Existence.
It was a result of Noah's actions that even he did not yet understand.
It stated that his first Dominium Rule was utilized to elevate his Lineage even further towards the initial steps of barely being an Existential Omniversal Lineage.
But what was a Dominium Rule?
And just how shocking had his existence become after all this?
And just what profound a change did it mean for him to have an Existential Omniversal Lineage?!
His will boomed out as it sought to understand everything!
The Imperium Right to Challenge was displayed before Al-Abalem and Ignatius as their faces were entirely dark.
Yet even in the midst of all this, Al-Abalem kept his composure.
Things had already progressed here as they could only salvage what could be salvaged.
|Whatever information you all provided to the Imperium is just falsified weavings of Existence.
I will provide accounts to the Imperium myself as your Imperium Right to Challenge...I do not have to accept it until I let the true weavings be known!|
Al-Abalem spoke with a sense of calmness and callousness.
But at his words, the smile on the Leashed Dog became even more resonant as behind him, the Veiled Herald of Flames actually floated forward and spoke.
|But O Great Archon Basileus Al-Abalem, we have gone through the proper channels to even invite an Imperium Royal Basileus to observe this.
A neutral party that makes it so this Imperium practice cannot be denied.|

Her words were biting as she bowed with respect, pointing behind her as from the back of the Existential Dominium Vessels, another Vessel that was much larger and filled with much grander waves of power came forth.
A vessel of the Imperium!

chapters.title: Chapter 2951 The Mantis, the Cicada, and the Oriole! I
paragraphs: The practice of Imperium Rules stretched out over the eons.
They were there because the profits of the Imperium mattered more than all others.
If Legacies were poorly running their Existential Domains, other Legacies could observe this and undergo proper procedures to strip them of this right and take their Domain for themselves.
If they could convince the Imperium that as Rulers, they were better. That in the long run, they would take in more profit for the Imperium!
Thus, at times, representatives of the Imperium would stand in observance for Domains they deemed of some importance.
If they were shifting rulership in Legacies, they would be there.
It was just that...Al-Abalem never expected to be on the opposing end of a situation like this!
First, a Corrupted Seed rose that caused him to lose a great deal of his profits.
He was forced to utilize the Codex of Extremity as even now, its authority was being encroached upon evermore!
And now, another Legacy appeared to challenge him for his rulership, and an Imperium Royal Basileus was even invited to observe!
Why had his contact at the Imperium not warned him of anything?
And how did they collect information to give to the Imperium that deemed it worthy to even have an Imperium Royal Basileus Observer here?
When he arrived at this thought, his eyes flashed brilliantly as his Will looked at the Basileus of the Ignatius.
He then flashed his awareness over the Basileus around him, his daughter included as his eyes flashed with a chilling light!
Was there a traitor among any of them? And what would they even have to gain if their Legacies fell and no longer reigned over an Existential Domain?!
They would lose one of the safest and most profitable methods of attaining Fruits of Existence.
Al-Abalem thought of many things while he, Ignatius, and all other Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem and Ignatius bowed towards the Imperium Vessel.
The vessel was triangular in nature, lined with pulsing gold and purple lights as a blinding slit on it opened to reveal a graceful man adorned in a golden purple robe.
His golden hair was sleek as he had a cane in his hands with a blinding Scripture that signified {IMPERIUM}!
It radiated an Existential Dominium light itself as this was a killing weapon that could oppress a common Existential Dominium Realm expert with a tap.
They bowed towards such a being as Ignatius and Al-Abalem spoke towards him.

|We live and we die for the Imperium. We pay respect to the Imperium Royal Basileus, but we wish it was under better circumstances! We never expected the names of our Legacies to be besmirched so much that they would even waste the time of the Observer.|
Al-Abalem and Ignatius bowed their heads briefly before rising as no matter the situation, the Imperium had to always be respected.
The Imperium had to always be placed above all else.
After all, the day they became entities of the Existential Dominium Realm, they pledged obeisance to the Great Imperium!
The Imperium Royal Basileus nodded with a graceful smile towards all beings here as his intent flowed out with calmness and majesty.

|Ignore my presence here, for I am only here to ensure impartiality- that no Legacy will be bullied into anything. Though some concerns were raised, so I will be here to observe the Contest of the Rule of Imperium Telos between the Legacy of Lethith and the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius. Which Contest do you wish to proceed with first?|
Words that nobody else could deny.
Words that made it clear the Rule of Imperium Telos would be carried out today!
The Imperium Royal Basileus asked...which Contest do they wish to proceed with first?
This was because the Rule of Imperium Telos consisted of three Contests.
The one challenged had to lose 2 of these 3 contests before they lost ownership of their Existential Domain!
If they instead won the contest against their challengers, they would instead win ownership of the Existential Domain of the Challenger.
With the Rule of Imperium Telos, they had to prove two of three things!
The first and foremost was that the power of the Archon Basileus themselves reigned supreme.

The second was to present the database of their past tributes, current tributes, and a stipulation of future tributes comparative to what their challengers would be able to provide if they were reigning over this same Existential Domain!
In this case, Al-Abalem and Ignatius would present their future stipulations along with Archon Basileus Lethith, and the grander stipulation would win.

This was the most abstruse contest to win as one wouldn't know what the other side could offer in their tributes of Fruits of Existence...and this was why all Archons kept large reserves of Fruits of Existence in hand.

In the case their rule was ever challenged, they would be wealthy enough to offer a high tribute in a Rule of Imperium Telos, and they would win the Domain of anyone who challenged them for the next few eons to recoup any losses!
This was how crucial Fruits of Existence were.
This was why using so many for the activation of the Codex of Extremity and subsequent losses over the last 2 days of Mors Apokalypsis...this was extremely deadly.
The face of Al-Abalem was cold as he thought of this.
His enemies must have been given information that foretold of his recent expenses.
Otherwise, they wouldn't be confident in exceeding him so greatly in wealth and tributes.
But these two Contests in the Rule of Imperium Telos, there was the third and final one.
This was commonly referred to by Archons as the Will of the Imperium.
Because it involved the Dominiums of the challenging Archon and the challenged Archon to be infused into the Codex of Extremity residing over the Existential Domain.
The Codex of Extremity granted by the Imperium!
The Codex held shocking weavings as it could choose itself who the better Archon to preside over it would be!
