chapters.title: Chapter 2952 The Mantis, the Cicada, and the Oriole! II
paragraphs: The Imperium stated that the Codex was impartial in this as nobody was favored...but very few Archons believed it.
This was why they called the last Contest...the Will of the Imperium.
It may very well be what the Imperium chose if one Archon lost favor with them.
But so long as one won the prior two Contests, the third Contest of the Codex wouldn't even matter!
So it was one's power that was the decider...and one's wealth.
Today, the power and wealth of the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius would be tested- and it was at the worst time imaginable!
Al-Abalem turned his gaze towards Ignatius as the darkness around this entity was just as obscure.
He then felt his connection with the Codex of Extremity...and observed that in the time wasted to stand before everyone here, the encroachment had only increased.
It meant that the Supernal and Nether Havens of Vitalis connected to the Codex of Extremity were already encroached upon for the most part.
And soon, he had an inkling that the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains would follow if nothing was done.
These dogs were sniffing around his Domain trying to fight for it when at this very moment, there was an infestation eating it up from below!
His eyes were sharp as he spoke out.

|I have no issues beginning with the First Contest. But before that, my words were true that as guests...you all came at a bad time. I currently have the Codex of Extremity under my control for this Domain actively in use to take care of something. I need to tend to it as the Rule of Imperium Telos can be carried out after a day at most.|
If he had the time, he could take care of it.

He couldn't let them know he intended to descend himself and violate the absolute restrictions- this being an action that would hurt the Existential Domain itself as it wouldn't produce Fruits of Existence for 9 eons!
This would be considered a failure by the Imperium as it had to remain a secret until-

|Haha, the great Archon Basileus Al-Abalem seeks for more time? The excuse is the Codex of Extremity currently being in use? Would you use that time to try and have your Dominium influence it to your favor for the Third Contest? I do not think so...|
The Leashed Dog spat out with a smile.
And yet, shrouded in Existential Vacuous Authority, Ignatius replied.

|You...we have been dealing with something concerning the workings of the Existential Domain itself. Our presence is needed to ensure its workings. You wouldn't be able to bear the responsibility of anything that happened because of us being held by such unworthy contests!| The eyes of Archon Basileus Ignatius blazed as he seemed to be about to reveal some things and speak even more, but Al-Abalem roused his intent to stop this.
Ignatius did not know about the worsening situation and the Codex of Extremity.
He couldn't reveal any critical information right now as whether he would be given extra time or not...would depend on a single entity.
His eyes moved and came to land on the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer.
Not just his eyes, but the eyes of Basileus around him, those from the Legacy of Ignatius, and those from the Legacy of Lethith!
The golden haired entity shimmering with gold and purple brilliance took in all gazes without faltering as he spoke while stroking his cane.

|It is all right. I, as the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer today, swear by the Imperium that any possible consequential weavings of the Codex of Extremity and the Lands of Vitalis and Vacuous it presides over fall to me. I will bear the responsibility for any issues caused by the delay in tending to the Codex as Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and Ignatius state, and the first two Contests can begin first.|
The purple golden eyes of this man smiled calmly as Al-Abalem stared at him coldly.

From the perspective of all those here, they knew nothing could possibly happen with the Codex or the Lands before them as they thought...Al-Abalem and Ignatius were simply trying to buy time to seek a way out of this!
They wouldn't even give them the time.
And Al-Abalem stared between the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer and the visage of the Leashed Dog and the Veiled Herald of Flames behind him as he callously wondered.

Just how many Fruits of Existence did this give this Observer for him to be on their side this much? Did they want his Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains this much that they would leave him no way out?!
|Very well...|
WAA!
His intent weaved out with immense calmness.
The eyes of many lit up after this as they were ready for a show.
But the eyes of Archon Basileus Al-Abalem were filled with utmost coldness as he knew things nobody here would know.
He knew of the encroachment of the Codex of Extremity- undoubtedly by the Corrupted Seed that was giving it so much trouble.
He knew that the encroachment of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domain...was nearly complete as the Codex was calling out to him to intervene!
And yet...
And yet...!
If the Legacy of Lethith spent so much to the extent of even bribing an Imperium Royal Basileus Observer on their side for this venture, if they really wanted to take away what was his...
The eyes of Al-Abalem burned with heavy and Existential decisiveness at this moment.
And then...he let go.
He couldn't win the contest of wealth.
He should be able to win the contest of strength as the Leashed Dog couldn't entirely compare to him.
But the moment they went to the Third Contest and saw the state of the Codex of Extremity...he would lose this contest right away.
He would lose his right to rule these Existential lands!
If they really wanted to take what was his...
If they really wanted to proceed...he would have them feel as much pain!
WAA!
|Since the Observer has stated that he would take all responsibility, we can proceed.|
All of their Dominiums had recorded what the Observer had stated.
Any changes or losses incurred by the encroachment of the Codex of Extremity...would not fall under his responsibility from this moment onwards!
HUUM!
Even as he spoke, his Existential Soul Dominium buzzed as he sensed the Encroachment of the Codex of Extremity starting from the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
He kept his emotions from expressing their intent as his eyes hardened, steeling his resolve.
But still...
What the fuck was this Noah Osmont doing that he was moving so quickly to cause all pieces to fall apart?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2953 The Mantis, the Cicada, and the Oriole! III
paragraphs: What was Noah Osmont doing to make everything deteriorate so quickly?
The question wasn't so much for him as it was for what his Extremes were doing in conjunction with his Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
While far above them, Basileus of Legacies and Basileus of the Imperium were conducting their own weavings, Noah and his extremes moved earnestly to achieve their intents.
{The Analysis of the Nether Haven of Andromeda has been pushed to 100%}
{This last Haven of Vitalis will now begin its assimilation into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!}
The last Haven within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domain.
This was how stupendously fast the process was made as the Extremity of Cheats coursed all extremes within Noah for multiple purposes!
And the change brought by this was something nobody could have anticipated.

The Infinite Hyperversal Haven had received an influx of an Existential Domain, its Aletheian Havens being rapidly stretched while new ones formed as its size was constantly multiplying in the last minutes.
Seas of existential authority coursed around it as when the last Haven within Vitalis was being devoured and assimilated by it after Dungeon Breaks had occurred...
{The Weavings of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven have exceeded any type of Haven.}
{Its Source had undergone too many advancements and alterations.}
{It carries within it threads of Weavings of Existence and Extremes, its makeup consisting of many more Extremes than any other.}
{If the Concepts within its makeup all become Existential, it is unknown what results such a phenomenon would bring forth.}
If the concepts within its makeup became Existential!
This was referring to Relativity, Manadynamics, Entropy, and all the other pillars of laws or Decreta that made up the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Just what land would it become if such a thing happened?
This was at a time when even the distinction it held this whole time...was also about to change.
{The Infinite Hyperversal Haven is burning with a new distinction as its Source undergoes a Quintessential advancement.}
{The weavings of the Codex of Extremity are becoming incorporated into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!}
{From the ashes of a Spiritual Land, the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed is being born.}
A heavy and utterly shocking prompt came.
A prompt that the moment it appeared, a transcendental radiance bloomed across these fantastical lands where the blood of the Existential Omniversal Emperor had begun to spread!

A heavy, unimaginable, and utterly unfathomable brilliance began to bud all around as truly and without a doubt, the words {Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed} were now attached to what used to be a small floating Spiritual Land.
How did things get here?
What source did this Spiritual Seed have that after the ceaseless advancements Noah brought to it, it even dared to take on the distinction of an Omniversal Seed?!
It was a profound question, but it held no answers at this moment.
But at the time such a thing began to occur, the construct that was having its source encroached upon...no longer sat still.
Within the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.

The land isolated away from everything- the land where the Legacy of Al-Abalem resided in!

The choice was made.
The weavings of Records, Extremes, and Existence began to move as at this moment, a shocking change began in the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
CRACK!

Existence shuddered as in the flaming white skies, a gulf of darkness appeared as from it, the bodies of dozens of Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity were pulled down as if it were outside of their control.

White Dikastes below.
Obsidian Dikastes above.

Dozens of them converged towards a central point as the light of the Codex of Extremity filled with Existential might covered them- their massive bodies forcibly brought together towards a single singularity!
Dozens of Bodies of Dikastes of Extremity...mashed together as Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities mixed and yet were separate at the same time.
But from the cluster of Dikastes of Extremity being mashed together...
HUUM!
The aura of a Dominium began to buzz.
With the bodies of multiple Dikastes of Extremity as fuel, an Existential Body Dominium began to radiate outwards with a heavy light!

BOOM!

{The analysis of the weavings of the eradicated target has reached 100%}
{The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Lesser Mimeisthai Henry, will now be called out to work under the banner of the Extremity of Loot.}
Dazzling prompts came.
But this wasn't the biggest thing for Henry.
The biggest thing was that apart from the profound aura of Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence coursing through his body, he began to feel the budding of another.
One whose source...wasn't entirely on his father.
{The purity afforded by your budding Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage grants you boundless boons.}
{First and foremost, your Lineage can currently hold the weight of an Existential Extremity Authority.}
{Your Lineage spurs the concept you define yourself with the most.}
{The Extremity of Destiny is painted with the glory of the Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage as it treks towards the Existential level.}
Henry's body shuddered as shockingly, he felt a new Existential Extremity Authority forming from the concept he knew too well.
Destiny...went towards the Existential level.
Under the banner of the Son of Destiny.
Ushered forth by the budding Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage!
{The Existential Extremity of Destiny has been recorded down in the creed of the Lineage of the Existential Omniversal Emperor.}

This prompt appeared before Henry in a dazzling fashion as around him, the extremes of other Defenders of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed rose in power as their existence became all that much more prominent when the effects of Noah's lineage descended!
One after another, the remaining Lesser Mimeisthais began to fall.
And for each one that fell, an Existential Illusory Weaving of them was made as they joined the ranks of Noah's invisible army!

An army that at this very moment felt their Sources also be affected by the elevation of their Mater, the changes brought forth by his entry into the Existential Dominium Realm simply being too grand.
And the changes expressed so far were truly just the tip of the iceberg.

Surrounded by an endless cerulean sea and a churning Lineage promising untold glories, Noah himself felt the weavings of Extremes and Existence burst intricately wrapping around him, prompts continuing to descend!
{The distinctions of the Weaver of Extremity and Weaver of Existence are not simple ones.}
{Paired with the emergence of your Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage, your very being demands desires to live up to its extreme!}
HUUM!
His body began to emit a resonance.
A vibration of immense power of all that was him- with his Haki filled with multicolored grandeur spreading outwards!
{The Existential Omniversal Emperor releases the valor of his Dominium!}
His Dominium, containing his will, extremes, and existence boomed out.
It was heavy.
It was undeniable.
His people heard it.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed heard it!
Those who heard it and were aligned with him felt their closeness towards the Existential Omniversal Emperor as their existence felt a sense of safety and power.
As for others...
HUUM!
It stretched out towards the empty void of existence where Vitalis used to be.
To the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains that he had now begun to devour!
And they even stretched out towards the Archaeos Vitalis and Vacuous Pylos.
As if his Dominium was a call that had to be answered.
The sensation was so profound for Noah as he remembered his own words not too long ago.
His own prophecy.
{Waters crossed with unimaginable speed.
Immeasurable extremes all brought under a single creed.
One by one, Legacies shall fall.
White and black will come under the heel of the call.
Only one Extreme will be left at the end of it all.
Unshackled lands will rise above Recorded Havens.
Annals will fall as an endless weaving awakens!}
His Dominium had just asserted itself and called out to everything around it as...
{The Vitalis Annals of Extremity tremble at the sheer weight of your Dominium.}
{The Vacuous Annals of Extremity tremble at the sheer weight of your Dominium!}
The integral part behind the Existential Domains themselves!
The Annals that recorded their existence!
They normally had the Dominium of two Archons Basileus protecting them.
But today, they held no protectors.
{The Aeonic Annals of Extremity are unable to resist the weight of your Dominium!}
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed hungrily gazes at the Annals overseeing the makeup of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.}
His Dominium spread out as his construct asserted itself.
And a moment later, weavings of Records- weavings of Annals themselves...began to be drawn towards Noah and his Omniversal Seed!
{The breakdown, refinement, and assimilation of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity has begun.}
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed is accepting the fuel of its existence with ease!}
An unbelievable new reality opened up as Noah was observing all of this with his blazing Dominiums.
He wanted to know the cause and effect of everything happening.
What it meant that it was happening.
He wanted to...understand his weavings at this moment.
{The Weaver of Existence reads the flow of Existence.}
{The Weaver of Extremity reads the flow of Extremes.}
Waves of authority surged around him as information began to flow.
{Your path is illustrious as your foundation erupts to establish quintessential Dominiums.}
{Those standing against your path are scattered and away from their Domains, the tendrils of the Imperium inadvertently interfering as their entry allowed your path to be even smoother.}
His eyes became sharper.
His enemies were away from their Domains?
His will was bright.

He wanted to set off into the empty homes of his enemies right away, but he remembered the intent of the Great Imperium that would surround him if he weren't in the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
He had to veil himself and not be discerned by the intent of the Great Imperium first!
And the answer to this...lay in nothing else but the newly emerging Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2955 The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed! I
paragraphs: The Existential Dominium Realm.
Dominium Rules.
His Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage. The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

All of these things were intricately connected, and Noah's main purpose and distinction was to truly understand all of them as first, he had to understand the Omniversal Seed that gave him refuge from the Intent of the Imperium.
So his main body buzzed as he left the wondrous blue sea and followed the weavings of his connection to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

After all of his records were receded into him, even the Quintessential Annals of Extremity held nothing regarding him as everything was his own, but he could still feel the complex connection his existence had with the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- and even more clearly than ever before!
He felt it weaving across his Dominiums.
Across his Extremes.
But most of all, he felt it resonate and tightly interlock with his Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage.
An Omniversal Lineage. An Omniversal Seed.

The two seemed like interlocking components as through such a connection, Noah delved into the depths of the constantly changing Omniversal Seed as the weavings of Reality distorted a moment later, his visage appearing in a domain filled with high concentrations of Existential Extremity Authorities.
Extremity Rune Scriptures in the hundreds of millions swam freely as they became components that formed blazing multicolored rivers swirling around like cosmic snakes.
Scriptures of Manadynamics could be seen amongst them.
So could Entropy, Genesis, Helios, Polarity, Dreams, Dissolution, Avalon, and many others.
They all formed into massive raging rivers that circled this domain, but all of them converged towards a single central point as if they were a cluster of wires plugging into a circuit board!
And the circuit board...was the place Noah's feet touched as it was a flat island made of extremely pure authority.
Filled with an assortment of colors, it pulsed with waves of Existential Extremity Authorities every single moment as the most profound thing was the purity of this authority.
It didn't belong to any specific extreme, but it was Existential!
This whole island he stood on was Existential, and yet the authorities coursing into it were all the past Natural Laws, Havenly and Infernal authorities, and Decreta.
As if at any moment, this pure Existential light could flow back from this island and make the extremes converging onto it Existential themselves!
In such a place, Noah saw that at the very center, all the converging authority was flustered to form a single multicolored throne radiating existential brilliance.
Noah's eyes flashed with the weavings of existence and extremes as he instantly knew what he was looking at.

{Seed of an Existential Omniversal Throne}:: A starting point, but also an end. Very few, if any, existences are able to sit on a throne like this. Its weight is too heavy. Its authority is too immaculate. On it, what one could do is boundless...
A simple introduction to such a dazzling throne.
And beside it, the figure of a manifestation of a woman with utterly unrealistic beauty could be seen.

Fair skin, lustrous locks of hair shining gold, red, green, white, black, and many other colors. A dress that seemed to be constructed from all the flowing authorities of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- with it extending into a robe that radiated streams of authority down into the vibrant pure land they stood on!
The Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed appeared and took light steps to arrive beside Noah, her hands reaching out towards his right.
Noah gazed at her closely before stretching his right hand out, and she took it into her hands while coming to kneel before him!
HUUM!
A glorious melody boomed out as utter brilliance unfolded.
{The Weavings of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed resonate with your existence, being yours alone to control!}
{Your Dominiums are connected to an unfathomable construct of Existence, and are beginning to anneal and expand further due to it.}
The brilliance was heart shaking.
The scene was one that nobody else would ever come to see.
Looking at the kneeling figure of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, Noah's intent ebbed out lightly.
|What are you, truly?|
What was she?
One could really just say she was a floating Spiritual Land from a Minor World.

But at the same time, this was the truth. There were many other Spiritual Lands just like it, with his people even obtaining rulership over those Spiritual Lands from the Beast World eventually as well.
But none of them had made even a fraction of a percentage of what Noah had made the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed turn out to be.
So it meant, Noah and the actions he took were one of the Prime factors that allowed what lay before him to appear!
But for this land to do what it was doing now. To take on the identity of an Omniversal Seed it was taking on now. Too capable of blanketing Noah from the intent of the Imperium. Surely...

The voice from the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was calm and filled with sweetness as she rose from her kneeling position, taking Noah's hand forward as she led him towards the dazzling Seed of an Existential Omniversal Throne.

|I am whatever Master chooses to make of me. You could break me down into nothing, or you could elevate me even further. Without you, there wouldn't be a budding Omniversal Seed. I am merely a product of your own achievements...if there is anything apart from that, if there is anything on the origins of the Spiritual Lands, then even I am not privy to it.|
WAA!
The words were filled with brilliance and authority, Noah gazing deeply into the multicolored pupils of this Entity before him as she led him to stand in front of the dazzling throne!
He could feel its pulsing existential authority.
He could feel its connection to the vast Havens within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
He could feel a boundless authority waiting for him the moment he sat down on this throne!

A glorious melody boomed out as utter brilliance unfolded.
{The Weavings of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed resonate with your existence, being yours alone to control!}
{Your Dominiums are connected to an unfathomable construct of Existence, and are beginning to anneal and expand further due to it.}
The brilliance was heart shaking.
The scene was one that nobody else would ever come to see.
Looking at the kneeling figure of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, Noah's intent ebbed out lightly.
|What are you, truly?|
What was she?
One could really just say she was a floating Spiritual Land from a Minor World.
But at the same time, this was the truth.
There were many other Spiritual Lands just like it, with his people even obtaining rulership over those Spiritual Lands from the Beast World eventually as well.
But none of them had made even a fraction of a percentage of what Noah had made the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed turn out to be.
So it meant, Noah and the actions he took were one of the Prime factors that allowed what lay before him to appear!
But for this land to do what it was doing now.
To take on the identity of an Omniversal Seed it was taking on now.
Too capable of blanketing Noah from the intent of the Imperium.
Surely...

The voice from the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was calm and filled with sweetness as she rose from her kneeling position, taking Noah's hand forward as she led him towards the dazzling Seed of an Existential Omniversal Throne.
|I am whatever Master chooses to make of me.
You could break me down into nothing, or you could elevate me even further.
Without you, there wouldn't be a budding Omniversal Seed.
I am merely a product of your own achievements...if there is anything apart from that, if there is anything on the origins of the Spiritual Lands, then even I am not privy to it.|
WAA!
The words were filled with brilliance and authority, Noah gazing deeply into the multicolored pupils of this Entity before him as she led him to stand in front of the dazzling throne!
He could feel its pulsing existential authority.
He could feel its connection to the vast Havens within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
He could feel a boundless authority waiting for him the moment he sat down on this throne!

chapters.title: Chapter 2956 The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed! II
paragraphs: |In this Omniverse and whatever else lies out there, you are the only one who can sit on the Seed of this Existential Omniversal Throne, and the only one who could allow it to sprout from a Seed. When that day comes, what can Legacies do? What can this so-called Imperium do?|
The words of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed carried a hint of tyranny within them as she motioned for Noah to take a seat on a shocking convergence of power!
There was never a question.

The connection between them transcended Records, with Noah's Dominium and Lineage constantly resonating with the seat of power behind him as with the beckoning of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, he proceeded to sit down!
HUUM!
Magisterial brilliance unfolded.
Noah's Existence gained a glimpse of just how profound the product of the distant Spiritual Land was.
For it to claim to be an Omniversal Seed!
As waves of information flowed across his mind, the voice of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed rang out.

{From the Weavings of Vitalis and Vacuous that I have swallowed, including their Annals, it shows that Existential Domains are unique singularities across the Omniverse that have the potential to support the growth and cultivation of Dominiums.}

{This potential more commonly comes in the form of Fruits of Existence, but as with everything, it is a limited resource. Eventually, it runs out, and eventually, the number of Dominiums that an Existential Domain can potentially grow becomes capped. That is, unless something is changed. Unless an alteration occurs.}
An alteration!
An intervention of how the Existential Domains operated!
This was where Legacies and the Great Imperium came in!

{I am breaking down the workings of the Existential Domains and the usage of the Codex of Extremity as I continue to encroach upon it, but the most important gain to observe due to the advancement of becoming an Omniversal Seed and swallowing Existential Domains...is this.}
While Noah was seated on his throne.
The fair hands of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed rose as on top of them, translucent light began to gather.
But it wasn't just that.
The transparent light held a hue of gold as it all mixed together rapidly atop the radiant hands, ultimately beginning to form a dazzling Fruit of Existence!
And it wasn't just a normal Fruit of Existence, but...

{A Quintessential Fruit of Existence. The capability of forming such a thing lies solely with an Existential Domain, with this type of Fruit being considered unique as some domains that are highly prized can produce different ones. Of course, then there is Master. There is your Omniversal Emperor Lineage.}
WAA!
As the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was speaking, Noah was already delving deeper into himself as he gazed at his Forge.
It could not produce Fruits of Existence, or even shards of it before.
But now...

{You hold the distinction of an Existential Omniversal Lineage. Within your Blood now flows an existential light that should allow for the accumulation of Existential Authority that can then be utilized by you, or if Master wishes for it, elevate and transform this Existential Authority into the form of Quintessential Fruits of Existence within your very being. Within your Forge. Within the peaks of your Aletheian Havens...}
The boons of an Existential Omniversal Lineage!
The generation of Existential Authority within one's being, and yet Noah could go even further than this and seek to elevate the quality of this authority through his own means!
He held the Extremity of Loot.
He held Quintessence.
He held Plot, and he held Cheats!
So why would he not be able to do this?!
{In addition to all of this, Master, there is also this...}
The eyes of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed pulsed with a radiant translucent light- a light that within it, Noah observed the flash of black and white.
And by the time it settled on him...
{Your Dominium is wrapped in the budding Omniversal light of your Lineage, and now also the Omniversal light of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.}
{The Omniversal light of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed can mimic the recognized existential authorities of the Imperium as it takes on the weavings of Vitalis and Vacuous.}
The quandary Noah was in within the last few minutes.
The fact that there was the thing called the Imperium that he knew nothing of- and it was seeking his obeisance!

The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed truly was the answer as its profound light covered Noah, his eyes rising with an air of Tyranny as a moment later, his body pulsed to release a figure that looked just like him.
Yet it was more robust.
It was more built as its fair chest was bare, lines of golden brilliance covering it as the eyes of this body of his let out a fiendish light.
It was his Existential Body Dominium.
Covered by the light of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, it took a single step and disappeared.

The next time it came to, it was already across multiple veils of existence and nonexistence as Noah's visage stared at a massive runic circle where not too long ago, he had seen the weavings of a Dikastes of Extremity go towards.
His body, surrounded by the mimicking light of Vitalis, passed through this barrier easily as he continued forward!

With another step, he traversed easily until he arrived at the next opposition that showed a dazzling white Runic circle stretching out endlessly, the shapes and forms of Dikastes of Extremity outline before him as only by being recognized and passing through this could one enter a special place.
The Archaeos Vitalis Pylos!
Noah looked at such a barrier as his Body flexed his muscles.
His enemies were not in their homes.
For this, he would thank the Imperium.
And he would also use this chance to Loot it!
HUUM!
His Dominium buzzed.
His Dominium was his body.
And just what did it mean to have an Existential Body Dominium? Noah wanted to experience this first hand!

chapters.title: Chapter 2957 A Breach! I
paragraphs: Dominium.
Above the Gradations of Extremity!
When Noah crossed the Existential Bridges with his Aspects of Existence, they shattered and eventually joined with him to make up his Dominium.
This...was what happened with his Main Body.
But, there was also his manifestation in the waters of the Gradations of Extremity.
Here, he saw an entirely different scene!
Above the waters of the Gradations of Extremity, he crossed an unsurpassable layer to arrive...at an endless sky.
There was no ceiling above him as it seemed to stretch out endlessly, but with his Dominium...he could feel that this was only an illusion.

A scene that the Codex of Extremity was displaying as it intricately connected the weavings of what was known as the Existential Domain of Vitalis and Vacuous to this conception of the Gradations of Extremity and what lay above it!
For all entities arising within these lands, they would be ascending the same Gradations of Extremity.
Their records and existence would benefit these Gradations and these Existential Domains.
This was why the tools of the Basileus moved within the Ninth Gradation, and there were even branches where pure Existential Authority converged into Fruits of Existence there!
Above it, the endless sky showed the purest streams of Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities as even further past all of this, Noah could see an illusion of a massive book.
Of an interminable Codex.
It was far from this location as it was within the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos!

The moment he came to this thought, the illusion of the endless sky seemed to shatter as in the distance, he saw an overlap of a massive white Runic circle with the shapes and forms of the Dikastes of Extremity.
As if reality was breaking down, he even saw the vision of his Existential Body Dominium that was staring at the same scene as he sought to enter the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos!
And at such a reality, his Dominium buzzed as he spoke.
{Swallow it all.}
HUUM!

The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed heard his call as its radiance erupted through him, reaching down to the distant waters of the Gradations of Extremity below and the illusion of the endless skies above- intent on swallowing everything.
There was no doubt a genuine endless sky and an endless path for Existential Dominiums in the Omniverse.
What he saw now...was merely a manifested replica meant for this Existential Domain by the means of the Imperium!
He would swallow it all.
And he would see just what grand construct his Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed could produce instead.
And as a devouring light emanating from him, his vision overlapped with his Existential Body Dominium staring at the massive runic magic circle as his right hand moved towards it!
Just his hand.
But his hand was a part of his Dominium.
And he was finally able to grasp a sense of what it meant for one to form their Dominium.
It seemed like a roadmap of Existence.
On this road, one's Existence flowed, one's Extremes flowed, and one's Records flowed.
The weight of the weavings of all three flowed in this roadmap that was a Dominium as thereafter, it went even further to enhance and elevate all three!
To give everything an Existential Authority.
Even if a concept had not attained Existential might, its extreme could be expressed with a false sense of Existential Authority within one's Dominium!
This was one of its profound wonders, but its true terror lay in the true meaning of Dominium itself.
A dominion of control or ownership.
Wherever one's Dominium fell, they would have that space of Existence fall entirely under the authority of their Extremes.
Of the weavings of their Existential Authorities!
In their Dominiums, they could traverse anywhere at will, and express and lay out absolute restrictions on these Domains at will.
One could bend the temporal continuum and the weavings of Existence, Extremities, and Records within their Dominiums!
If strong enough, one could reject who had entry into their Dominiums.

The basis of the power of one's Dominium lay in the fact that with their own Existence, Extremes, and Records being the limitation, they could effectively have absolute control over themselves and all the areas their Dominium covered- any aspects that defined them and their surroundings, including reality, perception, and existence itself!
The stronger one's Dominium was, the more control they held. This was why for many of those in the Existential Dominium Realm, they advanced one Dominium as much as possible- and endlessly at that.
So long as their Dominium was stronger than their enemies, they would completely warp existence, records, and extremes to their will and come out on top.
A few instances where even if one's Dominium was slightly stronger, one with a weaker Dominium could theoretically win.
Some of these factors included the weight of one's Records...and their Existential Extremity Authorities.
If an Extremity was particularly astounding and sitting far above others, it could bridge the gap of Dominiums- as long as this gulf wasn't too large!
With this information flowing in his mind, Noah's fingers came in contact with the massive solidified circular runic circle.
Around the edges of his body, a thin layer of transparent white light could barely be discerned as his Dominium remained retracted around him.
The transparent white light in front of his fingers then shone with tremendous radiance as he felt the exertion of his Existential Body Dominium.
At this moment, it seemed to express a single intent.
|Unstoppable|
HUUM!
This was the intent of his body!
And his newly risen Existential Extremity Authority of the Body blared with a cry, Tyranny joining in along with all of Noah's extremes- whether they were existential or not!
All of them went towards achieving the existence and intent of |Unstoppable| that his Body urged forth.
His muscular visage became ever magnified as if he were merely flexing his muscles!
And...
CRACK!
The massive solidified runic circle before Noah began to shatter as if it were made of mere glass.

chapters.title: Chapter 2958 A Breach! II
paragraphs: Like shards of glass, everything fell apart!
The protective boundary preventing entry to the Archons Vitalis Pylos entirely shattered from the mere fingers of Noah's coming in contact with them as in the next moment...
The intent of his Dominium remained.
It still warped existence to state the simple fact that it was unstoppable as a moment later, it continued forward.

Breaking apart any and all obstacles as even the records of space seemed to twist, a blinding expanse of whiteness already appearing before Noah's eyes as it was none other than the outline of Archaeos Vitalis Pylos!
Basileus Amelusa was standing beside dozens of other Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem as they gazed at the blinding mass of black and white in the skies being controlled by the Codex of Extremity.
|Why would the Codex go as far as to utilize the constructs of the Dikastes of Extremity...|
Her silver white hair blazed with brilliance, but her question didn't receive any answer as all Basileus here had many confounding worries!
First, an enemy Legacy appeared as the Archon and strongest Basileus went to represent their Legacy.
But they knew the conflict would only be removed by the Archons themselves as they could only wait to hear the resolution!
But not too long ago, they felt foreign Dominiums spread out momentarily and call out its glory.
What exactly was happening out there for foreign Dominiums to be so bold as to spread their brilliance here?

At such an atmosphere, behind the earthen clouds around them, a massive spherical building opened up as regal Basileus adorned in white clothes flew out, their distinction being high as they were the Ladies of Al-Abalem!
Nine of them stepped out as each was more beautiful than the last, their eyes brimming their Soul Dominiums as the leading one spoke out.
|No need to fret about when it comes to this. The Archon will take care of things as he always has, and the Codex is simply following its normal workings as it adjusts to the Corrupted Seeds below.|
Her voice was filled with authority as the dozens of Basileus gathered atop the radiant white clouds nodded respectfully at this leading member of the Ladies of Al-Abalem.
|Yes, Basileus Moraine.|
She was acknowledged as she gazed towards the distant flaming skies with sharp eyes.
She was not worried.
Their Legacy was a grand one.
One that stretched out for eons as any trials they came across, they weathered through.
No other Legacy could shake them of their foundations, nor could a meaningless Corrupted Seed in the lands below them do anything to jeorpa-
BOOM...CRACK!
All thoughts and intents were stopped in the next instant as it felt like the lands below them cracked, the white clouds churning and exploding out with indomitable force in the distance!

Their wills shockingly gazed out towards this area as white clouds of Vitalis roiled and dispersed as if an unfathomable beast was bursting through them, this whole area vibrating and shaking as if it were a membranous layer that did not want to be entered!
And yet...
BOOM!
Another explosion resounded as the white clouds dispersed to form billowing steam.
As if they were being burnt away at the sheer pressure alone.
And rising from the bottom, the visage of an Entity rose up with unstoppable momentum.
A visage that whipped its head to instantly hone in on the dazzling manifestation of a Codex above the skies filled with white flames.
A visage that also came to lock on to the distant figures of the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem, and the endless stretch of a celestial city behind them filled with massive spherical structures!
A visage that the Basileus also came to lock on with incredulity.
They saw the definition of a man, his figure tall and proud as his body was sculpted like an ancient emperor!

Radiant obsidian pants were the only thing covering him as his fair chest was bare, tendrils of gold coursing across it as one could appreciate the distinct hue of a white Dominium wrapping around his body.
The two sides gazed at each other in a moment of shocking silence, the Basileus nearly frozen from Incredulity as what they were seeing shouldn't be possible!
But it was reality.
Something had come up from below.
The Existential Annal barrier distancing them from the Vitalis Hyperversal Domain was just shattered- they heard that clearly before this being appeared.
Thus, his origin was clear.
Not from the outside.
But from within the very same lands they oversaw.
He was no Basileus.
He didn't belong to any Legacy.
He should be...a Seed!
And the only Seed that had been the root of problems was none other than...
|Noah...Osmont!|
The words stemmed out of Basileus Amelusa as they were filled with a sense of disbelief.
She wasn't even sure if it was exactly this Corrupted Seed that the Codex of Extremity was initiated for, but she and all others could instinctively feel it!
But this was what made it all that much more unbelievable.
How could a Corrupted Seed be here? And even more unbelievable, why would they have the white glow indicative of the early stages of an Existential Dominium Realm entity?!
It was a surreal weaving of Existence, and yet after the intent of Basileus Amelusa spread out, the being far ahead of them smiled devilishly as he didn't deny this intent!

And a moment later...his visage actually continued its unstoppable momentum as it began to surge towards them, their Dominium Souls gazing at this in shock as some Basileus instinctively moved a step back before their common sense kicked in.
|Blasphemous!|
WAA!
Who were they?
What were they?
And what was this being before them?!
He was just a Seed! And they...were the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem!
Between the two sides, there was no comparison.
The glow of white Dominium Souls began to rouse as after a moment of disbelief, the Basileus of Al-Abalem reacted to the unauthorized entry of a Corrupted Seed!

sentences.text: Like shards of glass, everything fell apart!
The protective boundary preventing entry to the Archons Vitalis Pylos entirely shattered from the mere fingers of Noah's coming in contact with them as in the next moment...
The intent of his Dominium remained.
It still warped existence to state the simple fact that it was unstoppable as a moment later, it continued forward.

Breaking apart any and all obstacles as even the records of space seemed to twist, a blinding expanse of whiteness already appearing before Noah's eyes as it was none other than the outline of Archaeos Vitalis Pylos!
Basileus Amelusa was standing beside dozens of other Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem as they gazed at the blinding mass of black and white in the skies being controlled by the Codex of Extremity.
|Why would the Codex go as far as to utilize the constructs of the Dikastes of Extremity...|
Her silver white hair blazed with brilliance, but her question didn't receive any answer as all Basileus here had many confounding worries!
First, an enemy Legacy appeared as the Archon and strongest Basileus went to represent their Legacy.
But they knew the conflict would only be removed by the Archons themselves as they could only wait to hear the resolution!
But not too long ago, they felt foreign Dominiums spread out momentarily and call out its glory.
What exactly was happening out there for foreign Dominiums to be so bold as to spread their brilliance here?

At such an atmosphere, behind the earthen clouds around them, a massive spherical building opened up as regal Basileus adorned in white clothes flew out, their distinction being high as they were the Ladies of Al-Abalem!
Nine of them stepped out as each was more beautiful than the last, their eyes brimming their Soul Dominiums as the leading one spoke out.
|No need to fret about when it comes to this.
The Archon will take care of things as he always has, and the Codex is simply following its normal workings as it adjusts to the Corrupted Seeds below.|
Her voice was filled with authority as the dozens of Basileus gathered atop the radiant white clouds nodded respectfully at this leading member of the Ladies of Al-Abalem.
|Yes, Basileus Moraine.|
She was acknowledged as she gazed towards the distant flaming skies with sharp eyes.
She was not worried.
Their Legacy was a grand one.
One that stretched out for eons as any trials they came across, they weathered through.
No other Legacy could shake them of their foundations, nor could a meaningless Corrupted Seed in the lands below them do anything to jeorpa-
BOOM...CRACK!
All thoughts and intents were stopped in the next instant as it felt like the lands below them cracked, the white clouds churning and exploding out with indomitable force in the distance!

Their wills shockingly gazed out towards this area as white clouds of Vitalis roiled and dispersed as if an unfathomable beast was bursting through them, this whole area vibrating and shaking as if it were a membranous layer that did not want to be entered!
And yet...
BOOM!
Another explosion resounded as the white clouds dispersed to form billowing steam.
As if they were being burnt away at the sheer pressure alone.
And rising from the bottom, the visage of an Entity rose up with unstoppable momentum.
A visage that whipped its head to instantly hone in on the dazzling manifestation of a Codex above the skies filled with white flames.
A visage that also came to lock on to the distant figures of the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem, and the endless stretch of a celestial city behind them filled with massive spherical structures!
A visage that the Basileus also came to lock on with incredulity.
They saw the definition of a man, his figure tall and proud as his body was sculpted like an ancient emperor!

Radiant obsidian pants were the only thing covering him as his fair chest was bare, tendrils of gold coursing across it as one could appreciate the distinct hue of a white Dominium wrapping around his body.
The two sides gazed at each other in a moment of shocking silence, the Basileus nearly frozen from Incredulity as what they were seeing shouldn't be possible!
But it was reality.
Something had come up from below.
The Existential Annal barrier distancing them from the Vitalis Hyperversal Domain was just shattered- they heard that clearly before this being appeared.
Thus, his origin was clear.
Not from the outside.
But from within the very same lands they oversaw.
He was no Basileus.
He didn't belong to any Legacy.
He should be...a Seed!
And the only Seed that had been the root of problems was none other than...
|Noah...Osmont!|
The words stemmed out of Basileus Amelusa as they were filled with a sense of disbelief.
She wasn't even sure if it was exactly this Corrupted Seed that the Codex of Extremity was initiated for, but she and all others could instinctively feel it!
But this was what made it all that much more unbelievable.
How could a Corrupted Seed be here?
And even more unbelievable, why would they have the white glow indicative of the early stages of an Existential Dominium Realm entity?!
It was a surreal weaving of Existence, and yet after the intent of Basileus Amelusa spread out, the being far ahead of them smiled devilishly as he didn't deny this intent!

And a moment later...his visage actually continued its unstoppable momentum as it began to surge towards them, their Dominium Souls gazing at this in shock as some Basileus instinctively moved a step back before their common sense kicked in.
|Blasphemous!|
WAA!
Who were they?
What were they?
And what was this being before them?!
He was just a Seed!
And they...were the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem!
Between the two sides, there was no comparison.
The glow of white Dominium Souls began to rouse as after a moment of disbelief, the Basileus of Al-Abalem reacted to the unauthorized entry of a Corrupted Seed!

chapters.title: Chapter 2959 Legacies and Seeds I
paragraphs: 2959 Legacies and Seeds I
A Seed.
Something they had known all their lives as they always had their own perceptions of such entities- noen of them being positive!
Seeds were ignorant Lifeforms living in Existential Domains, their lives always capped to a certain level they could never rise above of.
Their records were boring to look at, they lived, they died, and they were quickly replaced.
They contributed to the purity and accumulation of Vitalis and Vacuous as this was the main purpose of their lives.
To be Seeds that would eventually make way for more Fruits of Existence.
From the standpoint of a Basileus belonging to any Legacy, a Seed was akin to an ant they could step on if they so chose.
Akin to the clouds beneath their feet.
They could be stepped on, they could be sat on, and they forever remained beneath them.
So to actually have a Seed appear in the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos...
Truly, it was a violation of existence itself!
So Basileus Amelusa called it Blasphemous!
But before the two sides could even meet...
EEEE!
A fearsome cry came from the illusory Codex of Extremity above.
And the mass of white and black that had been blazing and converging this whole time flashed with brilliance as a shocking Dominium spread from it.
Filled with apocalyptic grandeur.
It was the last product of Mors Apokalypsis!
And it...was just a core.
Because within the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos and the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos, there were millions of Hibernating Dikastes of Extremity that were inactive this whole time.

Like throngs of puppets, hundreds of thousands of hibernating Vitalis Dikastes of Extremity burst from the clouds and white structures within this domain as they came to fuse and stack together with the core emanating a profound Dominium!

And from the obsidian gash above the white flames, hundreds of thousands of Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity also flew down akin to puppets without any strings attached, all of them joining together into a single swirling Dominium.
It all began to form into an utterly massive Dikastes of Extremity with a Dominium so heterogenous...so transfigured and unstable, and yet undeniably there.

Its Dominium Soul expressed a profound Dominium Rule as it was an amalgamation of creatures that shouldn't be possible, and yet when the distant figure of the Weaver of Existence gazed upon it, he began to peel apart its weavings!

[Existential Vitalis and Vacuous Potpourri]:: Held together by strings of opposing Existential Extremity Authorities, this Potpourri has an established Dominium Rule in two parts- one from Vacuous Existential Authority that allows its formation with the absolute restrictions of death in one hour, and another from Vitalis Existential Authority that allows it to burn with its brightest and most powerful Dominium Soul so long as it lives...
An amalgamation of Vacuous and Vitalis held together powerfully with a Dominium Rule as it was an extremely powerful enemy!
Formed from millions of Hibernating Dikastes of Extremity.

It was black and white evenly as it held a massive serpentine eye on its chest and face, with five pairs of wings radiating absolute white and obsidian light along with dozens of serpentine eyes stretched throughout them!
|EEEE!|
Its intent was filled with destruction and a sense of end as its entire Dominium radiated nothing else other than Apocalypse, its many serpentine eyes b coming fixed on Noah's figure!
Looking at it, the Existential Omniversal Emperor squinted his eyes with a smile.
[A slightly bigger ugly thing...are any of the wills that talked to me before in there?]
The previous Dikastes of Extremity Noah conversed with.
He had told one of them a prophecy that they would be kneeling before him soon enough, but it now seemed they may not even be cognizant in this massive contraction.
[Oh well, an ugly thing remains so no matter the size. Come on!]
WAA!
He sensed its spreading Dominium Soul that was bathed in an intense white grandeur.
The white of its Dominium seemed much more corporeal than his, but what about its Extremes?
Would they be able to match his?

His existence began to buzz with a wild sense of power, but an instant later, he turned his head towards the direction of the Basileus that had returned in their regal stances with their Dominium Souls still spread out- but they allowed the Existential Vitalis and Vacuous Potpourri to come after him while they themselves...
[Can't have you doing that now, can I?]
Noah could sense their Intent forming.
An intent that they wanted to spread outside of this domain to let others know of what was happening!
His Dominium considered this unfavorable to him and notified him of it as a moment later...
HUUM!
His Existential Body Dominium flashed as something blazed out of it.
A light so fast and blinding that it instantly crossed the weavings of space to appear in the flaming skies above the clustered Basileus!
Their Dominiums quickly caught it as they gazed up, their pupils constricting.
They saw the hazy outline of a multi colored infinity symbol standing up.

The extensions of the symbol felt like its limbs as around this Infinity symbol, gloriously vibrant Havens gravitated with existential light, some being entirely gold, purple, white, black, blue, and all sorts of other colors!
It was a wondrous Dominium.

It was Noah's Existential Origin Dominium that instantly appeared far above, seemingly made up of pure authority as one of the Aletheian Havens gravitating around him rose up with an existential light- this Haven being extremely dark in color!
It was the Aletheian Haven of Penumbra.
It carried with it the dominance of a Dominium as it seemed like a piece of a much larger and unfathomable whole!
And it gravitated off of Noah's body and towards the far flaming skies before radiating unfathomably vast waves of darkness that tainted the brilliant white all around!
|A Dominium Rule of Penumbra has been laid down.|
|No weavings or Intents may escape from this Domain.|
An obsidian light covered absolutely everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 2960 Legacies and Seeds II
paragraphs: 2960 Legacies and Seeds II

The flaming white skies were obscured as the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem gazed with sharp eyes towards the visage of Noah's Existential Body Dominium, the tip of the infinity symbol at the center of rotating Aletheian Havens forming an illusory face that seemed to be gazing down at them with immense scrutiny!
A nanosecond prior to this, Basileus Moraine, one of the leading figures of the Ladies of Al-Abalem, was weaving her intent to pass on the reality of what had just happened here towards Al-Abalem.
At the same time, among the others, Basileus Amelusa's eyes were cloudy as she also weaved her intent to alert someone- and it was none other than Basileus Anaine!
Allegiances had long been forged as in the next moment, Al-
Abalem and Anaine would have been alerted to what was happening here.
The weavings of this information may have been critical enough to change many things.
But a moment later, the visage of Noah's Existential Origin Dominium appeared, throwing out an existential authority that pushed forward one of his Aletheian Havens to set down a Dominium Rule!
Basileus Amelusa and Basileus Moraine sent out their Intents.
They fluttered across the weavings of existence in this domain and disappeared, causing their expressions to change!
They gazed at his figure above.
And his figure gazed at them below.
A Seed above.
Basileus below.
It was a contrasting scene that was hard to say if it ever occurred before, with the Basileus currently experiencing it feeling waves of immeasurable anger as some were ready to bellow out!
But at such an instant, Basileus Moraine raised her hand, her Dominium Soul spreading out and achieving control as she stared at Noah calmly.
They had heard of this Seed over and over again from their Records.
This Seed had overcome their expectations and everything they knew multiple times over, even causing alterations to Mors Apokalypsis of the Codex of Extremity!
Again and again, he defied the norms.
And here he was, somehow at the Existential Dominium Realm- somehow even stopping the weavings of their intent.
Basileus Moraine looked at him again calmly.
She could choose to look at this being how they always looked at him, or she could change her perception after everything they had done and treat them differently.
Her Dominium buzzed as her intent weaved out.
|You have achieved the impossible, so you can be commended for that.|

|You have achieved the Existential Dominium Realm, which means you have paid obeisance to the Great Imperium. We are high ranking members of the Imperium who even govern an Existential Domain under them. The things you have done are an impossibility, yes, but do you really believe you can go any further? Crossing higher ranking members of the Great Imperium outside of Imperium Rules is a guaranteed death. And in this Omniverse, there is nowhere one can be without the gaze of the Imperium...so what exactly do you think you're doing?|
WAA!
Her words were piercing as she was watching the advancement of the massive amalgamation of the Existential Vitalis and Vacuous Potpourri before coming to blows with the Corrupted Seed above!
Why did she do this? Her intent answered this question an instant later.

|The only reason I am holding everyone back is because I see you are tinged with the white light of the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm just like all of us. Staining our hands with you may cause a Dominium or two of our Legacy to fall if you burn the last embers of your Dominium. Why go through all that?|
The Neonate Stage of Existential Dominium Realm!
She gazed at the white light wrapping around Noah's Dominium as she said this, her eyes squinting with authority as she continued!

|Not even counting us, outside of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos, Basileus of Al-Abalem exceeding the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm are moving freely as what exactly do you see as the endgame here? You have done the impossible, Seed, how about you rest and wait to be judged? For your achievements, your Dominium may just have a path of survival since you have paid obeisance to the Great-|
|SILENCE!|
RUUUMBLE!
The Origin Dominium of Noah flared with indomitable brilliance.

In the distance, his Existential Body Dominium was about to come and clash against the Existential Vitalis and Vacuous Potpourri. His Existential Origin Dominium now gazed down at the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem as from his visage, a Colorless Aletheian Haven rose!
They thought he paid obeisance to the Great Imperium?
They thought he needed to bend down and hope that he would be spared by them and the Great Imperium?!
His Dominium blazed with Quintessence as he denied everything about this, a Quintessential Aletheian Haven rising up along with his will as his intent weaved out.
|Al-Abalem will face my judgment in the not so distant future for being the main perpetrator of Mors Apokalypsis...and the eons of oppression that have occurred here.|
|You all...sitting in your high thrones, will face this judgment early.|
His words caused the expression on all Basileus to turn cold and callous as Basileus Moraine radiated her own intent while her Dominium buzzed once more!
|So you have chosen death...the Imperium will understand.|
Her eyes changed entirely while gazing towards him as she already considered him dead!
She released the Dominiums of the other Basileus she was keeping back.
|You will now learn why the Basileus are Basileus, and why Seeds will forever be Seeds. You will-|
|No.|
HUUM!
Noah's intent weaved out again as the Colorless Haven he had released reached the high point in the darkened skies.
His form of an infinity symbol surrounded gravitating Aletheian Havens radiated its intent coldly as the Colorless Haven above began to pulse!
|I will give you all a glimpse of the authority that allowed me to be where I am now...and the authority that will spill the blood of Basileus.|
|I will give you a glimpse of Quintessence.|
The Colorless Haven above exploded out and radiated a Colorless light over everything.
And Noah's intent continued to blaze out unhindered as a new Dominium Rule was setting.
|Tell me, are any of the Existential Authorities you have Quintessential?|
WAA!
|Because if not...|
BOOOM!
The Existential Omniversal Emperor let loose.
It was his first battle with Lifeforms that were far above him not too long ago!

chapters.title: Chapter 2961 Legacies and Seeds III
paragraphs: Were any of their Existential Authorities Quintessential?
This question came and went just as quickly as the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem didn't put it in their hearts.

Each of those here were of the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm as unlike the Corrupted Seed above them, they had been lucky enough to devour and assimilate Fruits of Existence over the years!

Their Soul Dominiums had annealed and grown much more as they knew they were much stronger than this being above them, but Basileus Moraine had still sought to prevent a flash because eventually...they knew that even a weak entity at the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm was not to be so easily dismissed.

A Dominium was a heavy thing as anyone that had reached this stage had exploded with an accumulation of extremes and existence, and if they burned their Dominium when pushed to the brink...the power they could unleash before they perished was dreadful.
So, Basileus Moraine already knew what to do as she stared coldly at the spreading light of the Colorless Haven.
|Spread out and drain his Dominium. When he starts to burn his existence, increase the proximity and finish him off without any injuries.|
Her intent spread out at an extremely fast speed that was akin to the span of an instant as the Basileus around her had already begun moving- this single instant not even passing yet.
Basileus Moraine waved her hands thereafter as within them, weapons that would make one pause appeared.

They seemed like...firearms. Sleek and white with a fervent Existential brilliance, they exceeded any High Grade Armament of Extremity as they seemed entirely identical- with Basileus Moraine holding onto the grip of two handguns!
The magazine was already in as it held heart shaking weapons within, with the barrels of both of these guns inscribed with the markings that read {A Boom Box Production}!

Gripping them tightly in her hands, Basileus Moraine already raised both hands to aim ahead as the visage of the Corrupted Seed was within her gaze, the Colorless light reaching their surroundings at this moment as her intent moved to direct the flow of battle once more.
|Keep him at bay and finish him off cleanly. Show what it means to make an enemy out of the Legacy of Al-Ab-|
SAA!
Space fizzled.
Her words didn't finish as she instantly felt her Dominium Soul retreat around her body, her eyes no longer seeing the figure of the Corrupted Seed in the distance.
Instead...a voice shockingly rang out beside her very ears.
|You don't seem to understand.|
Her pupils dilated.

The Existential Armaments in her hands quickly began to turn as shockingly, to her left, the visage of the Corrupted Seed with his form of an Infinity symbol actually appeared, somehow bypassing their spread out Dominium Souls!

This was because similar to her, even those in the surroundings felt their Dominiums forced to retreat around their bodies, only covering them inches all around as this allowed their enemy to get close!

Basileus Moraine felt the beat of her heart as she sensed the weavings of the enemy Dominium already erupt towards her, her will seeing a blazing crimson Aletheian Haven of Apollyon pulsing with interminable destruction aimed at her side.
An entire Haven radiating an aura of a Dominium seeking to invade her protective Dominium Soul!

Sending this, her will quickly moved as she pulled the triggers of both her Existential Armaments before they could even be turned to entirely face their enemy- their barrels pointed in entirely different directions.
And yet...

The dazzling white bullets to be released disappeared the moment they came out of the muzzle, existence being distorted as they warped and somehow appeared directly opposite the incoming Aletheian Haven!
BZZT!
Noah's eyes were bright at such a scene.
The flow of existence and time seemed so extremely slow in his eyes as he picked up on the details of everything.
Appearing so close beside Basileus Moraine, he could see the weavings of her weapons clearly as their information rose before him.
{Glock #21- The Judge #1}
-A Uni-Dominium Existential Armament designed and forged by the Boom Box Enclave of the Imperium.
-It came as a blank slate before being infused by its current Existential Extremity Authority, its Source already fully resonated with Vitalis.

-A single shot requires the third equivalent authority of a simple Dominium Rule as the attack will distort existence to instantly appear before your target, so long as your Dominium can gaze upon it. -The Judge is proficient in the rapid penetration of Dominiums no matter which Existential Extremity Authority it was chosen for, with the bullets utilized by the Boom Box Enclave forged from rare Omniversal Existentanium Steel that aids in the breakdown of Existential Extremity Authority.
-Different modes of utilization include...
Waves of information flowed into his mind as his distinction of the Weaver of Existence and Extremity held a tremendous amount of power at this moment!

The information of The Judge #1 and #2 that were actually Existential Armaments flowed in his mind as they were shot, two sharp and spinning white bullets radiating a shocking light of existence instantly appeared before the Aletheian Haven of Apollyon he was throwing out to smash into his enemy!
BZZT!

The dazzling white transparent light of his Dominium buzzed around his thrown out Haven, the bullets shot out and laced with a heavy Dominium Soul of Basileus Moraine spinning rapidly as the moment they came in contact with his Haven, they began to lose their penetrating light.
Heavy friction of existence buzzed out as the moment it was ascertained they couldn't penetrate...
O!
The white bullets began to expand as if they held an entire unstable existential domain within them, a heavy explosion of Existential Authority exploding out!
The visage of Basileus Moraine gained some distance as she looked at Noah with an utterly distasteful gaze.
The dozens of Basileus Noah had appeared in the center of moved back while their Dominiums tried to stretch out and exert their authority!

chapters.title: Chapter 2962 Legacies and Seeds IV
paragraphs: He caused their Dominiums to retreat as he appeared amongst them!
Even as the explosion of the attack caused by The Judge #1 and #2 occurred, an Aletheian Haven of Prana bloomed that absorbed all the destruction with an overabundance of life.

Around him, the Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem erupted with their Dominium Souls as beside Basileus Moraine, multiple others called out Existential Armaments while some directly began expressing their own Dominium Rules.
But for Noah...
|You can try the expression of your authorities...but I ask, are they Quintessential?!|
HUUM!

His words seemed to make the Colorless light come to life as when the Dominium Souls of the Basileus nearby emanated out inches away from them, it began to fade and lose its capabilities to distort existence or anything else!
This caused the gazes of the Basileus to change as Noah didn't give them time to adapt.
His Origin Dominium stretched out multiple Aletheian Havens pulsing with destruction as they became laced with Plot.
Plot with wasn't Existential, and yet it blazed its brilliance in a Dominium of Existential Extremity Authority!
|These attacks have already arrived before you all.|
WAA!
The Havens around him instantly disappeared- only to reappear before the retracted Dominiums of all Basileus as their figures exploded with power.

Noah's eyes then honed in on Basileus Moraine who moved much faster than all others, her Existential Armaments already having their barrels pointed towards his direction as unlike others, she was using this unique weapon to instantly cause her existential authority to clash with Noah!
Her gaze was cold as a sense of fury rose within them while she spoke.
|Barrage of the Beginning|
BRRR!
The triggers of her Armaments were pulled hundreds of times in an instant.
And as if their magazines were endless, delicate white bullets spinning with penetrative existential brilliance boomed out, already arriving before Noah as his form of Infinity buzzed!
These enemies were not easy ones.
They wouldn't be eradicated in an instant, nor could they be one shotted into oblivion.
But there was something utterly Quintessential that others had to come to a realization of at this moment.
Noah had just arrived in the Existential Dominium Realm.
And yet...
What was he doing right now?
In the midst of Basileus of a Legacy that had lived many more years than him, he was freely throwing out attacks and facing not one...but dozens of them!
What reality was this? What possibility was this?!
And would there ever be anyone to even gaze upon such brilliance?!
BOOM!
A heavy explosion rocked the weavings of existence as at this time, an endlessly blue light of Infinity began to spread.
Around the same weavings of time as this was occurring.

In a place where time itself was negated, where those who lived there could experience a distorted and negation of the flow of spacetime continuum to the extent that it was hard to factor the passage of time for them.
In the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos.

Tainted with the Vacuous Existential Authority, these lands were unique in their fluctuations of time as while days may have passed outside of it- only a minute may have passed within, or years may have passed!
It was never cemented what would happen at what moment as even with such a surreal reality, balance was still kept when it came to what was within and what was without.
Within these lands, in the depths of buzzing obsidian clouds, in an underground lab that used to hold hundreds of thousands of Hibernating Vacuous Dikastes of Extremity.

A single Basileus of the Legacy of Ignatius was gazing at the lab that housed Dikastes of Extremity that was now half empty, his face turning up to gaze past the weavings of clouds above him where one could see a huge white gash in the obsidian flaming skies of Archaeos Vacuous Pylos!
|For Hibernating Dikastes to be taken like this...only the authority of an Archon can do so! Just what is...|
His intent was filled with doubt as he managed the operation of Dikastes of Extremity here, with his Dominium Soul spreading out at this moment and suffusing into the still Dikastes.
|And why didn't you all get pulled in?|
A question he asked himself.
No Fruits of Existence were provided to them as they weren't active, but they remained here.

The Basileus of the Legacy of Ignatius did not have any answers, so he had sent his intent towards Archon Basileus Ignatius to let him know of the recent developments like all others while he studied the weavings of the Dikastes of Extremity he managed!
His Dominium Soul spread out and studied the Dikastes closely.

What he didn't know was that as every weaving of his existence flowed across the Dikastes, an unseen cerulean light was latching onto it and ever so slowly infecting and seeding itself into his own authority.
But it didn't feel foreign or harmful as it was only feedback from the Hibernating Dikastes to grasp their weavings!
The more his will flowed out and more weavings of the Dikastes came to him, this unseen light penetrated ever deeper into his Existential Authority.
Into his Existential Dominium.

Moments later, he retracted his Dominium and flew out of this lab while shaking his head, going to meet with the other Basileus to discuss whether they should make their way to the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos to see what changes were occurring.
After this Basileus left.
There was immense silence as the thousands of 'hibernating' Dikastes of Extremity...suddenly had their serpentine eyes become filled with a tremendous amount of endless blue light.
It was a light disorientingly unique and isolated to a single being that had appeared within the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos after a certain cleansing.
It was the blinding blue light of another Seed, the Great Usurper- and it had begun to latch itself onto a Basileus of the Legacy of Ignatius silently!
|Eeny, meeny, miny, moe...which among you will get encroached upon more?|
The thousands of Dikastes formed a callous smile as their intents weaved simultaneously, a single Basileus not being their only target as another being waged a silent war!
