chapters.title: Chapter 2963 Eons of Brilliance Decimated! I
paragraphs: The Archaeos Vitalis Pylos had a Dominium Rule pressing on it that wasn't broken yet, so no information was able to squeeze past it.
But the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos was different as they sent their intents describing what they were seeing to Archon Basileus Ignatius!

Outside of the Records and Existence of Vacuous and Vitalis, Archon Basileus Ignatius had a cloudy gaze as he sorted through all of this information while gazing at the first contest of strength that was about to begin.

The visage of Archon Basileus Al-Abalem blazed with flames as his Dominium Soul was striking- a hue of gold covering it that denoted he was far from the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.
As an Archon who regularly devoured and assimilated Fruits of Existence, how could he not progress to such a height?
Meanwhile, opposite him was none other than Archon Basileus Lethith as the glow of gold around his Dominium wasn't as blindingly bright, showing that there was a distinct difference between them!
It meant the results of all this would truly be determined by the second and third contests to come.

Arriving at this thought, Archon Basileus Ignatius didn't confer with Archon Basileus Al-Abalem regarding the news he had received within the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos, with him expecting that Al-Abalem must have received similar information from his side as for now...he allowed him to put his full focus on the first contest to ensure that even this wasn't lost.
Thus, no line of communication was established to understand just what was happening in the lands far below them at this moment.
It meant one particular being could continue to use this time to go utterly wild.
And wild it was as the Weaver of Extremity slowly understood the utilization of Dominiums while he used multiple Basileus as the test subjects!
This wasn't to mention the massive amalgamation of the Dikastes of Extremity that his Existential Body Dominium had just clashed with.
EEE!
The serpentine eyes of this massive Existential Vitalis and Vacuous Potpourri radiated tendrils of Existential Authority as around them, reality was being distorted and reformed constantly!

This was because Vitalis and Vacuous sought to change existence how they wished, but the effects of Quintessence still pervaded the surroundings as they denied anything that wasn't Quintessential from expressing its effects.
This was the most terrifying move on the battlefield yet as unless this Dominium Rule was erased, it would be hard for Noah's enemies to express their authorities outwardly.
They should have never allowed him to set it up in the first place.
But still, the Potpourri was the final product of the Codex of Extremity that was having its authority encroached upon.
It moved with purpose and malice as since it couldn't distort and bend existence to its will around it...
BOOM!
It focused all parts of its authority around its body and flashed with Noah's Existential Body Dominium head on.
With his chest bare, Noah's visage shone with brightness as his hands were crossed in front of him, facing the impact of such a beast head on as his Dominium remained unbroken!
This was his Body Dominium.
His Soul Dominium...was having a shockingly easier time as he navigated across dozens of Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem.
The light of Infinity had also spread out as multiple figures just like him weaved across the surroundings, but they couldn't be formed in the thousands due to the sheer power they had to express!
When he was still walking across the Gradations of Extremity, he could form tens of thousands of clones freely with the Extremity of Infinity.

The same couldn't be repeated at the Dominium Realm this early on as to form an Existential Dominium was simply that arduous of a feat, where the Dominium Rule of Infinity was actually already doing something utterly balance breaking by having 36 of Noah's bodies currently on the battlefield!
But it was a deadlock.
The eyes of Basileus Moraine were sharp as these were beings that had lived for eons, sharpening their Existential Extremity Authorities as their sense for battle and war was not weak!

Many of them carried Existential Armaments that rebuffed Noah's extremes, this shocking reality being dragged on for this long purely due to Quintessence not allowing them the freedom of expressing their extremes.
But Noah needed to break this deadlock.
He had to begin slowly by...killing at least one.
If he just killed one, his power would jump by another level!
{The Weaver of Extremity seeks power within himself!}
He looked inward.
In this short period of time, he had obtained many advances as he was still learning their utilization in real time even now.
So he looked at what else lay within him.
His Dominiums.
He could bring his Existential Soul Dominium here as well.
Or...
|Mmm?|
His gaze went to his Havens and Extremity Vein.
To the thick blood coursing through them.
His Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage.
The creed that held many Extremes!
He probed it for its power!
{An Omniversal Lineage is one that is not clearly understood, but the weight of existence it holds far surpasses others.}
{It is possible to actively utilize this sense of oppression over those around you, or focus it on a single target for an even more profound effect.}
{The Extremity of Cheats taps the shoulders of Skill Trees and Tyranny as they begin to weave an Existential Lineage Ability.}
{The Authority of your Dominiums course through them as a Dominium Rule unfolds the potential of your own Lineage.}
{The Omniversal Emperor's Haki is being formed!}
Noah felt its design and coming closely as his illusory face atop the Infinity symbol smiled.
He slowly knew what level of oppression a lineage such as his could have.
And his...was of extreme purity as he was growing it himself!
He could express its wonders through Haki.
He could show its oppression over others through this Existential Lineage Ability known as Omniversal Emperor's Haki!
He understood it instinctively.
He could spread this unique Haki of oppression over a wide area with effect being slightly less, or focus it on a single target as at that time...
HUUM!
His eyes blazed with brilliance.
He gazed around and sought for a suitable target!

But it was a deadlock.
The eyes of Basileus Moraine were sharp as these were beings that had lived for eons, sharpening their Existential Extremity Authorities as their sense for battle and war was not weak!

Many of them carried Existential Armaments that rebuffed Noah's extremes, this shocking reality being dragged on for this long purely due to Quintessence not allowing them the freedom of expressing their extremes.
But Noah needed to break this deadlock.
He had to begin slowly by...killing at least one.
If he just killed one, his power would jump by another level!
{The Weaver of Extremity seeks power within himself!}
He looked inward.
In this short period of time, he had obtained many advances as he was still learning their utilization in real time even now.
So he looked at what else lay within him.
His Dominiums.
He could bring his Existential Soul Dominium here as well.
Or...
|Mmm?|
His gaze went to his Havens and Extremity Vein.
To the thick blood coursing through them.
His Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage.
The creed that held many Extremes!
He probed it for its power!
{An Omniversal Lineage is one that is not clearly understood, but the weight of existence it holds far surpasses others.}
{It is possible to actively utilize this sense of oppression over those around you, or focus it on a single target for an even more profound effect.}
{The Extremity of Cheats taps the shoulders of Skill Trees and Tyranny as they begin to weave an Existential Lineage Ability.}
{The Authority of your Dominiums course through them as a Dominium Rule unfolds the potential of your own Lineage.}
{The Omniversal Emperor's Haki is being formed!}
Noah felt its design and coming closely as his illusory face atop the Infinity symbol smiled.
He slowly knew what level of oppression a lineage such as his could have.
And his...was of extreme purity as he was growing it himself!
He could express its wonders through Haki.
He could show its oppression over others through this Existential Lineage Ability known as Omniversal Emperor's Haki!
He understood it instinctively.
He could spread this unique Haki of oppression over a wide area with effect being slightly less, or focus it on a single target as at that time...
HUUM!
His eyes blazed with brilliance.
He gazed around and sought for a suitable target!

chapters.title: Chapter 2964 Eons of Brilliance Decimated! II
paragraphs: The weavings of Existence and Extremes felt immeasurably heavy.
The circulation of authority across one's Dominium took three times the effort as the exertion of Extremes could not even unfold inches away from one's body.
This was Basileus Moraine's very own assertion as she felt the Dominium of this being oppressively laying itself all around!
How could a mere Seed achieve this?
Quintessence? How could a mere Seed from an Existential Domain do such a thing!
BOOM!

A barrage of bullets left her Existential Armaments as once more, endless Aletheian Havens seemed to rise around this being as his Dominium defended against all of them, his other bodies weaving across other Basileus as he alone...was battling all of them.
All of them!
It was something that didn't really make sense as more and more, this Seed was continuing to exceed their expectations.
Her intent bubbled forth as she wondered when the others and the Archon would return.
She didn't wish to see any Basileus fall to this being as so far, it was a deadlock that wouldn't be broken anytime soon.
And when it came to the gradual depletion of one's Existential Dominium...naturally, it would not be them who would be done first!
As she thought of this, a Fruit of Existence materialized in front of her that she opened her mouth to instantly devour, her Dominiums shining ever brighter once more as she kept her eyes peeled.
No more surprises from this Seed.
No more impossibilities made possible.
From here on out, they would slowly grind him down until-
Her intent questioned as it felt sluggish all of a sudden.
Her buzzing Dominium Soul that was constantly circulating authorities seemed to be slowing down tremendously.
Her muscles seemed to lose their potential of action as her fingers couldn't pull the triggers of her weapons anymore.
Her mind was blank as she couldn't understand what was going on, when in the next moment, she felt an immeasurably heavy weight settle at the very core of her existence.
At what lay behind the very foundation of her Dominium!
She felt...a supreme sense of oppression that she had only caught a minuscule version of from Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and Ignatius.

When they paid respects to the Great Imperium by visiting one of the Imperium Enclaves that handed down Imperium Rulings, she had sensed this same sense of oppression by an even greater degree on the Royalty of the Imperium!
It was an inherent oppression from beings that held something extremely pristine.
From beings that held...a Lineage relating to the Omniverse itself.
Why would such an oppression be here?
|You took up a decent number of words and pages.|
An intent weaved out beside her again.
Her hairs stood on end as she wanted to turn around, but the very core of her existence would not follow the direction of her intent as she remained frozen!
From the sheer weight of an Omniversal Lineage pressing down on a shockingly focused manner just at her!
|But, it is time for you to make your exit.|
WAA!

A bright Infinity symbol appeared to her side as 9 Aletheian Havens drilled from him and into her Dominium, instilling itself across her many layers of boundaries of her Dominium that she couldn't activate because her very Lineage was forced to tremble and be oppressed by the weight of this being before her!
She couldn't understand it.
It didn't make sense!

Yet there was a disconnect at the very core of her existence as her Dominium Soul did not answer to her in this brief instant, and within that period of time- the Dominium Origin of her enemy seamlessly entered her.
She instantly felt her Existence, Extremes, and Records begin to burn as a shocking devouring force began to wreck apart her Dominium!
While the weavings of her existence were still prevalent, she was still questioning.
How the hell did any of it make sense? How the hell did the aura and oppression only the Royals of the Great Imperium give off...be emanating from a Corrupted See?!
She had many questions.
But she wouldn't be able to get any answers.

Her last sensation was instead feeling her frozen fingers peeled away from the grips of her Existential Armaments, the dazzling white tools of destruction flowing towards her enemy as his Dominium...seemed to be shining at its utmost brightness.
An equivalent of three Dominium Rules worth of energy was required for a single activation of Omniversal Emperor's Haki.
It was a heavy cost.

And yet its result was utterly ecstatic as Noah observed two Existential Armaments flow towards him, while his Dominium buzzed as it began devouring everything about the Dominium Soul in front of him!
His Will seemed to be trembling with expectation as a deluge of Prompts were about to come to fruition.
{An Existential Achievement recorded in your exceedingly grand Fable!}
{One of the first set of actions after attaining your Dominium is the destruction and assimilation of another Dominion established eons before yours.}
{Your existence, extremes, and lineage further propagate your status.}
{The Loot for the first Dominium to fall under your hands will be of the highest possible quality.}
Before the other Basileus could even react.
Within the span of an instant where it just seemed Noah had appeared in front of Basileus Moraine.
Dazzling golden prompts began to appear before Noah at such a time!
{You have obtained The Existential Armament, Glock #21- The Judge #1, that is being bathed with the light of Quintessence.}
{You have obtained The Existential Armament, Glock #21- The Judge #2, that is being bathed with the light of Quintessence.}
{You have Obtained 89x Quintessential Fruits of Existence.}
{You have obtained an Entry Neonate License to the Existential Imperium Exchange.}
{You have obtained 64x Remnants of a Dominium Soul.}
|Hold on now...|
Noah's intent weaved out with a blinding light as he rolled it back.
What was that prompt just now? Entry Neonate License? Existential Imperium Exchange? Now what the hell was that?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2965 Eons of Brilliance Decimated! III
paragraphs: Within the weavings of a span of an instant.

The Weaver of Existence achieved something that should have been utterly impossible for him as he released the regality of the Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage to cause the very existence of a Basileus to come to a halt, and he used this chance to squeeze into their Dominium before devouring everything for himself!
It was an achievement that only made his fable grander, but among the prompts of Loot cascading down, there was one of utter unfamiliarity that his will honed in on.
Something termed the Entry Neonate License to the Existential Imperium Exchange.

A semblance of a Dominium Rule erupted within Noah's Origin as the light of Genesis and Chronos spread out, the flow of existence being granted a new beginning and stopped there momentarily as this span of an instant...continued as everything slowly became frozen.
The war he waged was so profound that he could use his power to pause the Weavings of Existence entirely while he gazed at something else!
Within the depths of his Origin, his will then reached out to Loot that he had just obtained.
In the upper curvature of the infinity symbol that made Noah's Origin Dominium.
Inside an Aletheian Haven of Dreams.
Noah manifested a visage of himself within this Haven that made him as above a field of sandy dream light, a dazzling white square card descended.

His will gazed at it with care and caution as his Dominium sent tendrils of his will into it, the crystalline white card pulsing with light as it pulled him into a new weaving of existence and record!
This card alone seemed to contain its own separate weavings of Existence and Records as it was something held by Basileus Moraine- and it didn't seem to be held en masse by other Basileus.
Very quickly, information flowed within Noah's mind as his Dominium Will appeared in an entirely separate space.

{The Entry Neonate License is the lowest License given out by the Great Imperium that grants one the ability to participate in the Existential Imperium Exchange. It is a type of Unique Existential Armament that allows the transfer of treasures, techniques, information, and much more so long as one can pay the cost. For the Entry Neonate License, the current functions are available...}
After the flow of information, Noah found his will surrounded by wondrous neon light as he appeared in the middle of a vast space.
And in front of him, the outlines of massive neon circular structures could be seen, with only four being lit up brightly and accessible to his will as all others were grayed out!

The four that were placed right in front of him had massive white doors radiating brilliance at the center, with radiant neon banners signifying what they were carved in the forefront of the circular building.
They read brilliantly.
{Enclaves}
{Commodities}
{Currencies}
{Marketplace}
Noah's eyes shone as he looked at the four structures, many thoughts and possibilities passing through his mind as he seemed to have stumbled onto an important tool of the Imperium.
A tool that he needed to understand thoroughly as the next thing he did was float towards the structure reading {Marketplace}!
WAA!
His surroundings changed and fluctuated once more as brand new Records revealed themselves.
{Existential Armaments}
{Existential Vessels}
{Existential Constructs}
{Miscellaneous}
{My Marketplace}
Inside the structure, new areas unveiled themselves as flows of information came into Noah's mind again.

In this isolated record, he could access its weavings to buy a great deal of things- and he could even put up his own constructs to be sold as the major currency to exchange...was none other than Fruits of Existence.
Noah smiled as his will delved into the area of Existential Constructs, and an illusory square screen listing a great deal of things rose up as it listed many things!

{Unbound Dikastes Worker}:: 1⁄3 Fruit of Existence. Peak Gradation of Extremity. Useful in the management of Existential Domains, or as fodders of exploration, this Unbound Dikastes is produced by the Enclave most proficient in...

{Unbound Dikastes Engineer}:: 1 ⁄ 2 Fruit of Existence. Peak Gradation of Extremity. Useful in the management of Existential Domains, or as fodders of exploration, this Unbound Dikastes is produced by the Enclave most proficient in...

{Bound Dikastes Worker}:: .1 Fruit of Existence. Peak Gradation of Extremity. Produced and bound by the Existential Authority of Factura. Its utilization is slightly less since it cannot be bound by the native Existential Extremity Authority of the Domain it is used in, but it is much cheaper compared to an Unbound Dikastes. Produced by...
Rows and rows of unique constructs unfolded before Noah's eyes as he went through all of them, many were produced by certain Enclaves of the Imperium as their uses were numerous!
Looking at all of this...
{The Extremity of Loot senses a profound possibility of fortune!}
A golden light shone within Noah's eyes as in addition to being able to purchase such constructs himself, one could also add their own constructs to be sold to others for Fruits of Existence!

Noah thought of the Existential Automatons that were already in the process of being created from his breakdown of Dikastes of Extremity, how inexpensive it was for him to design them with the aid of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...all of this and more made his senses tingle as in this path, there lay a great deal of Fruits of Existence.
In addition to the constructs, there were also {Existential Armaments}, {Miscellaneous}, and {Existential Vessels}, along with many other possibilities for Noah to explore.
He seemed to be following the lead of Loot as his eyes bathed in a golden brilliance and went towards the Miscellaneous section.
Here, rows and rows of possibilities unfolded before Noah's eyes.

{Existential Imperium Elixir V12}:: 88 Fruits of Existence. An Elixir designed by a genius of the Imperium that keeps their identity a secret. Their products are always top notch as this Elixir is capable of taking many concepts within the Gradations of Extremity to the Existential level in the smoothest possible manner...

chapters.title: Chapter 2966 Eons of Brilliance Decimated! IV
paragraphs: The things under the Miscellaneous section were many as they included Elixirs, and even more things that only gave Noah more ideas!

{Existential Planalith Krystallos of Vanity}:: 199 Fruits of Existence. Forged by the Enclave of Violet Alchemy Hall. Only the highest of Products approved by the Royalty of the Great Imperium stem from them as this Existential Planalith...

{Transcendental Origin Fruit of Existence}:: 100 Fruits of Existence. A Unique Fruit of Existence that allows for 100x increased elevation of one's Origin Dominium, with one's Dominium Rules gaining a mutation of...

{Remnant Source of a Shattered Existential Domain}:: 200,000 Fruits of Existence. An Existential Domain discovered by a Royal of the Great Imperium. Unfortunately, it was after it had been pillaged and destroyed as after a great battle, only the remnant Source of the Existential Domain was left behind...

{Basic Knowledge of the Omniverse}:: 99 Fruits of Existence. The glory of the Great Imperium extends far and wide. Those ignorant of it are low born and those not wishing to bask in the brilliance of the Imperium. This Almanac will provide the basic knowledge of the vast stretches of Domains under the Great Imperium, as well as regions to note or stay away from. Be informed. Be better. Become the limbs of the Great Imperium...
{Basic Knowledge of the Omniversal Pillagers- Chronicles of the Outerverse}:: 100,000 Fruits of Existence...
A great deal of things were laid out before Noah as all of this was only a small glimpse of the Existential Imperium Exchange!

This was only a small portion of it as Noah hadn't even perused through {Enclaves}, {Commodities}, or {Currencies} available within the Existential Imperium Exchange- all of this seeming like an intricate system set up by the Great Imperium.
And all of this was accessible with the Entry Neonate License.
What did higher level Licenses grant access to? What License did the Archons of Legacies hold?
These questions and more opened Noah's eyes to a new world of possibilities and Loot as within this span of an instant, Noah made up his mind on what he needed to do.
But his eyes couldn't help but linger on one of the many products he saw.
{Basic Knowledge of the Omniversal Pillagers- Chronicles of the Outerverse}
Omniversal Pillagers.
The Outerverse!
He was only just introduced to the Existential Omniverse that was ruled over by the Great Imperium.
But its rule did not seem absolute.
There was something known as the Outerverse.
There were those known as Omniversal Pillagers!
All of this and more just opened Noah's eyes to remind him that in the eons others had lived, they had accumulated a lot of power, knowledge, and influence.
He rose rapidly and in a Quintessential manner, yes.
But he was still eons of strength away.
Even these Basileus before him, even the one that he was devouring the Dominium of...what were they in the grand scheme of things?
His thoughts came to a close as the moment of an instant was passing.
The flow of existence began to resume.
He would delve into the Existential Imperium Exchange and learn more about it by having his Dominium Soul peruse through it.
His Existential Body and Origin Dominiums would complete the purpose of their weavings in the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos for now!
The flow of the spacetime continuum resumed.
Noah stood before the visage of Basileus Moraine whose eyes held not an ounce of light at this moment.
The profoundness of her Dominium had faded as ever so slowly, her body began to crack like a porcelain doll.
In the surroundings, the fighting Basileus seemed to sense this as their Dominium Souls locked onto this area in shock and disbelief!
Basileus Moraine's Dominium...was crumbling?
How was this...?
How could such a thing even happen?!
Hers was a Dominium built over eons.
Reinforced by hundreds of Fruits of Existence granted to her by the Archon Basileus!
How could eons of her brilliance be decimated just like this?! This question caused their battle to enter an entirely new stage as in their shock...their enemy didn't let the opportunity go to waste.
{Omniversal Emperor's Haki}

His Dominium was squeezed once more as he spent a great deal of its authority, and this time it was being directed to Basileus Amelusa as her existence began to freeze at the sheer regality of an Omniversal Lineage!
And at the same time this occurred, another part of Noah's Dominium was making grand moves.
His Existential Body Dominium facing the Potpourri was undergoing and carrying out its own changes, with its focus currently being set on a feature developed not too long ago!
{The Extremity of Loot is modifying the Log On and Log Off feature.}
The feature was left inactive as the battles this time were head on, but it was still too supreme to be left alone.
{The light of Existential Dominium shines with the ever present glory of Loot.}
{New modifications have been made.}
{From this moment on, whenever the authorities of your Dominium come in contact with enemy Dominium, Loot and Devouring will automatically extract a percentage of their authority.}

{Direct contact of Dominiums will allow for the extraction of .5% of the enemy's Existential Dominium, while Indirect Contact with their Dominium will allow for the extraction of .1% of the enemy's Existential Dominium. You can accept this as a form of pure authority, or it can be transformed across your Havens and Forge to form Quintessential Fruits of Existence.}
A modification was made.
And Noah's body pulsing with tendrils of golden light struck out against the Potpourri once more!
BOOM!
His fist smashed into its abomination of a fist as neither was pushed back, but wondrously...
A clear glow of gold erupted from the impact and became absorbed into Noah's Dominium!

The Potpourri paused briefly as its Dominium locked onto Noah, seeing the devilish eyes of this being as he now breathed in before beginning to release a barrage of strikes with his fist that were so fast that they formed phantoms of brilliance.
Such brilliance unfolded within the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos that was being absorbed at this very moment by Noah's terrifying construct!

sentences.text: The things under the Miscellaneous section were many as they included Elixirs, and even more things that only gave Noah more ideas!
{Existential Planalith Krystallos of Vanity}:: 199 Fruits of Existence.
Forged by the Enclave of Violet Alchemy Hall.
Only the highest of Products approved by the Royalty of the Great Imperium stem from them as this Existential Planalith...
{Transcendental Origin Fruit of Existence}:: 100 Fruits of Existence.
A Unique Fruit of Existence that allows for 100x increased elevation of one's Origin Dominium, with one's Dominium Rules gaining a mutation of...
{Remnant Source of a Shattered Existential Domain}:: 200,000 Fruits of Existence.
An Existential Domain discovered by a Royal of the Great Imperium.
Unfortunately, it was after it had been pillaged and destroyed as after a great battle, only the remnant Source of the Existential Domain was left behind...
{Basic Knowledge of the Omniverse}:: 99 Fruits of Existence.
The glory of the Great Imperium extends far and wide.
Those ignorant of it are low born and those not wishing to bask in the brilliance of the Imperium.
This Almanac will provide the basic knowledge of the vast stretches of Domains under the Great Imperium, as well as regions to note or stay away from.
Be informed.
Be better.
Become the limbs of the Great Imperium...
{Basic Knowledge of the Omniversal Pillagers- Chronicles of the Outerverse}:: 100,000 Fruits of Existence...
A great deal of things were laid out before Noah as all of this was only a small glimpse of the Existential Imperium Exchange!

This was only a small portion of it as Noah hadn't even perused through {Enclaves}, {Commodities}, or {Currencies} available within the Existential Imperium Exchange- all of this seeming like an intricate system set up by the Great Imperium.
And all of this was accessible with the Entry Neonate License.
What did higher level Licenses grant access to?
What License did the Archons of Legacies hold?
These questions and more opened Noah's eyes to a new world of possibilities and Loot as within this span of an instant, Noah made up his mind on what he needed to do.
But his eyes couldn't help but linger on one of the many products he saw.
{Basic Knowledge of the Omniversal Pillagers- Chronicles of the Outerverse}
Omniversal Pillagers.
The Outerverse!
He was only just introduced to the Existential Omniverse that was ruled over by the Great Imperium.
But its rule did not seem absolute.
There was something known as the Outerverse.
There were those known as Omniversal Pillagers!
All of this and more just opened Noah's eyes to remind him that in the eons others had lived, they had accumulated a lot of power, knowledge, and influence.
He rose rapidly and in a Quintessential manner, yes.
But he was still eons of strength away.
Even these Basileus before him, even the one that he was devouring the Dominium of...what were they in the grand scheme of things?
His thoughts came to a close as the moment of an instant was passing.
The flow of existence began to resume.
He would delve into the Existential Imperium Exchange and learn more about it by having his Dominium Soul peruse through it.
His Existential Body and Origin Dominiums would complete the purpose of their weavings in the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos for now!
The flow of the spacetime continuum resumed.
Noah stood before the visage of Basileus Moraine whose eyes held not an ounce of light at this moment.
The profoundness of her Dominium had faded as ever so slowly, her body began to crack like a porcelain doll.
In the surroundings, the fighting Basileus seemed to sense this as their Dominium Souls locked onto this area in shock and disbelief!
Basileus Moraine's Dominium...was crumbling?
How was this...?
How could such a thing even happen?!
Hers was a Dominium built over eons.
Reinforced by hundreds of Fruits of Existence granted to her by the Archon Basileus!
How could eons of her brilliance be decimated just like this?!
This question caused their battle to enter an entirely new stage as in their shock...their enemy didn't let the opportunity go to waste.
{Omniversal Emperor's Haki}

His Dominium was squeezed once more as he spent a great deal of its authority, and this time it was being directed to Basileus Amelusa as her existence began to freeze at the sheer regality of an Omniversal Lineage!
And at the same time this occurred, another part of Noah's Dominium was making grand moves.
His Existential Body Dominium facing the Potpourri was undergoing and carrying out its own changes, with its focus currently being set on a feature developed not too long ago!
{The Extremity of Loot is modifying the Log On and Log Off feature.}
The feature was left inactive as the battles this time were head on, but it was still too supreme to be left alone.
{The light of Existential Dominium shines with the ever present glory of Loot.}
{New modifications have been made.}
{From this moment on, whenever the authorities of your Dominium come in contact with enemy Dominium, Loot and Devouring will automatically extract a percentage of their authority.}

{Direct contact of Dominiums will allow for the extraction of .5% of the enemy's Existential Dominium, while Indirect Contact with their Dominium will allow for the extraction of .1% of the enemy's Existential Dominium.
You can accept this as a form of pure authority, or it can be transformed across your Havens and Forge to form Quintessential Fruits of Existence.}
A modification was made.
And Noah's body pulsing with tendrils of golden light struck out against the Potpourri once more!
BOOM!
His fist smashed into its abomination of a fist as neither was pushed back, but wondrously...
A clear glow of gold erupted from the impact and became absorbed into Noah's Dominium!

The Potpourri paused briefly as its Dominium locked onto Noah, seeing the devilish eyes of this being as he now breathed in before beginning to release a barrage of strikes with his fist that were so fast that they formed phantoms of brilliance.
Such brilliance unfolded within the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos that was being absorbed at this very moment by Noah's terrifying construct!

chapters.title: Chapter 2967 Annals Fall! I
paragraphs: How could he achieve his goals in the fastest and most efficient way possible?
This was a question Noah's extremes that were swirling within his Dominiums always sought to answer.
Some of them were already Existential, others were merely borrowing the Existential light within his Dominium.
But all of them were working together to ensure his success and livelihood!

His authorities as the Weaver of Extremity and Existence were the most active as they sought to obtain information about the weavings of existence and extremes themselves in order for him to see how to move!
This was how he had found out that his enemies were away from their abodes, and that he could enter to relish in chaos at this moment.
After that inflow of weavings, more continued to come as they allowed Noah to dictate how he should move still.
He kept his bodies moving in the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos because this was the extent he could currently handle.
Information was not leaving this Dominium as the reality of his enemies being away from their homes was temporary.
He had to achieve his goals and make an escape before the enemies returned!
They were far advanced in the Existential Dominium Realm as they had been enjoying Fruits of Existence for eons.
And the weavings he was grasping right now told him whatever reason brought them away from the Archaeos Vitalis and Vacuous Pylos....was a very powerful one.
So he was dancing with time.
And the most critical thing at this time...
{The devouring and assimilation of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity has exceeded the halfway point!}
Was none other than the plundering of the Annals of Extremity that supported these Existential Domains.
And alongside that...
{The Encroachment of the Codex of Extremity has exceeded the halfway point!}
There was also the Codex.

Both the Codex and the Annals of Extremity had exceeded the halfway point in their assimilation and encroachment as this was the direct result of Noah continuing to devour the Existential lands below and the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos above!
Under Vitalis, nothing else remained but the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
Under Vacuous, the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos had not yet begun to be devoured as Noah did not seek for information to spread from there yet!
But he was now close to grasping everything right under the noses of his enemies as in order to accomplish all of this and have enough leeway to move, the defeat of his enemies was paramount.
The battle had been in a deadlock before as the enemies he had faced were actually powerful Entities, but the way Noah operated was unique.
If he could kill one, the difficulty thereafter became much, much less as killing the next ones was even easier.
Because he devoured the power of those he killed and made it his!
Because-
|Impossib-!|
BOOM!
The Dominium Soul of a silver haired Basileus with a furious and deathly expression exploded out as Noah's origin buzzed with annoyance.
|Don't make too much noise while I'm trying to grasp the weavings of existence.|
His intent flowed out while streams of prompts cascaded over his eyes.
{You have obtained The Existential Armament, Neon Shield of the Imperium #99 that is being bathed with the light of Quintessence.}
{You have Obtained 81x Quintessential Fruits of Existence.}
{You have obtained 77x Remnants of a Dominium Soul.}
Loot from the decimation of a Dominium forged over the eons!
What Noah saw in terms of prompts of Loot was just half of it as thereafter, he devoured the very weavings of Existence of these beings into his own Dominium!
From the blood and eons of work of others, it all became his.
After the breakdown of the Dominium of Basileus Moraine, it was akin to Noah gaining the methodology to take them all down one by one as the rest would simply follow!
So another Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem fell as Noah gave them the least amount of attention, moving through the motions while doing his best to grasp the weavings of existence.
Yet to the Basileus...Noah's visage now changed to seem like an apathetic demon as after Basileus Moraine, one Basileus after another began to fall!
And the one doing all of this did not bellow out shouts of victory. Nor did he laugh in valor.
He impassively threw out Aletheian Havens filled with a terrifying Dominium as ever so often, one of the Basileus would seemingly freeze under his pressure as their defenses would be pierced through!
It was a hellishly ridiculous scene that the Basileus had never faced before.
|Archon!|
A Lady of Al-Abalem cried out her intent in this unwinding reality that made no sense whatsoever, and yet none of it passed through the established Dominium in this space!
The only one who answered...was the apathetic demon mowing them down.
|Quintillions of others called out on the lands below as some had their calls answered, others are forever gone.|
WAA!
|You looked at Seed with the same apathy and derision, I give you all a glimpse of this now.|
The same apathy they looked at others before with.

Noah was giving them a sense of this right now as he imposed the pressure of his Omniversal Emperor Lineage on one of them at a time, stopping the movement of their Dominiums before proceeding to destroy them!
|The Rules of the Imperium are wholly against this! Realize there is nowhere you can go if you keep doing thi-|
BOOM!
An Aletheian Haven of Dreams smashed onto the Dominium Soul of the one talking as the impact shook their existence.

Thereafter, the brilliance of Infinity erupted as the single Aletheian Haven smashing into them multiplied to become 81, a heavy Haki of an Existential Omniversal Lineage then descending and constricting everything as the blazing Infinity symbol towered over this Basileus, its Intent weaving out as everything froze!
|Fuck the Imperium.|
BOOM!
With an interminable glimmer of brilliance, the Dominium became locked down as the 81 Aletheian Havens pierced through, an endless dream being applied to this Entity that they would never wake from!

chapters.title: Chapter 2968 Annals Fall! II
paragraphs: |EEE!|
Its bellow boomed out amidst the roiling waves of Vitalis and Vacuous within it.
Inside of it, the will of the Codex of Extremity flowed as with the passage of time, it was becoming slower and slower.
It was being encroached upon more.

Its massive body clashed with the Dominium of its target as it observed the undeniable golden eruption of light that extracted its authority and brought it towards its enemy with every flash once more.
And its Dominium became ever slightly weaker.
Its gaze drifted off towards the distance where the subjects of the one who had controlled its weavings to initiate Mors Apokalypsis stood.
There, it could see the bodies of multiple of them shattered like the endless sands of the Omniverse, their Dominiums destroyed and drained of the Existential light that made them.
Yet another impossibility that the Seed it had been tasked to erase the Records of had accomplished.
It was a Tool of the Imperium as its purpose was the absolute management of the Weavings of an Existential Domain- connecting its Annals, Extremes, Gradations, and Records in a smooth manner.
And yet at this moment, it was about to fail in its task.
This could not be allowed.
If the will of the Imperium could not be carried out, the only pathway was destruction.
It completed its analysis as it moved right away.
What could not be contained in the hands of Imperium had to perish! It had to...did it really have to?
The weavings of the Codex of Extremity seemed to stall momentarily as if it were questioning itself.
Did it really have to destroy everything just because the Imperium could not get its hands on it?
|No...the destruction of Existence at such a scale isn't that wise, is it?|
A voice seemed to ring out within the depths of itself.
Feminine in nature, sweet and undeniable in its weavings.
Yes. How could destroy simply because the Imperium could not have it? These lands it had overseen all these eons couldn't just be erased like that.
Even if the Imperium couldn't have it, there was always the...
The...
|The Existential Omniversal Emperor will take care of it.|
Ah...
Yes.
He would take care of it.
In a trance, the Potpourri that the Codex of Extremity entranced its will in continued to swing its massive fists, every strike causing its authority to leak out even more.
In the very back of its weavings, a part of it seemed to come to a realization.
It seemed...that the encroachment had already progressed to an irreversible level.
The encroachment that-
Encroachment? Was there ever such a thing? It was the Codex of Extremity.
Its task was a simple one.
To oversee the weavings of all things connected to the Existential Domains under the Great...
BZZT!
In the flaming skies of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos that had begun to fracture and disappear, the illusion of the Codex of Extremity was gradually becoming more real.
Arcs of Quintessential light now covered it as the Will of the Codex within the Potpourri was slowly coming to understand something new!
It was the Codex of Extremity.
It was a Tool of none other than the Existential Omniversal Emperor.
And it was burdened with a glorious purpose!
HUUM!
The Weavings of Annals, Extremes, Gradations, and Records of Vitalis and Vacuous that it always oversaw were flung wide open as any resistance was lost.
All of it flowed towards the construct of a single entity.
All of it flowed towards the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as both this construct and itself...were merely tools of the Existential Omniversal Emperor!
BOOM!
With this admittance.
With this new reality set.

A massive crack split open across the flaming skies of the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos- the entire skies above seeming like shards of existence that instantly sunk into their surroundings as if they were being devoured by an unseen force!

The glorious citadel of round structures each varying in size on the cloudy earth below also began to crumble and sink into oblivion as the few Dozen Basileus remaining watching this...could only observe with disbelieving Dominiums at a reality that should in no way be occurring!

In the far distance, the massive Existential Vitalis and Vacuous Potpourri seemingly collected every ounce of authority under it as it bellowed out, throwing a final strike as if it was releasing everything it held forward.

And it truly was doing just that as the scene of blinding holding tendrils of light stretching out from the point of impact came to cover its massive body entirely- these tendrils of golden light pulling and absorbing everything about this creature as in a flash of brilliance...
WAP!
It entirely disappeared.

The only thing left behind was the visage of a bare chested entity whose Dominium now visibly blazed with transparent white flames, his expression seeming refreshed as he breathed out pure golden flames!
Around him, everything was seemingly shattering and disappearing, but with him...within his Existential Dominium...

A surge of indomitable authority was spreading as even though his Body was the one that obtained it, it spread towards his Soul and Origin as his Existential Forge and Aletheian Havens received an influx of authority all stemming from the Potpourri.
Their purpose was a simple one.
{The Existential Omniversal Emperor is embarking on the generation and formation of his own Fruits of Existence.}
A new dawn.
A new point of existence!
{The Extremity of Cheats gazes on with anticipation.}
{The Extremity of Extremity steps out of its silent abode, feeling its authority coursing through all extremes as it actively moves.}
{The Extremity of Extremity states that the forming Fruit of Existence has to be of the most extreme Tier.}
The weavings of the Existential Omniversal Emperor were reaching an immeasurable point.
And at such a stage...
{The Extremity of the Protagonist experiences a surge of Existential Authority as the Prophecy it has put forth is being achieved in real time.}
Unshackled lands will rise above Recorded Havens.
Annals will fall as an endless weaving awakens.

At this moment, with the Codex of Extremity whole encroached...what was known as the Aeonic Annals of Extremity began to crumble as everything about it was becoming devoured by the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

chapters.title: Chapter 2969 Annals Fall! III
paragraphs: An impossible future was unfolding at this very moment.

The weavings of many things were interconnected as the absence of one may have led to vastly different results, but events unfolded in such a way that at this moment, something as profound as a Codex of Extremity that was only ever accessible in the hands of the Archon Basileus of an Existential Domain...was actually wholly encroached upon!
And the entity connected to the Codex of Extremity intimately felt such a change the most.
Outside of the weavings of the Existential Domain of Vitalis and Vacuous.

Archon Basileus Al-Abalem burned with terrifying white flames of Vitalis, their lashing tongues and raging singularities caused by his Dominium Soul even causing the distant visage of the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer to raise his brows with a smile.
This Entity truly was a powerful one as were it not for profits, they may have chosen to ally with him instead of the Leashed Dog.
The entity that at this moment smiled and weaved out his intent.
Your existence burns with this much rage openly before you even make a move...can I take it that you have accepted the result of all this as a foregone conclusion?|
The raging intent around Al-Abalem was misunderstood.
He gazed up with such apathy and cold rage as he shockingly felt...his absolute control over the Codex of Extremity being contested at this moment.

It meant things had progressed to an irreversible level as with this under their control, the Seed may even be capable of entering the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos and controlling the workings of things there as the damage could be immense!
But at the end of the day, if he would lose it all to these dogs before him...
Tsk...
He shook his head at the taunt of the Leashed Dog as under the gazes of many beings, his Dominium began to move forth along with his intent.

Observer, I beseech you again that something critical is occurring within the Existential lands behind us, and our presence is required to deal with it. The damage is reaching an irreversible level as even if you have already acknowledged any and all responsibility to fall on you...I must still do my duty as the Archon Basileus!|
WAA!
His words caused many to pause as they didn't think he was trying to buy time or escape the contests anymore.
Basileus Anaine had questioning eyes behind him as she sent weavings of her intent back to the Archaeos Vitalis
Pylos, seeking to understand while Archon Basileus Al- Abalem was acting this was when she hadn't heard any drastic news!
What is this?
The annoyed voice of Archon Basileus Lethith already in battle mode reverberated out.
Let us finish the Contest of strength, and then whatever excuses there are can-
What?! A booming shout echoed out that stopped all intents.

The hundreds of powerful Dominiums here belonging to different Legacies all turned towards one point where the visage of Archon Basileus Ignatius could be seen, his expression that of anger and a sense of disbelief as he looked towards Al-Abalem!
The Archaeos Vacuous Pylos is beginning to crumble after the Codex of Extremity made yet another move! Is this occurring in your lands too?!|
Shocking words that finally revealed a semblance of the current reality echoed out.
When Al-Abalem heard them, he could only throw back a weaving of disbelief.
Archaeos Vacuous Pylos was crumbling? What did that even...
What? The Codex of Extremity made another move? Al- Abalem, what is happening down there?|
The voice of the Observer boomed out as his gaze became stern.
The lands below belonged to the Imperium.
He had just sworn in front of the Dominiums of hundreds of beings that he would bear responsibility for whatever happened as he wanted the contests to proceed!
But was there actually a larger issue even he didn't know about?!
The Veiled Herald of Flames and Archon Basileus Lethith looked at each other with stern looks as the gorgeous figure of the Veiled Herald of Flames also weaved her intent.
Has another Legacy illegally made a move and done something? You should've said this first-|
It is not another Legacy.
WAA!
The gaze of Al-Abalem was icy as his eyes moved around from all beings here.

The problem is from within...but when I stated that we were at a critical juncture, I was ignored and told that the responsibility would be on the shoulders of the Observer. The problem stems from...a Corrupted Seed.]
What?
The Dominiums of the Legacy of Lethith and the Royal Basileus Observer blinked as an immense silence descended.
Did he just say a Seed? There was a problem within his Existential Domain because of a fucking Seed?
You're serious?
Archon Basileus Lethith asked with a cold gaze as all he received was Al-Abalem's apathetic eyes.
The Royal Basileus Observer didn't like this progression currently as his golden eyes became sharp, his commanding intent booming out.
Place everything on hold and ensure the security of the Existential Lands first.
The one who would bear responsibility for all of this spoke as the first entity to move after his words was none other than Archon Basileus Ignatius!
But the eyes of three Legacies and a Royal Basileus
Observer all turned towards the distant Existential Domains behind them as many were wondering...just what damage could a Seed have possibly done?
{The makeup of the Existential Domains of Vitalis and Vacuous has begun to crumble along the fall of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity}
Noah stared at the inflow of prompts as he seemed to be at the end of an existential feast.
He was doing many things simultaneously as within him, his extremes were bubbling with ever increasing power!
Some more so than others as the Protagonist with its Prophecy being accomplished was on an extremely high stage, but there was one more concept that was flying just as high.
It bore its fangs at this point in time as something moving in the background finally reached completion.
One of the reasons why half of the Dominiums of the Basileus were absorbed into Noah's own Dominium.
{The incandescent light of Loot simmers with unfathomable glory.}
{Existential Analytical Looter has fully analyzed the weavings of Dominium Souls for the first time.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2970 Annals Fall! IV
paragraphs: 2970 Annals Fall! IV
Existential Analytical Looter.
Applying it to those in the Existential Dominium Realm was extremely hard...until Noah managed to devour entities of this nature.
Their breakdown and analysis then came that much faster!
[The Weaving of the makeup of Existence, Records, and Extremes of the Soul Dominiums of multiple devoured targets have been analyzed under the feature of Existential Analytical Looter.]
In the midst of a breaking down reality and existence.
As the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos crumbled around him, as the last few Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem were about to face his judgment...
An assortment of existential multi colored light began to gather as...
[The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Basileus Moraine, will now be called out to work under the banner of the Extremity of Loot.]
[The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Basileus Amelusa, will now be called out to work under the banner of the Extremity of Loot.]
Invisible to others.
Unaccounted for by the weavings of Records and Existence!
Within the crumbling Archaeos Vitalis Pylos, the visage of Entities bathed in the light of Loot, Infinity, Quintessence, Tyranny, and many other extremes began to rise.
The first was the visage of Basileus Amelusa.
A gorgeous figure, hair now tinged with a cerulean light, and a purple robe now draping over her as her pupils shone with white gold light.
Around her...the transparent white flames of a Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm burned as truly, a silent assassin of the Dominium Realm was born under Noah.
[The Extremity of Cheats glances at the Extremity Loot while shaking its head with glee, emphasizing just how crazy its actions are!]
Crazy.
And how could it be if not crazy!
But Noah didn't stop there as after Basileus Moraine, multiple other lights only seen to him shone as more Existential Illusory Weavings unfolded.
[The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Existential Vitalis and Vacuous Potpourri, will now be called out to work under the banner of the Extremity of Loot.]
[The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Basileus Hethrow, will now be called out to work under the banner of the Extremity of Loot...]
One after another, every defeated enemy was analyzed and recreated as each one stupendously held an aura of the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.
Each one!
All stemming from the Existential Analytical Looter feature that was spearheaded by Loot and supported by many other Extremes.
Noah stared at the forming army brought forth by this glorious feature as he gave out commands.
[Finish things up here, and raid the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos if there is time. If you are discovered, retreat right away.]
HUUM!
He gave this command while his Dominiums began to fade soon after, beginning to disappear entirely from the shattering Archaeos Vitalis Pylos as he had long since observed the weavings of danger.

He gave the command for the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos because if these Existential Domains were a map he was clearing out, he sadly didn't have a 100% completion rate as the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos wasn't entirely devoured at this point, nor did he get to grace the Basileus of Ignatius with his presence!
But he followed the weavings of information he received from his distinctions as the Weaver of Extremity and Weaver of Existence.
Everything about him instantly disappeared from these lands as the few Basileus remaining in the surroundings breathed out as if a heavy weight was lifted off their shoulders.
They gazed at the destruction around them with ashen expressions, but before they could even enjoy this momentary relief...

The Soul Dominium of a Basileus distorted and became flattened along with his body out of nowhere, the enemy being something he couldn't even see as the massive fist of the Illusory Weaving V3- Existential Vitalis and Vacuous Potpourri, moved the fastest!

The brief respite the few remaining Basileus felt was soon erased as before they could even wonder what was happening, silent and unseen attacks arrived all around them as their fate...was already sealed.
Noah's Dominiums returned to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed where his Soul Dominium was as everything merged back into one.
Sitting on the multicolored throne that seemed connected to all the authorities across this Omniversal Seed, Noah gained a small glimpse of the shocking changes occurring.
Just what an immense gain would bloom from the devouring of the Gradations, Annals, Domains, Records, and everything else of an entire Existential Domain?
And the encroached Codex of Extremity...
|I am pulling as much of it towards us as I can, Master. But the Dominium it is connected with is too advanced in its realm as we likely won't be able to obtain the Codex in its entirety.|

The Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed released its intent as when Noah gazed above him, in the endless multicolored skies, he could see the Illusory flashing glimmer of a massive white book.
Of a Codex of Extremity!
[It's okay. Let's be ready to make our exit depending on the situation.]
|Yes, Master. Everything is ready.|
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed nodded in affirmation.
A tremendous set of things were occurring all at once as both it and Noah had to manage and analyze swathes of information in a matter of nanoseconds, but they moved towards the most optimum paths!

Even at this very moment, Noah was observing the beginnings of the production of Fruits of Existence within his Infinite Existential Forge and Aletheian Havens, all the while understanding the changes of his Dominiums, Extremes, the Existential Imperium Exchange, and even the terrifying formation of his Existential Illusory Weavings of his enemies that was occurring in real time!
But even all of this seemed to pale in comparison to what his Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed had to do at this moment.
They had eaten up a lot.
They now needed to make a clean break and digest everything as they learned about this wider landscape they were finding themselves in!
And this new phase was kicked off grandly as a new prompt dawned before Noah.
[The Quintessential Annals of Extremity have fully devoured the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
[The weavings of the Annals of Vitalis and Vacuous have fallen.]
[Your Fable is arriving at a critical juncture!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2971 An Endless Weaving! I
paragraphs: A number of glorious things were occurring all at once.

It seemed like the Weavings of multiple destinies had already clashed as the results unfolded now, with Noah's destiny undoubtedly being at the very center as one by one, the Fruits of his labor unveiled themselves!
{The Quintessential Gradations of Extremity are being forged within the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.}
{The Weavings of Records, Extremes, and Existence of all entities within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed are connected with the forming Gradations and Annals!}
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed is transforming into a unique Existential Domain unbound by common restrictions and limitations.}
{The absolute reality of an Existential Domain being anchored in the weavings of Existence and Non-existence does not apply to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.}
Yes.
There were many fruits showing themselves, but the ones brought up at the very forefront were those that could be of direct and immediate aid to their goals.
And one was something of dire need if they wished to keep all the accomplishments here!
{The Feature of Existential Domain Warping is now available for use.}
A dazzling new capability bloomed.
An absolute rule that Noah didn't even give a moment of time to was violated.
All Existential Domains were anchored where they were born- with the Imperium working for eons to barely manage moving them!
Yet Noah achieved such a feat in such a short period of time that it was best if the Researchers of the Imperium never found out about such a feat.
And the moment it was achieved.
Let's get ready to make a clean break...]
Noah's intent weaved out towards the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, the rows of prompts about himself and this construct continuing to descend!
Outside the weavings of what was known as the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains.
The Archon Basileus Lethith and the few members of his Legacy watched coldly as over half of all Basileus of Al- Abalem and Ignatius disappeared into the Domains ahead of them.
They couldn't yet step foot on it as this was not yet their Domain, and it would be a clear declaration of War for another Legacy to enter a Dominium unless invited!
So they could only wait as the only exception to this...was the Royal Basileus Observer who left with Al-Abalem and Ignatius.

His massive Existential Vessels now showed rows of attendants stepping out due to the sudden complexity of this situation, their Dominiums all buzzing with power as they all exceeded the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm!
Archon Basileus Lethith gazed forth coldly as the Veiled Herald of Flames came by his side and whispered sweet glory.

Whatever issue they have with a Seed is of no consequence to our conquest. Vacuous and Vitalis are just the next we add to our tally...just imagine the others we can afford to conquer after another eon? Our Legacy will be among those carrying the most respect within the Imperium...to the extent that we will stand side by side with even the most powerful Royal Basileus!
Her words showed a hint of their burning ambition as the eyes of Archon Basileus Lethith twisted into a smile.
Mmm, after dealing with whatever issue they've
concocted, these lands will be ours. There is only that little issue with that Anaine...
Deals were made behind the scenes as they had to be honored.
But none of this would matter when the prize was an Existential Domain with an Existential Extremity of a beginning and an end!
No more excuses after this...only glory...
Their eyes were bright with the light of conquest as they stared at the distant lands!
And within these lands themselves.
Inside the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
Brilliance unfolded as Archon Basileus Al-Abalem, Basileus Anaine, other Basileus of their legacy, and the golden haired Royal Basileus Observer all appeared within the Weavings of this space!
And the moment they appeared...
Their Dominiums were faced with an unimaginable scene.
The white flaming skies above had all but crumbled.
The cloudy earth below that was a serene paradisiacal landscape was torn to shreds as a glorious citadel had all but perished into nothingness!
Their surrounding reality didn't even have the weavings of Existence as if they weren't really within an Existential Domain!
The gaze of Al-Abalem was extremely ugly as even though he had a glimpse of what was happening, he didn't know it had progressed to this extent.
This was him.
But the other Basileus that held no connection to the Codex of Extremity and the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer who were just facing this at face value... WHAT?!
A booming intent reverberated out as it was from none other than Basileus Anaine, her beautiful features distorted as she looked around her as if she had lost something extremely close to her!

While the other Basileus were dumbfounded, Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer had spread their Dominiums out, Al-Abalem instantly disappearing from their current position as he saw a single remaining Basileus of his Lineage on a thread of death.
And even though he couldn't see the enemy that was causing it...he could see something.
BOOM!
His Dominium crashed down as he felt it impact another, the opposing Dominium becoming flattened into nothingness within an instant as Al-Abalem's was simply that terrifying!
His gaze was filled with a heavy cloud as he then grasped the only remaining Basileus of his Legacy that was left behind as he asked in a grave tone.
What happened here?!|
The question shook the Basileus who was feeling waves of relief from being saved, and yet his eyes trembled as if he were traumatized...only saying two simple words.
Noah...Osmont!|
WAA!
The words caused Archon Basileus Al-Abalem to have an even darker gaze while in the distance, Basileus Anaine's face twisted into an utterly ferocious expression!
As for the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer....he appeared in the depths of the shattered flaming skies- reaching out towards a barely visible visage of a massive illusory white Codex.

Archon Basileus Lethith gazed forth coldly as the Veiled Herald of Flames came by his side and whispered sweet glory.
Whatever issue they have with a Seed is of no consequence to our conquest.
Vacuous and Vitalis are just the next we add to our tally...just imagine the others we can afford to conquer after another eon?
Our Legacy will be among those carrying the most respect within the Imperium...to the extent that we will stand side by side with even the most powerful Royal Basileus!
Her words showed a hint of their burning ambition as the eyes of Archon Basileus Lethith twisted into a smile.
Mmm, after dealing with whatever issue they've
concocted, these lands will be ours.
There is only that little issue with that Anaine...
Deals were made behind the scenes as they had to be honored.
But none of this would matter when the prize was an Existential Domain with an Existential Extremity of a beginning and an end!
No more excuses after this...only glory...
Their eyes were bright with the light of conquest as they stared at the distant lands!
And within these lands themselves.
Inside the Archaeos Vitalis Pylos.
Brilliance unfolded as Archon Basileus Al-Abalem, Basileus Anaine, other Basileus of their legacy, and the golden haired Royal Basileus Observer all appeared within the Weavings of this space!
And the moment they appeared...
Their Dominiums were faced with an unimaginable scene.
The white flaming skies above had all but crumbled.
The cloudy earth below that was a serene paradisiacal landscape was torn to shreds as a glorious citadel had all but perished into nothingness!
Their surrounding reality didn't even have the weavings of Existence as if they weren't really within an Existential Domain!
The gaze of Al-Abalem was extremely ugly as even though he had a glimpse of what was happening, he didn't know it had progressed to this extent.
This was him.
But the other Basileus that held no connection to the Codex of Extremity and the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer who were just facing this at face value...
WHAT?!
A booming intent reverberated out as it was from none other than Basileus Anaine, her beautiful features distorted as she looked around her as if she had lost something extremely close to her!

While the other Basileus were dumbfounded, Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer had spread their Dominiums out, Al-Abalem instantly disappearing from their current position as he saw a single remaining Basileus of his Lineage on a thread of death.
And even though he couldn't see the enemy that was causing it...he could see something.
BOOM!
His Dominium crashed down as he felt it impact another, the opposing Dominium becoming flattened into nothingness within an instant as Al-Abalem's was simply that terrifying!
His gaze was filled with a heavy cloud as he then grasped the only remaining Basileus of his Legacy that was left behind as he asked in a grave tone.
What happened here?!|
The question shook the Basileus who was feeling waves of relief from being saved, and yet his eyes trembled as if he were traumatized...only saying two simple words.
Noah...Osmont!|
WAA!
The words caused Archon Basileus Al-Abalem to have an even darker gaze while in the distance, Basileus Anaine's face twisted into an utterly ferocious expression!
As for the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer....he appeared in the depths of the shattered flaming skies- reaching out towards a barely visible visage of a massive illusory white Codex.

chapters.title: Chapter 2972 An Endless Weaving! II
paragraphs: The Imperium Royal Basileus Observer reached out and grasped a glimmer that remained of the Codex, his expression stern as his intent apathetically rang out.
|You had the Codex of Extremity activate Mors Apokalypsis this whole time? An issue with a Seed progressed to this extent?! Why didn't you provide clear details initially?!|
HUUM!
With every word, his expression revealed hints of more and more anger as down below, Al-Abalem gazed up coldly while replying.
|I was never given the chance. The Observer seemed to be in a hurry to see the results of the Rule of Imperium Telos against me.|

The words caused a simmering rage to rise within the golden eyes of the Observer as he used a unique authority, what remained of the Codex of Extremity falling in his hands as his expression became even more obscene.
He grasped the few tattered pages and then pointed down below- past the shattered clouds of earth and onto the domain where they couldn't see anything due to the Mors Apokalypsis being in process!
With a tap of his fingers, a veil was cracked forcefully as the scene down below became visible.
As the vastness of the Existential Vitalis Hyperversal Domain became visible.
And what they saw...
Caused a shocking silence to permeate across all the Existential Dominium Realm entities here!
This was because there was an absence of existence.
An absence of any Domain.
Nothing relating to Vitalis could be seen down below.
In this silence...
WAP!
The weavings of reality fluctuated as the figure of Archon Basileus Ignatius appeared while booming out with his intent.
|The Archaeos Vacuous Pylos was partly destroyed, how is the...!|
His pupils dilated.
He thought the damage within his Archaeos Vacuous Pylos was extensive.
He even destroyed the Dominiums of two invisible Entities that were actually devouring his Basileus before he came over!
But what he saw of the Vitalis Pylos...caused his words to never finish.
Up above, the visage of the Observer shifted from anger to apathy as he voiced out while piecing together the last remnants of the Codex of Extremity.

|No Seed can manage to cause this much destruction- no Seed can proceed not to just destroy, but to cause the disappearance of large swathes of Existential Domains. You came across a Seed that was influenced by Omniversal Pillagers...and you did not know it.|
BOOM!
His words were absolute as if they were weaving a new reality!
After all, he had claimed to take all responsibility on this issue as he couldn't get back to the Imperium and state that one of their Lands had been destroyed right under his nose.
|Omniversal Pillagers was the root cause of this...understood?!|
His visage pulsed with purple gold brilliance as he looked down on all Basileus here, Al-Abalem's cold figure about to reply when...
CRACK!

Stemming from the weavings of what used to be an Existential Domain below and the destroyed lands above, from the absence of Annals, Gradations, or any Source that would keep this sliver of existence together...its natural destruction began.
BOOOM!

What remained of the Existential Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains began to crumble as Archon Basileus Ignatius roared out, returning back to his lands as he truly couldn't stand losing everything!
But what could one do?
In front of an imploding Existential Domain, it was an irreversible force of nature that one could only bear or escape from.
BOOM!

Existential destruction began to unfold as in the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos, Ignatius roared out while pulling in portions of his past domain, his Basileus, and the throngs of Dikastes of Extremity remaining.
All of them flowed towards his own Dominium in this moment of profound destruction and loss!
And amongst those entering his Dominium through his own permission...there Dikastes of Extremity all flashed with a silent blue light.
A light that had already begun to silently meld into some Basileus, and at this moment...an Archon Basileus took it into his own Dominium to save what was his.
It was an astounding progression of events...and a terrifying possibility for the will of the Great Usurper silently spreading and infecting everything!
BOOM!
The fracturing of existence was immense as it could not be contained, where even those outside would be privy to it.

In the next few moments, the visage of the Observer with a cold expression appeared in front of his Existential Vessel once more, his attendants bowing down at his entry as in the distance, the figures of Archon Basileus Lethith and the Veiled Herald of Flames could be with their jaws opening wide in shock!
Even from where they stood, they could see the fracturing of the Existential Domain in the distance.
It was followed by the dazzling Basileus within the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius being spat out as well, the unfolding situation being one that nobody could fathom!
The only one able to exert their authority in this moment was none other than the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer, the weavings of this entity echoing out to all Basileus in the surroundings.
|The machinations of Omniversal Pillagers succeeded here today.|
Archon Basileus Lethith heard this as his Dominium buzzed.

What the fuck did he mean by the machinations of Omniversal Pillagers? What Omniversal Pillagers? If they really passed through here, all of them would be dead as this region was not one that they could even step into!
Did Al-Abalem really destroy his Existential Domain not to let him have it?! Did...-!
|The means of Omniversal Pillagers are nefarious as this time, they utilized a Corrupted Seed known as Noah Osmont. Track this Seed down, and he will lead us to the true culprits.|
WAA!
The Dominium of Lethith blazed.
What the fuck were they even talking about now?!
Did they not realize how many of his resources he had directed for this venture? How many tributes he had to give to invite the Observer here?
And now they were just going to fuck him over like this?!
His Dominium was burning with rage, but he couldn't even release it as he looked at the form gaze of the Observer that showed what he said was final.
Archon Basileus Lethith didn't know...that he was just one of the Entities here swimming in rage and regret.

There was one whose rage and regret far surpassed any others here, and it was none other than the gorgeous visage of Basileus Anaine that now stood amongst the throngs of Basileus behind Al-Abalem, all of them gazing with dark eyes towards the fracturing shell of an Existential Domain in the distance.
Her Dominium was seething so much that her eyes trembled, a single thought ringing inside her over and over again!
|I let him go...I let him go...I let him go!!!|
Over and over again!
Endlessly!
