chapters.title: Chapter 2973 An Endless Weaving! III
paragraphs: 2973 An Endless Weaving! III
|I let him go!|
Such a thought repeated within the shaky Dominium of Anaine as the weavings of Existence...were ultimately all made up of choices.
The weavings of the choices of all beings here were ultimately what led to the current reality.
But some...truly could not accept it!
They had done so much.
They had plotted for so many years!
And for others like Al-Abalem...they had just lost the home to their Legacy.
One's legend and the legend of their Legacy was determined by their capability to generate wealth.
Existential Domains were one of the main methods to generate wealth as a Legacy that had lost their Existential Domain...may as well lose Tier status as a Legacy!
Unless they could accumulate their wealth again through more dangerous means than when compared to Existential Domains.
Or if they had the capability to start up an Enclave and produce niche products to be sold in the Existential Imperium Exchange.
Ultimately, it was all about wealth and resources.
And on this day, barring any entities whose plans and weavings went to waste, the single entity that had lost every ounce of his wealth...was none other than Al-Abalem.
Blazing silver white brilliance covered his body as his Dominium felt Vitalis closely.
He still held and felt this Existential Extreme, but he could no longer feel the sense of absolute control with it to the extent that any others using this authority could be suppressed by him.
He had lost the right of its control as he now shared no connection to Vitalis itself, the Codex of Extremity above it, or any of its weavings!
He now had to depend on his other Existential Extremes, and not the one he had focused so many wins of resources into.
A tremendous loss.
This was what Al-Abalem faced as at this moment, his mind only held a single name repeated over and over again.
|Noah...Osmont!|
A single name was uttered out, thought about, and questioned about at this moment as multiple Legacies and a man of the Imperium stared at a crumbling Existential Domain.
A distance away from this area.
In the midst of the endless absence of existence that was represented by immeasurable darkness.
Multiple pairs of eyes were covered by a Dominium blazing with a wondrous purple light were watching on with cold interest.

Adorned in crystalline scales, they had forms most similar to Eonic Existential Gold Dragons, their visages dangerous and filled with power as the purple hue around their Dominiums rivaled that of Al-Abalem and other Archon Basileus!

There were three of these massive Entities, and yet above one of them was a woman robbed in a white Existential Armament, her body burning with a fearsome light as she actually sat atop beings such as this.
And even with their massive sizes and terrifying power, being not too far away in distance, neither the Observer nor the Archons of the three respective Legacies could sense nor see them.
At the sight of the crumbling Existential Domain, the draconian entity that the gorgeous visage of a woman sat on sharpened its gaze as its intent weaved out.

|We managed to see something unique, Sanctus Princess. Following a dog of the Imperium in these lands actually showed them blatantly destroying an Existential Domain. Shall we make a move to eradicate? To avenge the countless lives they have soullessly taken just now?|
The words were callous and filled with immense malice, and yet the woman atop this draconic entity stroked its scales calmly!

Her white robe glimmered with brilliance as verdant hair fell to her shoulders, her endlessly green eyes serpentine in nature as her Dominium also radiated a purple light- a light commonly associated two stages after the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.
On her forehead, the scripture [S] glowed in a gorgeous verdant light as this dazzling woman replied to the powerful Existential Dominium Realm entity below her.
|We must not believe everything at face value. Some of them emanated weavings placing the blame on Omniversal Pillagers, others on one called Noah Osmont...|

|Hmph, Sanctus Princess, they don't know the first thing regarding Omniversal Pillagers. If even a single one passed through here, not even a shred of our bones would remain, much less theirs. Blatant falsehoods...|
Words were exchanged by the woman termed Sanctus Princess and the entity she mounted as she calmly nodded.

|Yes. So it's either them or this Noah Osmont. Kidnap a few and scour their Dominiums before making a move. Don't make a move on the Dog of Imperium just yet, the Sanctus Empress has handed down a decree to all of us Sanctus Princesses that we are moving covertly without causing any open conflicts with the Imperium in this coming Eon. Also...did any of you feel anything out of place seconds ago?|
Her eyes glimmered with brilliance as she asked the three Entities below her, all three giving her quizzical glances as the one she mounted replied.
|No, Sanctus Princess.|
|Mmm...| Her green eyes shone serenely as her intent weaved out.

|Just for an instant...I caught the weavings of the Transference of Existence. As if something massive was transferred a vast distance in an instant. My Dominium is pulling me to follow up on this. I may be able to trace whatever it was...|
Her words were astonishing as the eyes of those below her glanced at each other before the one she stood atop of nodded.
|Then, I will follow your lead and let Knight Judar and Knight Ar'bun follow the peons of Legacies and the Dog of the Imperium here...and avenge the lives that ended so senselessly.|
|Mmm...Salus Populi Suprema Lex Esto.|
The Sanctus Princess called out lightly, her intent this time being filled with an unfathomable power as a set of words holding great meaning were uttered!
Her Dominium and the Dominium of the three Entities around her burned with an ever fiercer glint as they replied in kind.
|Salus Populi Suprema Lex Esto!|
|Salus Populi Suprema Lex Esto!|
A set of words that represented an immense power.
A set of words that meant....The good of the people was the supreme law!

chapters.title: Chapter 2974 An Endless Weaving! IV
paragraphs: 2974 An Endless Weaving! IV
Salus Populi Suprema Lex Esto!
The good of the people was the supreme law!
Such a maxim was uttered out while weavings were read and delegated.

The Sanctus Princess patted the draconian entity below her as they disappeared into a verdant light right away, the remaining two draconic entities turning their massive bodies and gazes towards the Legacies of Al-Abalem, Ignatius, and Lethith as they were none the wiser!
These entities were unique ones that belonged to a terrific power within this Omniverse.
A power only known as the Sanctus Populi!
Those who stood to reclaim the dignity of the masses.
Those who put the welfare of people above all else!
Like so, an intricate weaving began to form.
A dance began to ebb and flow.
And at the center of it all...was a man.

An Emperor born and reborn through countless fires of Quintessence as now, he could finally gain a brief moment of respite to understand the power he held, and just what existence meant for him who had pioneered into the Existential Dominium Realm, forged an Omniversal Lineage, and had his construct take the steps to become an Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
Across the blank expanse of the Omniverse.
An area so endlessly vast that even with the passage of eons, it was hard to say if one had ever caught a glimpse of its end.
Throughout the Omniverse, across the swathes of non-
existence, there would always be points of existence stretched throughout.
Existential Domains.

Massive pockets of existence that held the weavings and records of an uncountable number of creatures in each one, with the lives of trillions sometimes not knowing about the quintillions of others stretched out in the same Existential Domains!
Some live and die believing they were contained within a small world rotating around a sun in a distant galaxy, others may touch upon Mana and come to observe a much grander viewpoint.
Others could view things at a scale of the Universe, Cosmos, or even Planes of Existence, and those truly lucky or through sheer hard world...may even have touched upon the Gradations of Extremity!
Each Existential Domain was unique as it may have its own weavings of Existence, Records, and Gradations.
The powers and Concepts entities from one Existential Domain wielded may be vastly different compared to entities in another Existential domain.
Even the Gradations of Extremity they climbed may not be the same!
Even the Dominiums they formed...may not be the same.
Across this endless Omniverse, in a point of immense silence and nothingness...
WAP!
A singularity bloomed and illuminated everything nearby with multi-colored brilliance before an instant later, this brilliance retracted as if it never existed.
The singularity that had just warped in...glimmered silently before also disappearing.
[Existential Domain Warping was successfully completed.]

The good of the people was the supreme law!
Such a maxim was uttered out while weavings were read and delegated.

A power only known as the Sanctus Populi!

Those who put the welfare of people above all else!
Like so, an intricate weaving began to form.
A dance began to ebb and flow.
And at the center of it all...was a man.

existence, there would always be points of existence stretched throughout.
Existential Domains.

Massive pockets of existence that held the weavings and records of an uncountable number of creatures in each one, with the lives of trillions sometimes not knowing about the quintillions of others stretched out in the same Existential Domains!
Some live and die believing they were contained within a small world rotating around a sun in a distant galaxy, others may touch upon Mana and come to observe a much grander viewpoint.
Others could view things at a scale of the Universe, Cosmos, or even Planes of Existence, and those truly lucky or through sheer hard world...may even have touched upon the Gradations of Extremity!
Each Existential Domain was unique as it may have its own weavings of Existence, Records, and Gradations.
The powers and Concepts entities from one Existential Domain wielded may be vastly different compared to entities in another Existential domain.
Even the Gradations of Extremity they climbed may not be the same!
Even the Dominiums they formed...may not be the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 2975 An Endless Weaving! V
paragraphs: Manadynamics.
There were an endless variety of Existential Extremity Authorities that could be the basis of an Existential Domain.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, in conjunction with Noah, chose Manadynamics to be the one!
And...it would not be the only one.

But at this moment, its brilliance outshone all others as it was already intricately connected to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and Noah, and yet at this moment, its influence tremendously increased.
To the extent that even the Aletheian Havens and Extremity Vein became painted by a gorgeous blue light!
To the extent that Noah felt his body...begin to tremble as deep within him, Manadynamics began to flow like a torrential beast.
One that was so fierce to the extent that even his Dominium trembled.

It wasn't that he couldn't personally support another Existential Extremity Authority, with his three separate Dominiums having grown in real time to be capable of elevating and holding strong even with another authority!
But Manadynamics...felt so endlessly vast as its true anchor was the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed itself.
It was something meant to support the workings of such a construct.
And when it began to course through Noah, it didn't alter or modify itself on his behalf.
It ran through him as if it were running through the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
HUUM!

His Dominium creaked as it wasn't just a matter of a new Existential Extremity Authority, it was the ridiculous concentration and quantity of it as the weavings of Mana becoming Existential were too profound for Noah!
He, who held Infinite Mana!

The raging explosion of such an endless concept charged throughout him as his Existential Dominiums felt as if they were being squeezed. As if his Meridians were too narrow. As if the circuits and vessels carrying authority throughout Noah could not support it.
And in response...
{The Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage wakes with a challenging glare towards the immeasurable waves of Manadynamics.}
{The Meridians of the Existential Omniversal Emperor can support the flow of any authority.}
BOOM!
His body instantly flashed with countless interconnecting meridians as the raging waves of existential Mana quickly stabilized and found a flow.
But this wasn't all.
There was still such a massive amount of it as it had to be put to use!
{The Dominiums of the Existential Omniversal Emperor are filled with boundless stanchions of light and interconnected passages that can direct and transform all forms of authority.}

{The Existential Omniversal Extremity Passages are already rising from the backbone of the Quintessential Reality Passages, connecting everything across your Dominiums, your Forge, and your Aletheian Havens.}

Within his body, boundlessly large multicolored mountainous passages flashed, immense and interminable waves of authority beginning to course through them seamlessly as they seemed to cycle and direct the flow of the endless waves of existential Mana.
This...was a glimpse within Noah on how he was managing it.
Now, the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed...it didn't even need to manage anything.
It let it run rampant!

And this was why a moment later, the figure of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed in front of Noah had countless lines of blue rivers connecting to her, the authority of Manadynamics flowing entirely into her and coursing into her hand as...
{The Existential Authority of a past Natural Law that served as the building blocks of the current Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed flows with an intentful weaving.}
{Manadynamics asserts once more that the essence of Existence, Extremes, and Records can not be created nor destroyed, simply changed into different forms.}

{Through the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, Manadynamics courses across the weavings of its Records, Extremes, and Existence as it begins changing its endless authority towards the generation of Quintessential Fruits of Existence.}
BOOM!

In this dazzling region where only Noah and the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed were, heavy booms could be heard as massive mountainous passages of pure authority formed all around, each one looking like an inverted volcanic mountain gushing out waves of cerulean light that serenely flowed all around!
It clustered on the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and coursed through her as from her outstretched hands, a fantastical framework of a fruit of Existence began to form.
This scene was a wondrous one to see as Noah observed that after a second passed, the framework of a fruit similar to a paradisiacal apple was already formed.
And after 10 seconds passed, its radiant insides began to fill up!
BZZT!

All around, the mountains of Existential Omniversal Extremity Passages gushed out endless blue light that continued to only contribute to this, and after 30 seconds, the different layers of the Fruit of Existence were outlined.
After 50 seconds, the Fruit seemed nearly complete as an outer multicolored layer began to cover it!
And after 60 seconds...
HUUM!
An incandescent light blared as a dazzling Quintessential Fruit of Existence formed in the hands of the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
60 seconds.
After the passage of another second, the fruit in her hands was pushed away as another began to form.
{As of this moment, the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed can generate one Quintessential Fruit of Existence per minute, and in an endless manner through the weavings of Manadynamics.}
{This rate of convergence will only increase over time as the inclusion of even more relevant Existential Extremity Authorities onto the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed will only hasten it.}
Dazzling words cascaded down.
And they let it be known that every minute, a Quintessential Fruit of Existence would be born in the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
In an hour, that was 60 Quintessential Fruits of Existence. In a day, that was 1,440!
And this...was just the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
There was still Noah himself.
As dazzling mountainous passages gushed out waves of authorities in his Dominiums.
Above Noah's Aletheian Haven of Dreams within his Existential Origin Dominium.
A golden Fruit began to form a dazzling and frightening outline.
{A Unique Fruit of Existence has begun to form within your Aletheian Haven of Dreams.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2976 An Endless Weaving! VI
paragraphs: Another unique Fruit of Existence formed above a golden Haven of his!
And this was on top of a current output of 1,440 Quintessential Fruits of Existence a day from the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
As this began...
{A Unique Fruit of Existence has begun to form within your Aletheian Haven of Helios.}
{A Unique Fruit of Existence has begun to form within your Aletheian Haven of Quantum...}
{A Unique Fruit of Existence has begun to form within your Forge...!}
Within his Havens, within his Forge.
The backbone of Fruits of Existence began to form.
But he wasn't something as massive as the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
The progression of his Fruits of Existence was a little slower as even after 30 seconds passed, they were not even halfway done!
But nonetheless, they were forming.

It was a reality that very few Entities could say they witnessed in the eons that passed or were capable of doing it themselves- especially if it was someone in the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm!
And with it occuring...
{The analysis of the Fruits of Existence under Existential Analytical Looter has increased greatly.}
{Your Dominium has begun producing genuine Fruits of Existence as you turn your existence into something capable of a profound action.}
{Your extremes support your heavy path.}
{Your Fable stands strong enough to support such Existential shattering actions.}
{Many authorities within you are budding waves of Existential Extremity Authorities and increased elevation in their status.}

{The Weavings of the Extremity of the Hero flourish with brilliance as they garnered enough support from Quintillions upon quintillions of existence that were saved from extinction, accumulating concentrated seas of authority that can be transformed into at least 1,000 Quintessential Fruits of Existence through your Dominium.}
{All those who looked upon your existence as one that saved them have been Recorded in the Fable of the Hero. Existences sharing a unique fate or destiny have been highlighted.}
The endless amounts of people he saved within the Vacuous and Vitalis Existential Domains.
They bore literal fruits from his endeavors as the prompts continued!

{The Weavings of the Extremity of the Villain flourish with brilliance as they garnered enough support from many Entities with high levels of existence that considered you the bane of their existence, one who has destroyed everything they have built along with their weavings of Existence.}
{The Weavings of the Extremity of the Villain have accumulated concentrated seas of authority that can be transformed into at least 2,000 Quintessential Fruits of Existence through your Dominium.}
{All those who looked upon your existence as the bane of theirs have been Recorded in the Fable of the Villain. Those with the greatest capabilities to stand in your way have been highlighted.}
Within him, a scripture containing the Fable of the Villain unfolded as waves of information flowed from it.
Those who considered him a great enemy.
At the top of the list currently, there were some unique names.
1- Archon Basileus Al-Abalem 2- Basileus Anaine 3- Archon Basileus Ignatius 4- Archon Basileus Lethith 5- Royal Basileus Observer...
There were many who considered him a great enemy as just in the top five, three were Archons who led Legacies!
But none of this caused Noah to fear as he lingered on the name Basileus Anaine for a moment, thinking of the woman who made a choice not too long ago.
And as he thought about his enemies...
|The weavings of those who stand against the Existential Omniversal Emperor must be eradicated!|
A heavy intent reverberated out within Noah's mind, with this intent actually stemming out from beings connected to him.
A part of his will flashed to observe a scene near a transforming Existential Omniversal Blacksmith's Forge.
Here, dozens of Existential Illusory Weavings floated powerfully as they stared at the depths of the Blacksmith's Forge where the outlines of massive Existential Automatons were coming to fruition.

Around this region, magisterial Existential Omniversal Extremity Passages pointed down and gushed out authority endlessly that flowed towards the Dominiums of the invisible army of Noah's, with some even going to the Illusory Weavings of the Mimeisthais he had destroyed and analyzed!

The intent wishing to destroy his enemies stemmed from them while their very existence was being strengthened- while they were being pumped and restructured with Manadynamics at their base, along with the infusion of other Existential Extremity Authorities.
This was just one side of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and Noah, with there being so many to pay attention to as regarding the intent thrown out by his invisible army...
{Not quite yet...}
Noah sent a command back as he brought a majority of his will back towards his visage on the throne.
He had to.
Because even as Fruits of Existence were now being produced and generated every minute, Manadynamics did not stop there.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed did not stop there.
Noah's Dominiums pulsed as they felt something shocking forming, his rousing will pulled towards the newly forming Quintessential Gradations of Extremity that even he hadn't perused through yet.
How vastly did they change the progression across the Gradations of Extremity compared to the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains? Compared to the Great Imperium?
He didn't get a chance to even answer this question yet as above these very Quintessential Gradations of Extremity...
BOOM!
The foundations of something even more ecstatic began to form.
Powered by the endless authority of Manadynamics.
Its authority that stated it could change all forms of authorities into something it wished.
At this moment, it carried the blazing authority of the fallen Annals of Extremity, of the weavings of devoured Existential Domains as its result...
{The Infinite Existential Dominium Sky is being forged.}
Set to be above the Quintessential Gradations of Extremity.
Set for those in the Existential Dominium Realm.
Across the Omniverse, it was known that there wasn't a cap on how far one could grow their Dominium.
It was an endless process.
Countless Fruits of Existence were devoured as no entity has found a cap on their progression.
And on this day, an entity newly born in the Existential Omniverse began forming a construct of an Infinite Existential Dominium Sky that would propel him across this endless weaving of progression.
As he embarked on this endless weaving of existence that many others had already stepped on over the eons!
On this day, the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky was being formed as from it...an Endless Weaving awakened!

A heavy intent reverberated out within Noah's mind, with this intent actually stemming out from beings connected to him.
A part of his will flashed to observe a scene near a transforming Existential Omniversal Blacksmith's Forge.
Here, dozens of Existential Illusory Weavings floated powerfully as they stared at the depths of the Blacksmith's Forge where the outlines of massive Existential Automatons were coming to fruition.

Around this region, magisterial Existential Omniversal Extremity Passages pointed down and gushed out authority endlessly that flowed towards the Dominiums of the invisible army of Noah's, with some even going to the Illusory Weavings of the Mimeisthais he had destroyed and analyzed!

The intent wishing to destroy his enemies stemmed from them while their very existence was being strengthened- while they were being pumped and restructured with Manadynamics at their base, along with the infusion of other Existential Extremity Authorities.
This was just one side of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and Noah, with there being so many to pay attention to as regarding the intent thrown out by his invisible army...
{Not quite yet...}
Noah sent a command back as he brought a majority of his will back towards his visage on the throne.
He had to.
Because even as Fruits of Existence were now being produced and generated every minute, Manadynamics did not stop there.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed did not stop there.
Noah's Dominiums pulsed as they felt something shocking forming, his rousing will pulled towards the newly forming Quintessential Gradations of Extremity that even he hadn't perused through yet.
How vastly did they change the progression across the Gradations of Extremity compared to the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains?
Compared to the Great Imperium?
He didn't get a chance to even answer this question yet as above these very Quintessential Gradations of Extremity...
BOOM!
The foundations of something even more ecstatic began to form.
Powered by the endless authority of Manadynamics.
Its authority that stated it could change all forms of authorities into something it wished.
At this moment, it carried the blazing authority of the fallen Annals of Extremity, of the weavings of devoured Existential Domains as its result...
{The Infinite Existential Dominium Sky is being forged.}
Set to be above the Quintessential Gradations of Extremity.
Set for those in the Existential Dominium Realm.
Across the Omniverse, it was known that there wasn't a cap on how far one could grow their Dominium.
It was an endless process.
Countless Fruits of Existence were devoured as no entity has found a cap on their progression.
And on this day, an entity newly born in the Existential Omniverse began forming a construct of an Infinite Existential Dominium Sky that would propel him across this endless weaving of progression.
As he embarked on this endless weaving of existence that many others had already stepped on over the eons!
On this day, the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky was being formed as from it...an Endless Weaving awakened!

chapters.title: Chapter 2977 An Infinite Sky! I
paragraphs: An Endless Weaving of power, grace, Quintessence, and much more.
Other Existences had their own version of this- their own progression...but did Noah always have to conform?
Did he have to bend to what they decided was the Existential Dominium Realm? Its boundaries and limitations? Or could he simply just create his own?!

Before he took down the few Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem and obtained eons worth of common sense of the Imperium, he had already done something that entities like them would consider crazy and inefficient by equally distributing Existential Authority equally between his three Dominiums.
Common sense for them was to seek a single Dominium and not divide one's resource between three, with this sense actually being true for the most part!

Someone who ate 1,200 Fruits of Existence and placed them all towards their Dominium Souls would be capable of expressing much greater power than someone who gave 400 Fruits of Existence to all three of their Dominiums. They would be equally weaker in all three as against the one who gave everything to a single aspect and elevated it to a higher point.
It was nothing complex, and this method was true and tried over the eons.
This was why the masses conformed to it.
But was this same common sense applicable to Noah!?
With his Fruits of Existence.
With his Lineage.
With his Foundation!
As he felt the Fruits of Existence forming throughout his Aletheian Havens and Forge, Noah's will buzzed with his extremes as he proceeded on his own path
What others deemed impossible...was merely something deserving a nod of his head and a wave of his hands.
He would forge his own path.
|Let us see this Dominium Sky...|
HUUM!
His intent echoed out.
And...
{The Extremity of Quintessence throws their support towards the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky.}
{The Extremity of Infinity throws their support towards the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky.}
{The Extremity of Cheats throws their unflinching support towards the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky...}
One extreme after another.
Their intent flowed along with Noah as they added in the construction of the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky!
Above the Quintessential Gradations of Extremity, an endless sky was forged.
{Let us see its beginnings...}

Noah rose from his throne as unlike the waters of the Gradations of Extremity where only a manifestation of himself could appear within, since he held his tremendous authority and this construct was under the control of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, he could appear they both directly and with a manifestation of his existence!
He took a step, and he disappeared only to reappear in a splendorous new space.

The weavings of many extremes seemed to be acting as the building blocks, with the fallen source of the Existential Domains, Records, Annals, and Extremes of Vitalis and Vacuous also being crumbled and recycled as the fuel!

All around, the authorities weaved into transparent white tendrils that formed symbols of Infinity- these weavings stretching out like endless rivers towards an endless sky whose end was not close to being decided.
The moment Noah arrived, waves of prompts came as he felt the extremes within his body come to life.
{You have utilized your absolute authority over the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed to appear in the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky.}
{It is a unique domain to cultivate one's Dominiums to their fullest, with the effectiveness of all tools of existence assimilated into one's Dominiums increasing by three times while in this space.}

{The early stages of the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky are demarcated by a characteristic white brilliance that others refer to as the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm. As the Master of this space, you can choose to declare this stage with this same distinction or another, with its upper tier being something influenced by you as it can vastly exceed what others commonly know to be the Neonate Stage.}

{Still under construction with its full features yet to be unveiled, but another one of its most distinct features is making it possible for the Extremes within one's Dominium to be stimulated to a Quintessential extent that one's extremes become actualized outside of their bodies. Such an action would already require a deep understanding of the Extremes within one's existence, with very few entities at the Neonate Stage capable of this, and with Existential Extremity Authorities being the only ones with a high level of strength to even express a sliver of their sentience outwardly.}
A unique prompt came as finally, Noah understood why he felt like his extremes were becoming much more active.
It was a rare feat.
Not even feasible for those in the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm!
And yet the moment Noah arrived, his immense understanding of the desires and intents of his extremes that he was already allowing to run free by expressing themselves...they began to bud and bloom.
His body began to pulse with arcs of multicolored Haki as soon, it felt like smoke was rising from his body!
It was heavy and thick, with the first one being Colorless as it was none other than Quintessence.
HUUM!

The gorgeous Dominium Sky trembled as above Noah thick Colorless essence arose like smoke from Noah's body...and rose above him to form a smoky visage of himself- but with a touch of extra glory and honor as it gazed up at the Dominium Sky!
An actualization of his extreme.
Different from the past Reified forms of his Extremes- with these concepts now being bound to him as to an extent, they were him!
They couldn't be extricated so easily as it was akin to pulling a part of himself away, but Quintessence became actualized at this moment as it wasn't the only one.
WU!
A moment later, an endlessly blue smoke arose from Noah another visage similar to him but looking extremely cold appeared!
The Reified Form of Infinity appeared as the gorgeous cerulean light began to cover the white hues all around.
Existential might emanated off of these reified forms with glory as they truly were just the first!

chapters.title: Chapter 2978 An Infinite Sky! II
paragraphs: After Quintessence and Infinity, blazing purple waves of glorious smoke rose from Noah one after another, and his Existential Extremes manifested outwardly!

Tyranny arose with heavy splendor as a burly visage of Noah with an expression of pride and power appeared, a dazzling purple crown floating above his head as he gazed calmly at Infinity and Quintessence.
After that, a golden brilliance rose as a halcyon visage of Noah exactly as he looked rose and looked at all others with its eyes raised- it was the Protagonist!
And not a beat later, another golden light rose as the visage of Loot appeared.

And this...was just too unique as a manifestation of Noah adorned with golden rings of bracelets filled with precious stones around his hands, a necklace that seemed to be connected with golden Fruits of Existence, and golden rivers of swirling diamond encrusted Fruits of Existence flowed around his whole smoky body!
He looked like a wealthy emperor from ancient times as even his eyes were gazing around shiftily for any signs of Loot!

Thereafter, the manifestation of his Origin appeared as a glaring infinity symbol with swirling Havens, a burly visage of his Body also made an appearance, and his Soul that looked most like his actual body and Quintessence also made an appearance.
Thereafter, obsidian smoke gathered.
The Dominium Sky once more trembled.
And from the ashes rose the visage of the Existential Extremity of Extremity.
It seemed shrouded in mystery and valor, its whole body wrapped by a thick veil as it joined the heavy circle of manifestations of Existential authorities around Noah.
Above his head, it felt like parts of himself had simply risen up and were looking at each other with their own unique personalities!
|I...| Quintessence was about to begin expressing its intent when all of a sudden...
BZZT!
Another endlessly blue light boomed from Noah as a dominating visage of Manadynamics bloomed.
Expanded by the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, but still part of Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities!
Its eyes felt like they were filled with a boundless sea of light as the pressure it emanated was immeasurably heavy and suffocating.
If any other entities were here, they may be crushed by the weight of the Existential Extremity Authorities manifesting here as they were simply that heavy!
And now, they all looked at each other.
Vitalis and Vacuous were excluded as Noah had not fully taken a look at them yet.
The Existential parts of Noah looked at each other as Quintessence was about to begin expressing its intent once more.
After all, all Existential Extremity Authorities were here, and only Existential Extremity Authorities could manifest themselves within this Infinite Existential Dominium Sky!
But...
HUUM!
Noah's main body radiated a gorgeous light once more.
And his extremes gazed questioningly as a daring aura rose from Noah's body, coming to manifest outwards with a dazzling light as a visage adorned in a white robe appeared.
Hair as dark as the farthest reaches of the Omniverse, and fair skin as brilliant as it could be.
A mischievous expression full of devilishness could be seen on its face as it gazed at the many Existential Extremity Authorities looking towards it, its intent weaving out!
|You all were going to have a party without inviting me?|
The Extremity of Cheats spoke out.
And silence reigned as all Existential Extremity Authorities gazed at its manifestation.
It wasn't an Existential Extremity Authority, and yet here it was standing amidst them with their heavy pressures! A devilish glint shone within the Manifestation of Cheats as it continued.
|We are here to ponder upon and choose from the innumerable paths forward, yes? Let's get the show on the road. Is the focus on ourselves? The Imperium? Legacies? The Existential Imperium Exchange?|
This manifestation of Noah spoke as if it were the most natural thing for it to be here, and Quintessence gave a nod at it with sharp eyes as its intent weaved out.

|We've devoured an Existential Domain, and we can always devour more- with an eventual future path being the devouring and assimilation of many Existential Domains as the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed goes from a Seed and into...a genuine Omniverse.|
HUUM!
Shockingly heavy words emanated from Noah's manifestation of Quintessence as it dared to mention putting an entire Omniverse under it- their main task being to aid in the production of such a thing!
|Mmm...| Cheats nodded with smiling eyes at this as it replied to Quintessence.

|Yes...even though we didn't fully devour everything, the taste of an Existential Domain still lingers in my mouth. You all picked up on the traces of the Great Usurper within the Archaeos Vacuous Pylos? That guy actually survived.|
Cheats uniquely mentioned one of their prior colleagues.
Noah Eckert! The Great Usurper!

From the weavings of the few Basileus that Noah's Existential Illusory Weavings killed before Archon Basileus Ignatius came, and from the land and Dikastes of Extremity themselves, Noah actually picked up traces of the Great Usurper.
At the mention of this, the Protagonist waved his hands dismissively as he radiated a golden glow.

|He'll do his own thing within the Legacy of Ignatius, that is his path. We shall focus on ours. Mainly mine since we are here after my first prophecy was achieved. An Endless Weaving has awakened as my next prophecy can generate even grander glory.|
The Protagonist declared his will.
Tyranny and Infinity nodded in affirmation as the Extremity of Cheats clapped while beckoning towards the Protagonist.
|Yes...the Prophecy. Hey big guy, what did you get from the successful completion of this prophecy that we all helped achieve? You were undergoing elevation moments ago.|
The Protagonist gazed towards Cheats who was smiling with a devilish glint as it replied.
|I can live up to my truest extreme even further. The distinction of the Weaver stemmed from me, the prophecy came from me, even you...|
HUUM!
A moment of profound tension arrived.
Different parts of his existence were having a discussion above Noah's head.
It was akin to him...talking to himself.
He was not crazy...this was just a unique method of his extremes!

chapters.title: Chapter 2979 An Infinite Sky! III
paragraphs: Many concepts were brought forth at the time that the Protagonist arose, and this distinction was brought forth at this moment to serve as a reminder!
The visage of the Protagonist held a sense of majesty as his gaze only caused the Extremity of Cheats to nod with a smile as he replied.
|Yes, but our Intents and desires aside...let's also not forget we are of the same source. We are merely part of a larger whole as all of us have a single purpose.|
HUUM!
Different parts of Noah's will came to gaze at each other.

Yes, each of them were distinct concepts that occasionally had their intents clash, but they were all ultimately extensions of Noah's will. And their main purpose was him. The expression of their extremes...were all for him!
|Yes.|
The booming intent of Quintessence reverberated out as all eyes turned towards it, a light of glory and direction shining within its eyes as it spoke.
|Protagonist, begin the design of a new prophecy, and make it as grandiose and broken as possible.|
|Loot, where are we with the analysis of Fruits of Existence?|
Two quick directions, the last one being a question for Loot who smiled to reveal gold teeth as if he were the grandest nouveau riche.
|Soon...and by then, this ridiculous time it is taking to generate the Fruits of Existence should be cut real short.|
Even now as the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed produced 1 unique Fruit of Existence every minute, none of the Fruits being generated within Noah's body has risen to completion!
The time they took was a lot longer, even if multiple were being made at once.
The extremes of Noah nodded and looked forward to this as Quintessence continued.
|And then, there's the elevation of Ruination...|
Ruination.
Anchored within Noah's soul, his progression was her progression as the Extremity of Soul had its visage speak calmly.

|The Judge #1 and the Judge #2 are already being broken down by her along with the other Existential Armaments. We don't need multiple trashy Armaments, just a single supreme one. Though in our case, our next phase may not necessarily be battle oriented.|
Yes.
Grand as he may be, overpowered as he may be, Noah was still only in the stage that others considered the Neophyte Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm!
He currently didn't hold a candle to the average Archons of Legacies, much less the most powerful entities within this Omniverse... of which there were many.
The next phase of his growth...the method for him to anneal his Dominiums and expand them at a rate others couldn't even fathom...
All gazes turned back towards a single manifestation.
All gazes turned towards Loot as he smiled bright gold.

|We have lots of products in our great lands, and this Omniverse seems uniquely designed with tools we can utilize to very quickly obtain Fruits of Existence. The more of these we attain, the faster we progress. Enemies that are on the list to be hunted like Archon Basileus Al-Abalem...they could be a whole stage beneath us and perish with a flick of a finger in mere days or weeks if our growth curve remains the same.|

Noah still held enemies who would be hunting him down with every part of their Dominiums for having taken what they considered their lands, and by extension...the Imperium would also be his great enemy since to them, he destroyed an Existential Domain under their banner!
All of these had to be brought into account as Noah progressed.

At this point, he could already talk about someone like Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and not worry about his weavings being found out just by thinking about him or mentioning his name, his realm of power having now grown to the extent that his records remained his own, the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed covering for him, and an entity of the Dominium Realm didn't vastly or outstrip him in power!
Ever so slowly, he was catching up to these monsters that had lived over eons as his direct path forward at this moment remained the heavy accumulation of...Fruits of Existence.
|Very well.|
Quintessence clapped his hands.

|We shall solidify our power at this initial stage of the Existential Dominium Realm, and since we shall not follow the convention of others...this stage shall be deemed the Primordium Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.|
HUUM!
The surroundings buzzed.
The surroundings of the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky vibrated as Noah granted it a new distinction that was his alone!
Noah's Primordium Stage would be something that the Neophyte Stage of others could not even compare to.
And when his people moved across the Quintessential Gradations of Extremity to arrive here, they would embark on the same Quintessential path!

As the surroundings of the Dominium Sky began to blaze with white rivers of flames forming into infinity symbols, Noah's manifestation of Cheats nodded with a thoughtful expression as he spoke before Quintessence could continue.

|In addition to all of this, I've begun to play around and tweak the Codex of Extremity. The light from this book...should allow for free entry into the lands of the Imperium, and even protection while utilizing the Existential Imperium Exchange. It will set the stage as the key to entering this vast Omniverse, and even for the lands that aren't Existential Domains where one can accumulate Fruits of Existence...|

Cheats took it upon himself to begin doing this and more as the other extremes no longer looked at this concept as if it weren't an Existential one, their discussions continuing as a moment later, all of these manifestations of smoky brilliance began to recede down and delve back into Noah's lone figure.
Their weavings continued within him.
Their extremes moved according to his will as they looked at many aspects of his existence all at once and planned for a glorious future!
And at this moment.
Noah's eyes opened with blinding white brilliance, his Dominiums seemingly trembling from excitement while staring at the endless Dominium Sky around them as...
{The First unique Fruit of Existence has been produced within your Dominium.}
{An Unfathomable Achievement!}
The Weaver of Extremity was gradually becoming something else entirely as with his own existence, he fully produced a Fruit of Existence for the first time!

sentences.text: Many concepts were brought forth at the time that the Protagonist arose, and this distinction was brought forth at this moment to serve as a reminder!
The visage of the Protagonist held a sense of majesty as his gaze only caused the Extremity of Cheats to nod with a smile as he replied.
|Yes, but our Intents and desires aside...let's also not forget we are of the same source.
We are merely part of a larger whole as all of us have a single purpose.|
HUUM!
Different parts of Noah's will came to gaze at each other.
Yes, each of them were distinct concepts that occasionally had their intents clash, but they were all ultimately extensions of Noah's will.
And their main purpose was him.
The expression of their extremes...were all for him!
|Yes.|
The booming intent of Quintessence reverberated out as all eyes turned towards it, a light of glory and direction shining within its eyes as it spoke.
|Protagonist, begin the design of a new prophecy, and make it as grandiose and broken as possible.|
|Loot, where are we with the analysis of Fruits of Existence?|
Two quick directions, the last one being a question for Loot who smiled to reveal gold teeth as if he were the grandest nouveau riche.
|Soon...and by then, this ridiculous time it is taking to generate the Fruits of Existence should be cut real short.|
Even now as the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed produced 1 unique Fruit of Existence every minute, none of the Fruits being generated within Noah's body has risen to completion!
The time they took was a lot longer, even if multiple were being made at once.
The extremes of Noah nodded and looked forward to this as Quintessence continued.
|And then, there's the elevation of Ruination...|
Ruination.
Anchored within Noah's soul, his progression was her progression as the Extremity of Soul had its visage speak calmly.
|The Judge #1 and the Judge #2 are already being broken down by her along with the other Existential Armaments.
We don't need multiple trashy Armaments, just a single supreme one.
Though in our case, our next phase may not necessarily be battle oriented.|
Yes.
Grand as he may be, overpowered as he may be, Noah was still only in the stage that others considered the Neophyte Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm!
He currently didn't hold a candle to the average Archons of Legacies, much less the most powerful entities within this Omniverse... of which there were many.
The next phase of his growth...the method for him to anneal his Dominiums and expand them at a rate others couldn't even fathom...
All gazes turned back towards a single manifestation.
All gazes turned towards Loot as he smiled bright gold.
|We have lots of products in our great lands, and this Omniverse seems uniquely designed with tools we can utilize to very quickly obtain Fruits of Existence.
The more of these we attain, the faster we progress.

Enemies that are on the list to be hunted like Archon Basileus Al-Abalem...they could be a whole stage beneath us and perish with a flick of a finger in mere days or weeks if our growth curve remains the same.|

Noah still held enemies who would be hunting him down with every part of their Dominiums for having taken what they considered their lands, and by extension...the Imperium would also be his great enemy since to them, he destroyed an Existential Domain under their banner!
All of these had to be brought into account as Noah progressed.

At this point, he could already talk about someone like Archon Basileus Al-Abalem and not worry about his weavings being found out just by thinking about him or mentioning his name, his realm of power having now grown to the extent that his records remained his own, the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed covering for him, and an entity of the Dominium Realm didn't vastly or outstrip him in power!
Ever so slowly, he was catching up to these monsters that had lived over eons as his direct path forward at this moment remained the heavy accumulation of...Fruits of Existence.
|Very well.|
Quintessence clapped his hands.

|We shall solidify our power at this initial stage of the Existential Dominium Realm, and since we shall not follow the convention of others...this stage shall be deemed the Primordium Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.|
HUUM!
The surroundings buzzed.
The surroundings of the Infinite Existential Dominium Sky vibrated as Noah granted it a new distinction that was his alone!
Noah's Primordium Stage would be something that the Neophyte Stage of others could not even compare to.
And when his people moved across the Quintessential Gradations of Extremity to arrive here, they would embark on the same Quintessential path!

As the surroundings of the Dominium Sky began to blaze with white rivers of flames forming into infinity symbols, Noah's manifestation of Cheats nodded with a thoughtful expression as he spoke before Quintessence could continue.
